segments.speaker: Rep. Arnie B. Fuentebella
segments.text: Diyos maray na aga po sa inyong gabos, [unclear] day to everyone.

segments.speaker: Rep. Arnie B. Fuentebella
segments.text: I again have the honor of welcoming Secretary Juanito Victor "Jonvic" Remulla,

segments.speaker: Rep. Arnie B. Fuentebella
segments.text: the honorable members of this committee, the heads, officials, and personnel of the Department of the Interior and Local Government,

segments.speaker: Rep. Arnie B. Fuentebella
segments.text: and its attached agencies, our resource persons, and our distinguished guests

segments.speaker: Rep. Arnie B. Fuentebella
segments.text: for the briefing on the Department's proposed budget for fiscal year 2027.

segments.speaker: Rep. Arnie B. Fuentebella
segments.text: When we speak of poverty, we usually speak of income.

segments.speaker: Rep. Arnie B. Fuentebella
segments.text: We speak of the ability of every family to afford food, secure decent work,

segments.speaker: Rep. Arnie B. Fuentebella
segments.text: access essential services, and pursue a better life.

segments.speaker: Rep. Arnie B. Fuentebella
segments.text: There is, however, one dimension of poverty we tend to overlook, the poverty of security.

segments.speaker: Rep. Arnie B. Fuentebella
segments.text: To my fellow lawmakers, peace, safety, disaster, resilience, and the capacity of our local government units

segments.speaker: Rep. Arnie B. Fuentebella
segments.text: to deliver basic necessities are not expenses that compete with economic development.

segments.speaker: Rep. Arnie B. Fuentebella
segments.text: They are the conditions which make economic development possible.

segments.speaker: Rep. Arnie B. Fuentebella
segments.text: Congress therefore supports the Department's direction

segments.speaker: Rep. Arnie B. Fuentebella
segments.text: stronger local governments, and law enforcement institutions that are trusted, capable, and responsive.

segments.speaker: Rep. Arnie B. Fuentebella
segments.text: This is precisely why the DILG's requested budget of P332.5 billion

segments.speaker: Rep. Arnie B. Fuentebella
segments.text: under the fiscal year 2027 National Expenditure Program.

segments.speaker: Rep. Arnie B. Fuentebella
segments.text: the Fiscal Year 2026 General Appropriations Act level

segments.speaker: Rep. Arnie B. Fuentebella
segments.text: will be a strategic public commitment that should yield clear and measurable returns in peace and order,

segments.speaker: Rep. Arnie B. Fuentebella
segments.text: public safety, disaster preparedness, and local governance.

segments.speaker: Rep. Arnie B. Fuentebella
segments.text: It will provide sustained institutional support for the department

segments.speaker: Rep. Arnie B. Fuentebella
segments.text: and will convert national policy into peace, safety, security, and services

segments.speaker: Rep. Arnie B. Fuentebella
segments.text: at the level where Filipinos actually experience government.

segments.speaker: Rep. Arnie B. Fuentebella
segments.text: Of the total proposal, P242.5 billion is intended for the Philippine National Police,

segments.speaker: Rep. Arnie B. Fuentebella
segments.text: underscoring its central role of effective policing and maintaining a secure domestic environment.

segments.speaker: Rep. Arnie B. Fuentebella
segments.text: Over the past year, the DILG has delivered significant gains in public safety,

segments.speaker: Rep. Arnie B. Fuentebella
segments.text: law enforcement, corrections, and local governance.

segments.speaker: Rep. Arnie B. Fuentebella
segments.text: The department posted a 96.33 efficiency rate in emergency response

segments.speaker: Rep. Arnie B. Fuentebella
segments.text: with response times of 5 to 7 minutes.

segments.speaker: Rep. Arnie B. Fuentebella
segments.text: As we enter the rainy season, we now have 50,441 evacuation centers nationwide

segments.speaker: Rep. Arnie B. Fuentebella
segments.text: with more than 126,000 uniformed personnel deployed for disaster response

segments.speaker: Rep. Arnie B. Fuentebella
segments.text: ready to assist Filipinos in distress,

segments.speaker: Rep. Arnie B. Fuentebella
segments.text: especially in light of the recent Habagat.

segments.speaker: Rep. Arnie B. Fuentebella
segments.text: The crime rate has continued to go down

segments.speaker: Rep. Arnie B. Fuentebella
segments.text: with lower numbers across focused crimes,

segments.speaker: Rep. Arnie B. Fuentebella
segments.text: especially as the threat environment continues to evolve.

segments.speaker: Rep. Arnie B. Fuentebella
segments.text: Recent incidents of school and academic violence involving students,

segments.speaker: Rep. Arnie B. Fuentebella
segments.text: create a new challenge for the PNP

segments.speaker: Rep. Arnie B. Fuentebella
segments.text: and other law enforcement agencies with related mandates.

segments.speaker: Rep. Arnie B. Fuentebella
segments.text: The PNP's report of 50 school-related incidents involving minors from June 16 to August 18, 2026

segments.speaker: Rep. Arnie B. Fuentebella
segments.text: reinforces the need for prevention, early detection, rapid response,

segments.speaker: Rep. Arnie B. Fuentebella
segments.text: and responsible digital monitoring that respects lawful safeguards.

segments.speaker: Rep. Arnie B. Fuentebella
segments.text: we welcome and support the Department's review of school security protocols,

segments.speaker: Rep. Arnie B. Fuentebella
segments.text: the strengthening of safer school zones,

segments.speaker: Rep. Arnie B. Fuentebella
segments.text: including mobilization of barangay peace and safety mechanisms.

segments.speaker: Rep. Arnie B. Fuentebella
segments.text: The proposed budget provides concrete support through

segments.speaker: Rep. Arnie B. Fuentebella
segments.text: P2 billion for the PNP capability enhancement program,

segments.speaker: Rep. Arnie B. Fuentebella
segments.text: and P48.95 million for Phase 2 of the Philippine Public Safety College National Cyber Training Institute.

segments.speaker: Rep. Arnie B. Fuentebella
segments.text: These resources should translate into trained investigators,

segments.speaker: Rep. Arnie B. Fuentebella
segments.text: and clear response protocols for schools and communities.

segments.speaker: Rep. Arnie B. Fuentebella
segments.text: peace is not simply the absence of conflict.

segments.speaker: Rep. Arnie B. Fuentebella
segments.text: It is the foundation on which all sustainable development is built.

segments.speaker: Rep. Arnie B. Fuentebella
segments.text: No less than the President himself said in his SONA

segments.speaker: Rep. Arnie B. Fuentebella
segments.text: that our goal as a government is to uplift the lives of struggling Filipinos.

segments.speaker: Rep. Arnie B. Fuentebella
segments.text: If our objective is to uplift the poor,

segments.speaker: Rep. Arnie B. Fuentebella
segments.text: we must make sure places where Filipinos live are safe,

segments.speaker: Rep. Arnie B. Fuentebella
segments.text: orderly, and resilient with their local governments

segments.speaker: Rep. Arnie B. Fuentebella
segments.text: capable of responding immediately when crisis strikes.

segments.speaker: Rep. Arnie B. Fuentebella
segments.text: The DILG's budget affirms our shared commitment

segments.speaker: Rep. Arnie B. Fuentebella
segments.text: to strengthen the government's capacity to act.

segments.speaker: Rep. Arnie B. Fuentebella
segments.text: Communities in crisis need a government capable of responding today,

segments.speaker: Rep. Arnie B. Fuentebella
segments.text: is to help the Department move these reforms forward

segments.speaker: Rep. Arnie B. Fuentebella
segments.text: while ensuring that every appropriation is used

segments.speaker: Rep. Arnie B. Fuentebella
segments.text: strategically, promptly, and accountably to prevent threats,

segments.speaker: Rep. Arnie B. Fuentebella
segments.text: protect the vulnerable, and preserve peaceful communities.

segments.speaker: Rep. Arnie B. Fuentebella
segments.text: Congress stands ready to support Secretary Remulla and the entire DILG family

segments.speaker: Rep. Arnie B. Fuentebella
segments.text: in advancing programs that strengthen peace and order

segments.speaker: Rep. Arnie B. Fuentebella
segments.text: and allow our people's school, business, and local economies

segments.speaker: Rep. Arnie B. Fuentebella
segments.text: We must protect our constituents' right to safety and security.

segments.speaker: Rep. Arnie B. Fuentebella
segments.text: our constituents are put in a better position for growth,

segments.speaker: Rep. Arnie B. Fuentebella
segments.text: Secretary Remulla, we look forward to your presentation.

segments.speaker: Rep. Arnie B. Fuentebella
segments.text: Diyos mabalos po. Salamat po sa inyong lahat.

segments.speaker: DILG Secretary Juanito Victor C. Remulla
segments.text: Thank you very much, Honorable Congressman Fuentebella.

segments.speaker: DILG Secretary Juanito Victor C. Remulla
DILG Video Narrator
segments.text: and Local Government is at the forefront of advancing peace and order, public

segments.speaker: DILG Video Narrator
segments.text: safety and responsive local governance across the country. Together with its attached agencies,

segments.speaker: DILG Video Narrator
segments.text: the Department works to strengthen local government units, enhance public safety and

segments.speaker: DILG Video Narrator
segments.text: emergency response and promote inclusive programs that uplift the lives and welfare of Filipinos.

segments.speaker: DILG Video Narrator
segments.text: With the support, resources and confidence entrusted to us by Congress, the Department

segments.speaker: DILG Video Narrator
segments.text: has continued to fulfill its mandate and deliver programs aligned with the President's priorities

segments.speaker: DILG Video Narrator
segments.text: for the country. Safeguarding our collective peace and prosperity, and ensuring our people

segments.speaker: DILG Video Narrator
segments.text: safe and secure, remained among our foremost priorities. We continue to strengthen the unified

segments.speaker: DILG Video Narrator
segments.text: through acquiring additional assets and expanding access to emergency services,

segments.speaker: DILG Video Narrator
segments.text: which led to more calls, fewer prank calls, and an improved emergency response time.

segments.speaker: DILG Video Narrator
segments.text: The aggressive anti-criminality campaign by the PNP led to reduced crimes throughout the country

segments.speaker: DILG Video Narrator
segments.text: while the NAPOLCOM fulfilled its commitment of zero backlog in cases involving police officers

segments.speaker: DILG Video Narrator
segments.text: that helped restore accountability, integrity and public trust. Our unrelenting drive

segments.speaker: DILG Video Narrator
segments.text: against illegal drugs led to billions worth of drugs seized, thousands arrested, and more

segments.speaker: DILG Video Narrator
segments.text: barangays nationwide cleared of drug-related threats. This we did, even as we completed

segments.speaker: DILG Video Narrator
segments.text: development projects in conflict-affected areas and gave former rebels more opportunities to

segments.speaker: DILG Video Narrator
segments.text: begin anew. Through the BJMP, we significantly reduced jail congestion as well as provided

segments.speaker: DILG Video Narrator
segments.text: holistic rehabilitation and reintegration services for persons deprived of liberty.

segments.speaker: DILG Video Narrator
segments.text: We instituted sweeping reforms within the BFP to strengthen transparency, integrity

segments.speaker: DILG Video Narrator
segments.text: and accountability, which contributed to more effective and efficient fire prevention and

segments.speaker: DILG Video Narrator
segments.text: suppression services, thereby reducing fire incidents and saving more lives.

segments.speaker: DILG Video Narrator
segments.text: The Department continues to empower and transform our local government units as capable and agile

segments.speaker: DILG Video Narrator
segments.text: partners for national development. Our rigorous monitoring of national and local government

segments.speaker: DILG Video Narrator
segments.text: funded projects ensured the completion of thousands of projects such as farm-to-market roads,

segments.speaker: DILG Video Narrator
segments.text: evacuation centers, rice subsidies, water and sanitation systems, and other community facilities

segments.speaker: DILG Video Narrator
segments.text: that benefited millions of Filipino families, especially in underserved and disadvantaged areas.

segments.speaker: DILG Video Narrator
segments.text: We nurtured our newly elected local officials as well as our barangay and Sangguniang Kabataan

segments.speaker: DILG Video Narrator
segments.text: officials through various capacity-building interventions. We accelerated the

segments.speaker: DILG Video Narrator
segments.text: digitalization and automation of LGU services that led to faster and more efficient governance,

segments.speaker: DILG Video Narrator
segments.text: which is essential in attracting businesses and investments and boosting economic development among

segments.speaker: DILG Video Narrator
segments.text: LGUs. The Department likewise played a pivotal role in making our LGUs adequately prepared,

segments.speaker: DILG Video Narrator
segments.text: which cushioned the impact of typhoons and other calamities that hit the various parts of the country.

segments.speaker: DILG Video Narrator
segments.text: These include the constant monitoring of evacuation centers in LGUs,

segments.speaker: DILG Video Narrator
segments.text: as well as the timely and strategic deployment of first responders in affected areas

segments.speaker: DILG Video Narrator
segments.text: to provide immediate assistance during and after disasters.

segments.speaker: DILG Video Narrator
segments.text: We also monitor the completion of rehabilitated and constructed facilities and maintain the

segments.speaker: DILG Video Narrator
segments.text: cleanliness of barangays and communities to help prevent further risks to public health.

segments.speaker: DILG Video Narrator
segments.text: Uplifting the lives and welfare of every Filipino has been the driving force behind our sectoral interventions.

segments.speaker: DILG Video Narrator
segments.text: We advanced the institutionalization of early childhood care and development while investing in the capacity and potential of the next generation of Filipinos.

segments.speaker: DILG Video Narrator
segments.text: We also continued to address the needs of our Muslim brethren while strengthening our efforts in advancing gender equality in the country

segments.speaker: DILG Video Narrator
segments.text: that are at par with or even better than those of other countries in Asia and across the globe.

segments.speaker: DILG Video Narrator
segments.text: These and much more have been made possible as reflected in our strong financial performance in 2025

segments.speaker: DILG Video Narrator
segments.text: Similarly, we remain on track to achieve our financial targets for the year

segments.speaker: DILG Video Narrator
segments.text: with a 55% obligation rate and a nearly 97% disbursement rate as of mid-year.

segments.speaker: DILG Video Narrator
segments.text: Our proposal for the next fiscal year reflects our commitment to sustaining our ongoing initiatives

segments.speaker: DILG Video Narrator
segments.text: and advancing our goals, amounting to a total of

segments.speaker: DILG Video Narrator
segments.text: P332.5 billion, a 7% increase from last year's appropriation.

segments.speaker: DILG Video Narrator
segments.text: Of this amount, Bureau of Jail Management and Penology, Bureau of Fire Protection, Philippine National Police,

segments.speaker: DILG Video Narrator
segments.text: and the Office of the Secretary have registered increases in their respective appropriations.

segments.speaker: DILG Video Narrator
segments.text: While the Early Childhood Care and Development Council, Philippine Commission on Women,

segments.speaker: DILG Video Narrator
segments.text: National Commission on Muslim Filipinos, National Youth Commission, and National Police Commission

segments.speaker: DILG Video Narrator
segments.text: have experienced decreases compared with their previous appropriations.

segments.speaker: DILG Video Narrator
segments.text: Consistent with the previous years, the majority of our proposed budget, equivalent to 84%,

segments.speaker: DILG Video Narrator
segments.text: is allocated to personal services, while 13% is earmarked for maintenance and other operating expenses

segments.speaker: DILG Video Narrator
segments.text: The proposed budget is broken down by expense class per agency.

segments.speaker: DILG Video Narrator
segments.text: With your help, we will be able to build on these gains through the proposals each agency has put forward for your consideration.

segments.speaker: DILG Video Narrator
segments.text: The Office of the Secretary will continue to uplift local governance in every community

segments.speaker: DILG Video Narrator
segments.text: through the implementation of various programs and projects

segments.speaker: DILG Video Narrator
segments.text: advance digitalization, good governance, and citizen participation.

segments.speaker: DILG Video Narrator
segments.text: We will remain unwavering in improving our emergency response system

segments.speaker: DILG Video Narrator
segments.text: to make it more efficient and accessible,

segments.speaker: DILG Video Narrator
segments.text: while strengthening the fight against illegal drugs

segments.speaker: DILG Video Narrator
segments.text: and advancing peace and order in the communities.

segments.speaker: DILG Video Narrator
segments.text: Our drive continues to focus on the rehabilitation and cleanup of Manila Bay,

segments.speaker: DILG Video Narrator
segments.text: and fully operationalizing our new central office and regional offices.

segments.speaker: DILG Video Narrator
segments.text: The LGA will continue to strengthen LGUs and the DILG personnel

segments.speaker: DILG Video Narrator
segments.text: through training newly elected barangay officials,

segments.speaker: DILG Video Narrator
segments.text: advancing disaster readiness, innovation, creative industries, and security,

segments.speaker: DILG Video Narrator
segments.text: and strengthening their capacity to deliver these interventions.

segments.speaker: DILG Video Narrator
segments.text: To uphold integrity and trust in our police force,

segments.speaker: DILG Video Narrator
segments.text: the NAPOLCOM will prioritize investments in critical facilities in Regions 3, 5,

segments.speaker: DILG Video Narrator
segments.text: and Cordillera Administrative Region, ICT projects, ISO certification, and equipment for Negros Island Region.

segments.speaker: DILG Video Narrator
segments.text: The Philippine National Police will strengthen its ranks to become a reliable and trustworthy partner in law enforcement

segments.speaker: DILG Video Narrator
segments.text: through the recruitment of new personnel, enhanced equipment and ICT capabilities,

segments.speaker: DILG Video Narrator
segments.text: and stronger support for the welfare of its personnel.

segments.speaker: DILG Video Narrator
segments.text: fulfilling commitments under the Program Convergence Initiatives,

segments.speaker: DILG Video Narrator
segments.text: intensifying police operations, and constructing new facilities.

segments.speaker: DILG Video Narrator
segments.text: The Bureau of Fire Protection will likewise accelerate efforts in fire prevention, suppression, and emergency response

segments.speaker: DILG Video Narrator
segments.text: through hiring new fire officers, operationalizing newly completed fire stations,

segments.speaker: DILG Video Narrator
segments.text: deploying new fire trucks, procuring equipment,

segments.speaker: DILG Video Narrator
segments.text: and constructing new fire stations, training centers, and a fire arson laboratory.

segments.speaker: DILG Video Narrator
segments.text: To safeguard and rehabilitate persons deprived of liberty,

segments.speaker: DILG Video Narrator
segments.text: the Bureau of Jail Management and Penology will bring in recruits to reinforce operational capability

segments.speaker: DILG Video Narrator
segments.text: and ensure hygiene and medical support.

segments.text: Ninety-five point two percent, I think, sir.

segments.speaker: Rep. Rolando M. Valeriano
segments.text: And 2026, halos tingin niyo yun din, 95 percent.

segments.speaker: Rep. Rolando M. Valeriano
segments.text: na natanggap or hindi masyadong naibigay yung budget.

segments.speaker: Rep. Rolando M. Valeriano
segments.text: medyo malaki pa kulang natin sa

segments.speaker: Rep. Rolando M. Valeriano
segments.text: Bureau of Fire po. Opo, medyo malaki pa kulang natin sa mga firetruck, ha?

segments.speaker: Rep. Rolando M. Valeriano
segments.text: at mukhang hindi kasama sa budget?

segments.speaker: DILG Secretary Juanito Victor C. Remulla
DILG Secretary Juanito Victor C. Remulla
segments.text: The budget for the firetrucks comes from the collections from the fire inspection of the BFP.

segments.speaker: DILG Secretary Juanito Victor C. Remulla
DILG Secretary Juanito Victor C. Remulla
DILG Secretary Juanito Victor C. Remulla
DILG Secretary Juanito Victor C. Remulla
segments.text: is collected for the fire code fees.

segments.speaker: DILG Secretary Juanito Victor C. Remulla
segments.text: But this is what we remit directly into the National Treasury.

segments.speaker: DILG Secretary Juanito Victor C. Remulla
segments.text: Unfortunately, that four point five billion is not committed entirely for the use of the BFP.

segments.speaker: DILG Secretary Juanito Victor C. Remulla
segments.text: I think this year, only one billion was committed by the Treasury,

segments.speaker: DILG Secretary Juanito Victor C. Remulla
segments.text: although it should be in a lockbox for the use of the BFP.

segments.speaker: DILG Secretary Juanito Victor C. Remulla
segments.text: However, sir, we have come up with a novel plan

segments.speaker: DILG Secretary Juanito Victor C. Remulla
segments.text: of entering into a government-to-government deal with Korea.

segments.speaker: DILG Secretary Juanito Victor C. Remulla
segments.text: We just came there recently, a few weeks ago.

segments.speaker: DILG Secretary Juanito Victor C. Remulla
segments.text: And we are in the process of completing a government-to-government transaction of 1,500 trucks over the next four years

segments.speaker: DILG Secretary Juanito Victor C. Remulla
segments.text: so that all municipalities will be covered in the next four years.

segments.speaker: DILG Secretary Juanito Victor C. Remulla
segments.text: And furthermore, we will now remove the corruption that has been endemic in the BFP

segments.speaker: DILG Secretary Juanito Victor C. Remulla
DILG Secretary Juanito Victor C. Remulla
segments.text: So, a government-to-government transaction immediately erases all doubts

segments.speaker: DILG Secretary Juanito Victor C. Remulla
segments.text: because it is only the governments that talk.

segments.speaker: Rep. Rolando M. Valeriano
segments.text: And the reason why I'm asking that, Sek,

segments.speaker: Rep. Rolando M. Valeriano
segments.text: kasi siyempre kung ano yung maitutulong ng Kongreso kung kailangan na magdagdag ng pondo since budget season ngayon,

segments.speaker: Rep. Rolando M. Valeriano
segments.text: pero maliit lang naman din yung requirement na kailangan.

segments.speaker: Rep. Rolando M. Valeriano
segments.text: I move sana na mahanapan pa natin ng additional budget

segments.speaker: Rep. Rolando M. Valeriano
segments.text: yung DILG, especially the Bureau of Fire, tsaka yung PNP,

segments.speaker: Rep. Rolando M. Valeriano
segments.text: and also ito na rin, Bureau of Jail Management,

segments.speaker: Rep. Rolando M. Valeriano
segments.text: para kahit papaano makaganap sila ng katungkulan.

segments.speaker: Rep. Rolando M. Valeriano
segments.text: Kasi parang narinig ko, ang firetruck is mga forty years na?

segments.speaker: DILG Secretary Juanito Victor C. Remulla
DILG Secretary Juanito Victor C. Remulla
Rep. Rolando M. Valeriano
segments.text: Baka tinutulak na lang yun, sir.

segments.speaker: DILG Secretary Juanito Victor C. Remulla
DILG Secretary Juanito Victor C. Remulla
segments.text: That's why yung refleeting program [unclear] is a four-year program,

segments.speaker: DILG Secretary Juanito Victor C. Remulla
DILG Secretary Juanito Victor C. Remulla
segments.text: Purchased at 40% less of the cost of the previous fire trucks.

segments.speaker: DILG Secretary Juanito Victor C. Remulla
segments.text: And it will have a maintenance contract with it

segments.speaker: DILG Secretary Juanito Victor C. Remulla
segments.text: so that we will make sure that all municipalities can maintain all their trucks.

segments.speaker: DILG Secretary Juanito Victor C. Remulla
DILG Secretary Juanito Victor C. Remulla
segments.text: if we do repeal the Robin Padilla law

segments.speaker: DILG Secretary Juanito Victor C. Remulla
segments.text: and I hope that this distinguished body acts on it,

segments.speaker: DILG Secretary Juanito Victor C. Remulla
segments.text: I would request that you add additional funds for the BJMP

segments.speaker: DILG Secretary Juanito Victor C. Remulla
DILG Secretary Juanito Victor C. Remulla
segments.text: Because the loose firearms in this country are prevalent,

segments.speaker: DILG Secretary Juanito Victor C. Remulla
segments.text: and if we catch them, it will be non-bailable.

segments.speaker: DILG Secretary Juanito Victor C. Remulla
segments.text: So we will need more room in our jails.

segments.speaker: DILG Secretary Juanito Victor C. Remulla
segments.text: Pag na-repeal yun, mapupuno natin yung BJMP.

segments.speaker: DILG Secretary Juanito Victor C. Remulla
DILG Secretary Juanito Victor C. Remulla
segments.text: if you're at 200 capacity, baka mag-300% capacity tayo, sir.

segments.speaker: Rep. Rolando M. Valeriano
segments.text: As a matter of fact, Mr. Secretary, Mr. Chair,

segments.speaker: Rep. Rolando M. Valeriano
segments.text: Natapos na dito sa Congress yung batas natin,

segments.speaker: Rep. Rolando M. Valeriano
segments.text: Then extend natin yung ng one year in PNP.

segments.speaker: DILG Secretary Juanito Victor C. Remulla
Rep. Rolando M. Valeriano
segments.text: Kasunod na rin yung sa Bureau of Fire, tsaka yung sa BJMP.

segments.speaker: DILG Secretary Juanito Victor C. Remulla
DILG Secretary Juanito Victor C. Remulla
DILG Secretary Juanito Victor C. Remulla
DILG Secretary Juanito Victor C. Remulla
segments.text: sir, I would extend it to 60.

segments.speaker: DILG Secretary Juanito Victor C. Remulla
DILG Secretary Juanito Victor C. Remulla
segments.text: When the law was enacted in 1992,

segments.speaker: DILG Secretary Juanito Victor C. Remulla
DILG Secretary Juanito Victor C. Remulla
DILG Secretary Juanito Victor C. Remulla
segments.text: the average life expectancy age of a Filipino then was 64 years old.

segments.speaker: DILG Secretary Juanito Victor C. Remulla
DILG Secretary Juanito Victor C. Remulla
segments.text: Today, sir, our life expectancy for the Filipino is 70.5 years old.

segments.speaker: DILG Secretary Juanito Victor C. Remulla
DILG Secretary Juanito Victor C. Remulla
DILG Secretary Juanito Victor C. Remulla
DILG Secretary Juanito Victor C. Remulla
segments.text: And the knowledge that they have accumulated through the years are invaluable.

segments.speaker: DILG Secretary Juanito Victor C. Remulla
DILG Secretary Juanito Victor C. Remulla
segments.text: but hopefully over the years we can increase the retirement age

segments.speaker: DILG Secretary Juanito Victor C. Remulla
segments.text: because the experience that they gain is much too valuable just to let them retire.

segments.speaker: Rep. Rolando M. Valeriano
segments.text: Pero Mr. Secretary, Secretary, during the hearing,

segments.speaker: Rep. Rolando M. Valeriano
segments.text: kasi ako chairman ng public order noon,

segments.speaker: Rep. Rolando M. Valeriano
segments.text: kinuha namin ang inputs ng PNP.

segments.speaker: Rep. Rolando M. Valeriano
segments.text: And according to them, as a matter of fact, gusto namin 60.

segments.speaker: Rep. Rolando M. Valeriano
segments.text: Pero sabi lang kasi ng PNP hierarchy,

segments.speaker: Rep. Rolando M. Valeriano
segments.text: So pagdating ng 60, medyo exhausted na sila.

segments.speaker: Rep. Rolando M. Valeriano
segments.text: Ang sabi ko nga, nakikita ko pa,

segments.speaker: Rep. Rolando M. Valeriano
segments.text: yung ibang PNP nga nakakatakbo pa,

segments.speaker: Rep. Rolando M. Valeriano
segments.text: Kaya sila rin, idea rin nila na maging 57 lang.

segments.speaker: Rep. Rolando M. Valeriano
segments.text: kasi parang sinama nila yung training nila bago sila pumasok sa sa serbisyo.

segments.speaker: DILG Secretary Juanito Victor C. Remulla
segments.text: Sir, ang 57 is still prime productivity for a policeman.

segments.speaker: DILG Secretary Juanito Victor C. Remulla
DILG Secretary Juanito Victor C. Remulla
DILG Secretary Juanito Victor C. Remulla
DILG Secretary Juanito Victor C. Remulla
segments.text: Si Congressman Richard is only 37 years old.

segments.speaker: DILG Secretary Juanito Victor C. Remulla
DILG Secretary Juanito Victor C. Remulla
segments.text: and a lot of us here are past 57 years old

segments.speaker: DILG Secretary Juanito Victor C. Remulla
DILG Secretary Juanito Victor C. Remulla
segments.text: And our wealth of knowledge is incalculable into making the department run better.

segments.speaker: Rep. Rolando M. Valeriano
segments.text: Sa mga tanong pa, wala naman akong masyadong tanong

segments.speaker: Rep. Rolando M. Valeriano
segments.text: I-move ko lang sana na ibang mga natanggal na budget nila,

segments.speaker: Rep. Rolando M. Valeriano
segments.text: Kasi nakikita ko minsan pag may sunog, parang 5 is to 1,

segments.speaker: Rep. Rolando M. Valeriano
segments.text: hindi ko naman masisi dahil ang tingin ko nga, kakulangan din ng budgetary.

segments.speaker: Rep. Rolando M. Valeriano
segments.text: So kung may magagawa po kami rito sa Kongreso,

segments.speaker: Rep. Rolando M. Valeriano
segments.text: tutal, naghihimay-himay pa tayo ng budget,

segments.speaker: Rep. Rolando M. Valeriano
segments.text: malagyan natin ng kaukulang budget tong

segments.speaker: Rep. Rolando M. Valeriano
segments.text: PNP, Bureau of Fire, and the rest of your family.

segments.speaker: DILG Secretary Juanito Victor C. Remulla
Rep. Arnie B. Fuentebella
segments.text: In addition lang po regarding the fire trucks,

segments.speaker: Rep. Arnie B. Fuentebella
segments.text: kung ang DBM lang po ay ibigay kahit 72% ng collection po nila in one year,

segments.speaker: Rep. Arnie B. Fuentebella
segments.text: yung 100 fire trucks natin and even 40 plus fire stations in one year,

segments.speaker: Rep. Arnie B. Fuentebella
segments.text: Siguro, there's a need to pressure the DBM para lumabas yung...

segments.speaker: DILG Secretary Juanito Victor C. Remulla
Rep. Arnie B. Fuentebella
segments.text: We're asking for 72%, so we will support Secretary Remulla.

segments.speaker: Rep. Arnie B. Fuentebella
segments.text: Since malinis naman po ang BFP.

segments.speaker: Rep. Arnie B. Fuentebella
segments.text: But, Secretary, may I suggest also that not only Korea, let's venture out Japan.

segments.speaker: Rep. Arnie B. Fuentebella
segments.text: Kasi yung mga Isuzu parang 40 years.

segments.speaker: DILG Secretary Juanito Victor C. Remulla
DILG Secretary Juanito Victor C. Remulla
DILG Secretary Juanito Victor C. Remulla
segments.text: So, I think Korea is the best option for us right now.

segments.speaker: DILG Secretary Juanito Victor C. Remulla
Rep. Arnie B. Fuentebella
segments.text: I believe in your wisdom and leadership, Senior Brod.

segments.speaker: Rep. Arnie B. Fuentebella
segments.text: So, before I go to the next interpellator, I would like to recognize Representative Julius Vergara,

segments.speaker: Rep. Arnie B. Fuentebella
segments.text: Deputy Majority Leader Alyssa Mica Gonzales,

segments.speaker: Rep. Arnie B. Fuentebella
segments.text: For the next representative from the minority, may I recognize Representative Percival Cendaña.

segments.speaker: Rep. Percival "Perci" Cendaña
segments.text: Magandang umaga po, Mr. Secretary at sa buong DILG family.

segments.speaker: Rep. Percival "Perci" Cendaña
segments.text: Sige po, simulan natin yung unang round with a question on the burning issue.

segments.speaker: Rep. Percival "Perci" Cendaña
segments.text: yung usapin po ng slots for sale sa BFP.

segments.speaker: Rep. Percival "Perci" Cendaña
segments.text: At ito po, recently may nakita tayo, may nahuli na hiring official.

segments.speaker: Rep. Percival "Perci" Cendaña
segments.text: Ano po ang nangyayari sa BFP dito sa slots for sale?

segments.speaker: Rep. Percival "Perci" Cendaña
segments.text: At ano pong ginagawa natin para tugunan nito?

segments.speaker: DILG Secretary Juanito Victor C. Remulla
segments.text: Number one, sir, the case is officially solved.

segments.speaker: DILG Secretary Juanito Victor C. Remulla
segments.text: Yung slots for sale na isang nahuli natin.

segments.speaker: DILG Secretary Juanito Victor C. Remulla
segments.text: Right now, I will defer to the BFP chief to explain our new hiring procedures and how we make it almost impossible to have the slots for sale.

segments.speaker: DILG Secretary Juanito Victor C. Remulla
DILG Secretary Juanito Victor C. Remulla
segments.text: the slots for sale ranged from 200,000 to 800,000 per slot.

segments.speaker: DILG Secretary Juanito Victor C. Remulla
segments.text: But for one slot, with our new system, which I will defer to the BFP chief to explain,

segments.speaker: DILG Secretary Juanito Victor C. Remulla
segments.text: we will make it almost impossible for that so that the slots will be for sale.

segments.speaker: DILG Secretary Juanito Victor C. Remulla
BFP Officer-in-Charge Fire Chief Superintendent Wilberto Rico Neil A. Kwan Tiu
BFP Officer-in-Charge Fire Chief Superintendent Wilberto Rico Neil A. Kwan Tiu
segments.text: Thank you very much, Mr. Chair, and Your Honors, and to our good Secretary.

segments.speaker: BFP Officer-in-Charge Fire Chief Superintendent Wilberto Rico Neil A. Kwan Tiu
segments.text: To cut the story short, Mr. Chair,

segments.speaker: BFP Officer-in-Charge Fire Chief Superintendent Wilberto Rico Neil A. Kwan Tiu
segments.text: the Oplansang Tindig of the BFP, a mechanism that prevents and arrests persons who are into corruptions,

segments.speaker: BFP Officer-in-Charge Fire Chief Superintendent Wilberto Rico Neil A. Kwan Tiu
segments.text: not only outside but also the inside personnel of the BFP.

segments.speaker: BFP Officer-in-Charge Fire Chief Superintendent Wilberto Rico Neil A. Kwan Tiu
segments.text: It's working, and that is why just recently, nahuli po natin yung isang SFO1 na nag-engage into anomalies.

segments.speaker: BFP Officer-in-Charge Fire Chief Superintendent Wilberto Rico Neil A. Kwan Tiu
BFP Officer-in-Charge Fire Chief Superintendent Wilberto Rico Neil A. Kwan Tiu
segments.text: matagal na pong naging kuwento ng BFP ang slot for sale.

segments.speaker: BFP Officer-in-Charge Fire Chief Superintendent Wilberto Rico Neil A. Kwan Tiu
segments.text: Gumawa po tayo ng bagong makinarya, and we called it the e-hiring that somehow prevents this kind of people doing anomalies during recruitment.

segments.speaker: BFP Officer-in-Charge Fire Chief Superintendent Wilberto Rico Neil A. Kwan Tiu
segments.text: And so far, wala po tayong narinig on the first part of recruitment because it's system-generated.

segments.speaker: BFP Officer-in-Charge Fire Chief Superintendent Wilberto Rico Neil A. Kwan Tiu
segments.text: It's online application at the doorstep of their home,

segments.speaker: BFP Officer-in-Charge Fire Chief Superintendent Wilberto Rico Neil A. Kwan Tiu
segments.text: pwede na po silang mag-apply sa BFP,

segments.speaker: BFP Officer-in-Charge Fire Chief Superintendent Wilberto Rico Neil A. Kwan Tiu
BFP Officer-in-Charge Fire Chief Superintendent Wilberto Rico Neil A. Kwan Tiu
BFP Officer-in-Charge Fire Chief Superintendent Wilberto Rico Neil A. Kwan Tiu
BFP Officer-in-Charge Fire Chief Superintendent Wilberto Rico Neil A. Kwan Tiu
BFP Officer-in-Charge Fire Chief Superintendent Wilberto Rico Neil A. Kwan Tiu
BFP Officer-in-Charge Fire Chief Superintendent Wilberto Rico Neil A. Kwan Tiu
segments.text: However, as I said, hindi 100% na nagagawa namin kasi human na po itong pagdating sa dulo.

segments.speaker: BFP Officer-in-Charge Fire Chief Superintendent Wilberto Rico Neil A. Kwan Tiu
segments.text: So ang ginawa po nung isang bumbero na ito ay tiningnan niya sino po yung umabot na sa stage na kung saan matatapos na po yung recruitment phase sa kanya.

segments.speaker: BFP Officer-in-Charge Fire Chief Superintendent Wilberto Rico Neil A. Kwan Tiu
segments.text: So randomly, tiningnan niya sa Facebook at nung may nakita siyang may sumagot sa kanya, nag-offer po siya ng tulong.

segments.speaker: BFP Officer-in-Charge Fire Chief Superintendent Wilberto Rico Neil A. Kwan Tiu
BFP Officer-in-Charge Fire Chief Superintendent Wilberto Rico Neil A. Kwan Tiu
segments.text: na naman na ginagawa ng mga kasamahan po namin.

segments.speaker: BFP Officer-in-Charge Fire Chief Superintendent Wilberto Rico Neil A. Kwan Tiu
segments.text: Just very unfortunate na kasamahan nga po namin.

segments.speaker: BFP Officer-in-Charge Fire Chief Superintendent Wilberto Rico Neil A. Kwan Tiu
segments.text: The entire men and women of BFP felt sad on what transpired just recently. Kasi nga po lahat kami ang direksyon ay gusto na pong pag-uwi.

segments.speaker: BFP Officer-in-Charge Fire Chief Superintendent Wilberto Rico Neil A. Kwan Tiu
BFP Officer-in-Charge Fire Chief Superintendent Wilberto Rico Neil A. Kwan Tiu
segments.text: As I said, epektibo po yung mekanismo ng Oplansang Tindig.

segments.speaker: BFP Officer-in-Charge Fire Chief Superintendent Wilberto Rico Neil A. Kwan Tiu
segments.text: And I commend the bravery and courage of that applicant para ho isumbong niya dahil naniniwala siya na nagbabago na ho ang pananaw ng BFP, Mr. Chair.

segments.speaker: Rep. Percival "Perci" Cendaña
segments.text: so sana simula pa lamang ito

segments.speaker: Rep. Percival "Perci" Cendaña
segments.text: at mas maging matindi sana yung pagbabantay natin kasi nakalulungkot po na may galawang sindikato sa loob ng BFP pagdating po dito sa slots for sale.

segments.speaker: Rep. Percival "Perci" Cendaña
segments.text: Let me move on to a more pressing issue.

segments.speaker: Rep. Percival "Perci" Cendaña
segments.text: Sa ngayon po, nagluluksa ang buong bansa dito sa sunod-sunod na karahasan sa ating mga eskwelahan.

segments.speaker: Rep. Percival "Perci" Cendaña
segments.text: Hindi lamang po ito red flag, kundi isa na pong red alert ang nababalitaan natin na school violence.

segments.speaker: Rep. Percival "Perci" Cendaña
segments.text: Last week lang yung school shooting sa Zamboanga,

segments.speaker: Rep. Percival "Perci" Cendaña
segments.text: tapos sa Tacloban, two months ago.

segments.speaker: Rep. Percival "Perci" Cendaña
segments.text: Pero hindi po ito yung buong kuwento.

segments.speaker: Rep. Percival "Perci" Cendaña
segments.text: Recently yung PNP nagsabi that they recorded at least 50 incidents in schools involving children in conflict with the law from June 16 to August 19.

segments.speaker: Rep. Percival "Perci" Cendaña
segments.text: So ang range po niyan ay bomb threats, alleged shooting threats, stabbing incidents, illegal possession of firearms, death threats.

segments.speaker: Rep. Percival "Perci" Cendaña
segments.text: Dito po sa nakaraang Senate hearing chaired by our colleague, Sen. Risa Hontiveros,

segments.speaker: Rep. Percival "Perci" Cendaña
segments.text: the PNP sa Anti-Cybercrime Group said that they had handled 74 cases linked to nihilistic violent extremism,

segments.speaker: Rep. Percival "Perci" Cendaña
segments.text: at they rescued 42 minors in connection with these cases.

segments.speaker: Rep. Percival "Perci" Cendaña
segments.text: Nagbago po ba ang strategy ng DILG at PNP after the recent events?

segments.speaker: Rep. Percival "Perci" Cendaña
segments.text: At ano po yung mga efforts to closely monitor and apprehend nihilistic violent extremism online?

segments.speaker: DILG Secretary Juanito Victor C. Remulla
segments.text: Sir, there are two parts to that.

segments.speaker: DILG Secretary Juanito Victor C. Remulla
DILG Secretary Juanito Victor C. Remulla
segments.text: of how we deal with the children in conflict with the law

segments.speaker: DILG Secretary Juanito Victor C. Remulla
DILG Secretary Juanito Victor C. Remulla
segments.text: Again, the PNP is present in all schools in the country during entry and dismissal.

segments.speaker: DILG Secretary Juanito Victor C. Remulla
DILG Secretary Juanito Victor C. Remulla
segments.text: Number two, again, as I repeat, we have barangay tanods who will inspect the bags and identify the children who enter the school.

segments.speaker: DILG Secretary Juanito Victor C. Remulla
DILG Secretary Juanito Victor C. Remulla
segments.text: what happens in their homes that influence them

segments.speaker: DILG Secretary Juanito Victor C. Remulla
DILG Secretary Juanito Victor C. Remulla
segments.text: I urge the country, all of us, the government as a whole,

segments.speaker: DILG Secretary Juanito Victor C. Remulla
segments.text: to act on these nihilistic sites

segments.speaker: DILG Secretary Juanito Victor C. Remulla
segments.text: and have them cancelled as soon as possible.

segments.speaker: DILG Secretary Juanito Victor C. Remulla
DILG Secretary Juanito Victor C. Remulla
segments.text: Australia is very successful in handling the use of

segments.speaker: DILG Secretary Juanito Victor C. Remulla
DILG Secretary Juanito Victor C. Remulla
segments.text: China is very good at handling that. It is not

segments.speaker: DILG Secretary Juanito Victor C. Remulla
DILG Secretary Juanito Victor C. Remulla
segments.text: it is a filtering out of dangerous

segments.speaker: DILG Secretary Juanito Victor C. Remulla
segments.text: sites so that children will not get influenced.

segments.speaker: DILG Secretary Juanito Victor C. Remulla
segments.text: You will be surprised at the depravity of these websites.

segments.speaker: DILG Secretary Juanito Victor C. Remulla
segments.text: They espouse everything from satanism to nihilism

segments.speaker: DILG Secretary Juanito Victor C. Remulla
DILG Secretary Juanito Victor C. Remulla
segments.text: and they encourage the children to act on this.

segments.speaker: DILG Secretary Juanito Victor C. Remulla
DILG Secretary Juanito Victor C. Remulla
segments.text: something that the DICT, the DILG

segments.speaker: DILG Secretary Juanito Victor C. Remulla
segments.text: and all other governments and even Congress

segments.speaker: DILG Secretary Juanito Victor C. Remulla
segments.text: can act upon so that these sites can be banned.

segments.speaker: Rep. Percival "Perci" Cendaña
segments.text: Thank you very much, Mr. Chair, Mr. Secretary.

segments.speaker: Rep. Percival "Perci" Cendaña
segments.text: Para lang po sa NYC, ano po ang ginagawa natin

segments.speaker: Rep. Percival "Perci" Cendaña
segments.text: para po mailayo yung mga kabataan natin sa mga nihilistic violent extremism?

segments.speaker: NYC Chairperson and CEO Joseph Francisco R. Ortega
segments.text: Mr. Chair, currently ang NYC po ay nag-a-allocate ng pondo

segments.speaker: NYC Chairperson and CEO Joseph Francisco R. Ortega
segments.text: para sa Mental Health Youth Hub.

segments.speaker: NYC Chairperson and CEO Joseph Francisco R. Ortega
segments.text: Ito po ay ang pagpapadala ng

segments.speaker: NYC Chairperson and CEO Joseph Francisco R. Ortega
NYC Chairperson and CEO Joseph Francisco R. Ortega
NYC Chairperson and CEO Joseph Francisco R. Ortega
segments.text: sa mga areas gaya ng Zamboanga.

segments.speaker: NYC Chairperson and CEO Joseph Francisco R. Ortega
segments.text: So nung nangyari po yung Zamboanga incident,

segments.speaker: NYC Chairperson and CEO Joseph Francisco R. Ortega
NYC Chairperson and CEO Joseph Francisco R. Ortega
segments.text: and minobilize po namin yung mga facilitators namin.

segments.speaker: NYC Chairperson and CEO Joseph Francisco R. Ortega
segments.text: Nung recent Senate Committee hearing po,

segments.speaker: NYC Chairperson and CEO Joseph Francisco R. Ortega
segments.text: it was recognized that there is a lack of guidance counselors.

segments.speaker: NYC Chairperson and CEO Joseph Francisco R. Ortega
NYC Chairperson and CEO Joseph Francisco R. Ortega
segments.text: meron po silang programa na Tara-Usap,

segments.speaker: NYC Chairperson and CEO Joseph Francisco R. Ortega
segments.text: and may cash for work po iyan

segments.speaker: NYC Chairperson and CEO Joseph Francisco R. Ortega
segments.text: para sa mga volunteers na tutulong sa mental health peer support.

segments.speaker: Rep. Percival "Perci" Cendaña
segments.text: Mr. Chair, hindi po. I think it's not an accident. It's by design na magkasama sa DILG family ang PNP at ang NYC.

segments.speaker: Rep. Percival "Perci" Cendaña
segments.text: Nasusundan po ba natin kung nasaan yung incidents, nung mga nabanggit ko kanina ng report ng PNP?

segments.speaker: Rep. Percival "Perci" Cendaña
segments.text: At ano po ang ginagawa natin? Halimbawa po, if you have this caravan, kapag may report na ganito sa isang area,

segments.speaker: Rep. Percival "Perci" Cendaña
segments.text: nasusundan po ba natin at natatapatan natin ng immediate response, Mr. Chair?

segments.speaker: NYC Chairperson and CEO Joseph Francisco R. Ortega
segments.text: Yes, Mr. Chair, naglabas po kami ng mga statements sa mga nangyari.

segments.speaker: NYC Chairperson and CEO Joseph Francisco R. Ortega
segments.text: And limited po ang NYC sa pagpapadala ng support.

segments.speaker: NYC Chairperson and CEO Joseph Francisco R. Ortega
segments.text: So ang pinakamabilis na magagawa lang po namin is magpadala ng mga facilitators.

segments.speaker: NYC Chairperson and CEO Joseph Francisco R. Ortega
segments.text: And siguro I'll take this chance na rin po. Nag-propose po kami ng anti-bullying summit for next year na in-approve naman po ng DBM.

segments.speaker: NYC Chairperson and CEO Joseph Francisco R. Ortega
segments.text: So we hope to work with you, Mr. Chair, para gawin yung programa nito for next year. Salamat po.

segments.speaker: Rep. Percival "Perci" Cendaña
segments.text: Kasi po halimbawa dito sa report ng PNP,

segments.speaker: Rep. Percival "Perci" Cendaña
segments.text: merong 12 alleged shooting threats, 4 stabbing incidents,

segments.speaker: Rep. Percival "Perci" Cendaña
segments.text: 4 arrests for illegal possession of firearms, at dalawang death threats.

segments.speaker: Rep. Percival "Perci" Cendaña
segments.text: Kung ma-map po natin kung nasaan ito, baka dapat dito rin yung tutok nung ating intervention when it comes to mental health services.

segments.speaker: NYC Chairperson and CEO Joseph Francisco R. Ortega
segments.text: Mr. Chair, I would like to add as well that nag-partner po kami with META.

segments.speaker: NYC Chairperson and CEO Joseph Francisco R. Ortega
segments.text: And currently ongoing po yung META camps namin.

segments.speaker: NYC Chairperson and CEO Joseph Francisco R. Ortega
segments.text: Tinuturuan po namin per province and select sites how to use the tools of META

segments.speaker: NYC Chairperson and CEO Joseph Francisco R. Ortega
segments.text: kasi currently po marami po daw nagre-report sa META ng mga bullying, so ginawan po kami ng

segments.speaker: NYC Chairperson and CEO Joseph Francisco R. Ortega
segments.text: direct line ng META na kung may magre-report po sa NYC, puwede po namin silang direct na tawagan.

segments.speaker: NYC Chairperson and CEO Joseph Francisco R. Ortega
segments.text: So iyon po yung ginagawa namin, Mr. Chair.

segments.speaker: NYC Chairperson and CEO Joseph Francisco R. Ortega
Rep. Percival "Perci" Cendaña
segments.text: I agree with the good Secretary.

segments.speaker: Rep. Percival "Perci" Cendaña
segments.text: Malaki po yung papel din ng ating mga tahanan,

segments.speaker: Rep. Percival "Perci" Cendaña
segments.text: kaya nga hindi lamang whole-of-government approach ang kailangan natin dito sa pagtugon sa karahasan sa ating mga eskwelahan,

segments.speaker: Rep. Percival "Perci" Cendaña
segments.text: And let me move on to an equally important issue.

segments.speaker: Rep. Percival "Perci" Cendaña
segments.text: Yung issue po ng ating mga mas bata kesa sa mga kabataang pinag-uusapan natin kanina.

segments.speaker: Rep. Percival "Perci" Cendaña
segments.text: Sabi po ng EDCOM sa kanilang Early Childhood Dashboard, aabot sa 4,600 na barangay ang walang Child Development Center sa ating bansa.

segments.speaker: Rep. Percival "Perci" Cendaña
segments.text: baka mas familiar po ang ating mga kababayan sa tawag na daycare centers.

segments.speaker: Rep. Percival "Perci" Cendaña
segments.text: Ulitin ko po, 4,600 na barangay ang walang daycare centers.

segments.speaker: Rep. Percival "Perci" Cendaña
segments.text: Ngayon ba lang po pinirmahan ang IRR ng Early Child Care and Development System Act?

segments.speaker: Rep. Percival "Perci" Cendaña
segments.text: Sa tingin po ba natin sa DILG ay matutugunan na ang kakulangan?

segments.speaker: Rep. Percival "Perci" Cendaña
segments.text: Sorry, matutugunan na ba ang kakulangan sa daycare centers because of this new law?

segments.speaker: DILG Secretary Juanito Victor C. Remulla
segments.text: Sir, the daycare centers are allotted in the budget of the barangay.

segments.speaker: DILG Secretary Juanito Victor C. Remulla
segments.text: It should be part of the barangay budget.

segments.speaker: DILG Secretary Juanito Victor C. Remulla
segments.text: If you look at the DILG budget, sir, 96% is either for MOOE or salaries.

segments.speaker: DILG Secretary Juanito Victor C. Remulla
segments.text: So in terms of this, sir, for additional daycare centers, it is not

segments.speaker: DILG Secretary Juanito Victor C. Remulla
segments.text: the DILG's budget that is involved,

segments.speaker: DILG Secretary Juanito Victor C. Remulla
segments.text: but rather the DPWH, the province, and the other local government units that are involved.

segments.speaker: Rep. Percival "Perci" Cendaña
segments.text: And I can imagine, mahalaga po ang magiging papel ng ECCDC para i-facilitate po ito.

segments.speaker: Rep. Percival "Perci" Cendaña
segments.text: Pero napansin ko po, isa yung ECCDC sa mayroong budget cuts this year.

segments.speaker: DILG Secretary Juanito Victor C. Remulla
segments.text: Sir, there are 124 million ang budget.

segments.speaker: DILG Secretary Juanito Victor C. Remulla
segments.text: A lot of this will go, sir, to the feeding program and capacity building for the children, sir.

segments.speaker: Rep. Percival "Perci" Cendaña
segments.text: Sige po. Baka mahalaga po na magkaroon ng convergence to be able to facilitate yung gap na ito between the DILG and the other concerned agencies.

segments.speaker: DILG Secretary Juanito Victor C. Remulla
segments.text: You're very cognizant of it, sir.

segments.speaker: Rep. Percival "Perci" Cendaña
segments.text: Thank you very much, Mr. Secretary.

segments.speaker: Rep. Percival "Perci" Cendaña
segments.text: Punta naman po ako doon sa usapin ng HIV, particularly among young people.

segments.speaker: Rep. Percival "Perci" Cendaña
segments.text: Pasensya na po, medyo malapit talaga sa puso ko ito.

segments.speaker: Rep. Percival "Perci" Cendaña
segments.text: This was my area of work when I was working in the NYC.

segments.speaker: Rep. Percival "Perci" Cendaña
segments.text: At nabalitaan po natin, ang NYC mayroong ginawang training program to capacitate the SK

segments.speaker: Rep. Percival "Perci" Cendaña
segments.text: pagdating sa HIV-AIDS programming and budgeting in partnership with our friends from UNAIDS and HASH.

segments.speaker: Rep. Percival "Perci" Cendaña
segments.text: Sa anong regions or provinces po natin na-implement yung programa?

segments.speaker: NYC Chairperson and CEO Joseph Francisco R. Ortega
segments.text: Mr. Chair, nag-pilot po tayo dito sa Metro Manila.

segments.speaker: NYC Chairperson and CEO Joseph Francisco R. Ortega
NYC Chairperson and CEO Joseph Francisco R. Ortega
segments.text: Mr. Chair, is yung participation natin sa Love, Laban Pride Parade.

segments.speaker: NYC Chairperson and CEO Joseph Francisco R. Ortega
segments.text: And this was the first time na nag-attend po ang National Youth Commission actually in 2025.

segments.speaker: NYC Chairperson and CEO Joseph Francisco R. Ortega
segments.text: And ito pong 2026, ito po ang pinakamalaking contribution ng gobyerno through the National Youth Commission sa ating LGBTQ Pride Parade.

segments.speaker: NYC Chairperson and CEO Joseph Francisco R. Ortega
segments.text: Nagkaroon po tayo ng almost half a million, Mr. Chair, attendees and a lot of them actually went to the booths na meron po tayong HIV tests.

segments.speaker: NYC Chairperson and CEO Joseph Francisco R. Ortega
segments.text: So kailangan lang po namin, Mr. Chair, kunin yung mga numero

segments.speaker: NYC Chairperson and CEO Joseph Francisco R. Ortega
segments.text: kung ilan talaga nagpa-test, then we can give it to you, Mr. Chair.

segments.speaker: Rep. Percival "Perci" Cendaña
segments.text: So sa NYC, halos Quezon City lang po yung Love Laban ito na pilot, tama po ba?

segments.speaker: NYC Chairperson and CEO Joseph Francisco R. Ortega
segments.text: Mr. Chair, actually ang Love Laban po nangyari po iyan in multiple locations at different times to celebrate the pride.

segments.speaker: NYC Chairperson and CEO Joseph Francisco R. Ortega
segments.text: So ang count po sa Quezon City is around 300,000.

segments.speaker: NYC Chairperson and CEO Joseph Francisco R. Ortega
segments.text: National po in different parts of the Philippines was 500,000.

segments.speaker: Rep. Percival "Perci" Cendaña
segments.text: So ano po ang plano natin to be able to replicate this in other areas around the country?

segments.speaker: NYC Chairperson and CEO Joseph Francisco R. Ortega
segments.text: Mr. Chair, sa sobrang maganda na effect na binigay nito sa ating kabataan,

segments.speaker: NYC Chairperson and CEO Joseph Francisco R. Ortega
segments.text: nag-commit po ang NYC for a Visayas and Mindanao leg for the Pride Parade.

segments.speaker: NYC Chairperson and CEO Joseph Francisco R. Ortega
segments.text: However, wala pa po siya sa NEP namin. Meron lang po kaming 5 million for Manila.

segments.speaker: NYC Chairperson and CEO Joseph Francisco R. Ortega
segments.text: But we are requesting sana po para magkaroon tayo ng Visayas at Mindanao leg, an additional 5 million per island-wide po.

segments.speaker: NYC Chairperson and CEO Joseph Francisco R. Ortega
segments.text: Total po is 15 million, Mr. Chair.

segments.speaker: NYC Chairperson and CEO Joseph Francisco R. Ortega
segments.text: Pero given the nature na binigyan po kami ng 8 million, we are requesting for additional 12 million po.

segments.speaker: NYC Chairperson and CEO Joseph Francisco R. Ortega
segments.text: Para kasama na po dito yung kababaihan, kasama na rin po dito yung adolescent sexual reproductive health.

segments.speaker: Rep. Percival "Perci" Cendaña
segments.text: I cannot overemphasize how important yung intervention among young key population, YKP kung tawagin natin, sa HIV-AIDS programming ng bansa.

segments.speaker: Rep. Percival "Perci" Cendaña
segments.text: And I think the most capable agency to do that would be the NYC in partnership with our SK.

segments.speaker: Rep. Percival "Perci" Cendaña
segments.text: At dahil din po sa fiscal autonomy ng SK, talagang malaki ang puwedeng gawin at the community level ng ating mga youth leaders.

segments.speaker: Rep. Percival "Perci" Cendaña
segments.text: Para tiyakin na ikakalat natin ang impormasyon, tamang impormasyon for responsible behavior.

segments.speaker: Rep. Percival "Perci" Cendaña
segments.text: at maging accessible ang mga services tulad ng testing at iba pa.

segments.speaker: Rep. Percival "Perci" Cendaña
segments.text: At kasama po dito, yung pagbawas ng stigma and discrimination pagdating sa HIV and AIDS.

segments.speaker: Rep. Percival "Perci" Cendaña
segments.text: Alam natin kung gaano kahalaga ang ating mga barangay health workers,

segments.speaker: Rep. Percival "Perci" Cendaña
segments.text: speaking of frontliners at the community level,

segments.speaker: Rep. Percival "Perci" Cendaña
segments.text: pero sana mas alam po natin ang pinagdadaanan nila.

segments.speaker: Rep. Percival "Perci" Cendaña
segments.text: Hindi ko na po ulitin iyan.

segments.speaker: Rep. Percival "Perci" Cendaña
segments.text: Walang sahod, sa bulsang kinukuha ang pamasahe ng pasyente, et cetera.

segments.speaker: Rep. Percival "Perci" Cendaña
segments.text: May plano po ba ang DILG

segments.speaker: Rep. Percival "Perci" Cendaña
segments.text: na suportahan ang transportation costs ng ating mga BHW at i-cover ang gamot ng kanilang mga pasyente?

segments.speaker: DILG Secretary Juanito Victor C. Remulla
segments.text: Again, sir, the DILG is supervisory over the LGUs who handle the BHWs.

segments.speaker: DILG Secretary Juanito Victor C. Remulla
segments.text: As of current, sir, the BHWs are listed down by the barangay captains, passed on to the municipalities,

segments.speaker: DILG Secretary Juanito Victor C. Remulla
segments.text: and then given allowance by the governors and the other LCEs.

segments.speaker: DILG Secretary Juanito Victor C. Remulla
segments.text: So as far as that is concerned, it is not in our budget but we have supervisory authority over it.

segments.speaker: Rep. Arnie B. Fuentebella
segments.text: Can we let Kong Perci finish his interpellation?

segments.speaker: Rep. Percival "Perci" Cendaña
segments.text: Napakahalaga po kasi ng papel ng ating mga BHWs and I'm sure that as former governor, you really appreciate that.

segments.speaker: Rep. Percival "Perci" Cendaña
segments.text: And we would appreciate interventions from the DILG to be able to facilitate this when it comes to the implementation at the LGU level.

segments.speaker: Rep. Percival "Perci" Cendaña
segments.text: So, baka po, a set of guidelines, a set of recommendations to the LGU will be very helpful in this area, Mr. Secretary.

segments.speaker: DILG Secretary Juanito Victor C. Remulla
DILG Secretary Juanito Victor C. Remulla
Rep. Percival "Perci" Cendaña
segments.text: Thank you very much, Mr. Chairman. Maraming salamat po.

segments.speaker: Rep. Arnie B. Fuentebella
segments.text: Just to remind everyone, our colleagues, we do not allow any interjection.

segments.speaker: Rep. Arnie B. Fuentebella
segments.text: And this is about our rules.

segments.speaker: Rep. Arnie B. Fuentebella
segments.text: Okay, so, sorry, Congressman Jay Vergara.

segments.speaker: Rep. Arnie B. Fuentebella
segments.text: Next to interpolate, Congressman Bong Teves, you have one minute.

segments.speaker: Rep. Jose "Bong" J. Teves Jr.
segments.text: The DILG family, of course, the number one agency na pinagtitiwalaan ng sambayan ng Pilipino, Philippine National Police, headed by our PNP chief

segments.speaker: Rep. Jose "Bong" J. Teves Jr.
segments.text: kasama ang masipag na komisyoner ng NAPOLCOM, Commissioner Vicente Calinisan,

segments.speaker: Rep. Jose "Bong" J. Teves Jr.
segments.text: and of course, the DOJ Secretary,

segments.speaker: Rep. Jose "Bong" J. Teves Jr.
segments.text: ang ating kumpare, ating matagal nang kaibigan, energetic and handsome Secretary, Secretary Boying Remulla.

segments.speaker: Rep. Jose "Bong" J. Teves Jr.
segments.text: Good morning po sa inyo lahat.

segments.speaker: Rep. Jose "Bong" J. Teves Jr.
segments.text: Mr. Chair, alam naman natin na matagal nang napapabayaan ang Bureau of Fire Protection

segments.speaker: Rep. Jose "Bong" J. Teves Jr.
segments.text: tulad ng sinabi po kanina ng ating kasama, si Congressman Valeriano.

segments.speaker: Rep. Jose "Bong" J. Teves Jr.
segments.text: Ang kanila pong mandato ay bukod sa umapula ng sunog,

segments.speaker: Rep. Jose "Bong" J. Teves Jr.
segments.text: ay mag-responde sa natural at man-made disasters.

segments.speaker: Rep. Jose "Bong" J. Teves Jr.
segments.text: Lagi natin silang nakikita sa kalsada,

segments.speaker: Rep. Jose "Bong" J. Teves Jr.
segments.text: ang budget ng Bureau of Fire

segments.speaker: Rep. Jose "Bong" J. Teves Jr.
segments.text: ang kanilang capital outlay from P1.4 billion for 2026

segments.speaker: Rep. Jose "Bong" J. Teves Jr.
segments.text: to P362 million na lang for year 2027.

segments.speaker: Rep. Jose "Bong" J. Teves Jr.
segments.text: dahil dapat tayo ay nagpre-prepare para ngayon

segments.speaker: Rep. Jose "Bong" J. Teves Jr.
segments.text: sa parating na El Niño sa susunod na taon at iba pang natural disasters.

segments.speaker: Rep. Jose "Bong" J. Teves Jr.
segments.text: Ang PNP ay tumaas ng capital outlay

segments.speaker: Rep. Jose "Bong" J. Teves Jr.
segments.text: dahil ito po ay ating pinagtitiwalaan.

segments.speaker: Rep. Jose "Bong" J. Teves Jr.
segments.text: kailangan po ng Bureau of Fire Protection

segments.speaker: Rep. Jose "Bong" J. Teves Jr.
segments.text: ang Virac at ito naman ay kanyang

segments.speaker: Rep. Jose "Bong" J. Teves Jr.
segments.text: and rescue trucks para sa bawat

segments.speaker: DILG Secretary Juanito Victor C. Remulla
DILG Secretary Juanito Victor C. Remulla
DILG Secretary Juanito Victor C. Remulla
segments.text: of the capital outlay was because we had

segments.speaker: DILG Secretary Juanito Victor C. Remulla
DILG Secretary Juanito Victor C. Remulla
DILG Secretary Juanito Victor C. Remulla
DILG Secretary Juanito Victor C. Remulla
DILG Secretary Juanito Victor C. Remulla
DILG Secretary Juanito Victor C. Remulla
DILG Secretary Juanito Victor C. Remulla
DILG Secretary Juanito Victor C. Remulla
segments.text: now that we have instituted a system,

segments.speaker: DILG Secretary Juanito Victor C. Remulla
segments.text: you will see that in this year,

segments.speaker: DILG Secretary Juanito Victor C. Remulla
DILG Secretary Juanito Victor C. Remulla
DILG Secretary Juanito Victor C. Remulla
DILG Secretary Juanito Victor C. Remulla
DILG Secretary Juanito Victor C. Remulla
segments.text: corruption which used to be endemic before in the department

segments.speaker: DILG Secretary Juanito Victor C. Remulla
DILG Secretary Juanito Victor C. Remulla
DILG Secretary Juanito Victor C. Remulla
DILG Secretary Juanito Victor C. Remulla
DILG Secretary Juanito Victor C. Remulla
DILG Secretary Juanito Victor C. Remulla
segments.text: All of that, sir, we have reformed

segments.speaker: DILG Secretary Juanito Victor C. Remulla
segments.text: and now you can expect a more

segments.speaker: DILG Secretary Juanito Victor C. Remulla
DILG Secretary Juanito Victor C. Remulla
Rep. Jose "Bong" J. Teves Jr.
segments.text: Isa rin sa napunako rito. Tumaas ng halos 16 billion ang budget ng PNP pero bumaba naman ng halos P150M ang panukalang budget ng NAPOLCOM.

segments.speaker: Rep. Jose "Bong" J. Teves Jr.
segments.text: Paano po natin mapapalakas ang ating kapulisan kung babawasan natin ang pondong nakalaan para sa kanilang supervision, discipline at accountability?

segments.speaker: Rep. Jose "Bong" J. Teves Jr.
segments.text: Hindi po ba sapat na nagdagdag lamang ng pondo ng PNP? Kailangan din nating palakasin ang ahensyang tumitiyak na ang ating mga pulis ay propesyonal, disiplinado at mananagot sa batas.

segments.speaker: Rep. Jose "Bong" J. Teves Jr.
segments.text: Kung kinakailangan, i-encourage po natin ang ating mga kasama na mga congressman na dagdagan ang pondo ng DILG,

segments.speaker: Rep. Jose "Bong" J. Teves Jr.
segments.text: bakit hindi nang sa ganoon ang mga importanteng ahensiya na nandito po ngayon under ng DILG ay ating pong masuportahan?

segments.speaker: DILG Secretary Juanito Victor C. Remulla
segments.text: Thank you very much, Chair. I would like to commend the performance of the NAPOLCOM.

segments.speaker: DILG Secretary Juanito Victor C. Remulla
segments.text: When we assumed office in 2024, there was a 15,000 case backlog in the cases in NAPOLCOM.

segments.speaker: DILG Secretary Juanito Victor C. Remulla
segments.text: Some dated up to 2001. So the cases were 25 years old and unacted upon.

segments.speaker: DILG Secretary Juanito Victor C. Remulla
segments.text: Upon the leadership of our VCEO, in a matter of one year, we eliminated all 15,000 cases, disposed of it, rendered judgment on it, and now we have a zero backlog profile in the NAPOLCOM.

segments.speaker: DILG Secretary Juanito Victor C. Remulla
segments.text: So, the reason for the reduction of this, sir,

segments.speaker: DILG Secretary Juanito Victor C. Remulla
segments.text: is what the Chair VCEO requested and what the DBM approved are two different things.

segments.speaker: DILG Secretary Juanito Victor C. Remulla
segments.text: So, if you can accommodate the request of the Vice Chairman for the budget needed, that would be most greatly appreciated.

segments.speaker: Rep. Jose "Bong" J. Teves Jr.
segments.text: Thank you, Mr. Chair. Siguro naman napakinggan natin ang paliwanag ng ating butihing Secretary.

segments.speaker: Rep. Jose "Bong" J. Teves Jr.
segments.text: Siguro pagtulong-tulungan natin dagdagan ang pondo.

segments.speaker: Rep. Jose "Bong" J. Teves Jr.
segments.text: last week, nagkaroon po ng matinding pagbaha sa Metro Manila.

segments.speaker: Rep. Jose "Bong" J. Teves Jr.
segments.text: Halos nakita natin kung paano pumara ang basura sa kanal.

segments.speaker: Rep. Jose "Bong" J. Teves Jr.
segments.text: The DILG is in charge of overseeing the LGU on the implementation of solid waste management under Republic Act 9003.

segments.speaker: Rep. Jose "Bong" J. Teves Jr.
segments.text: Ang katanungan ko po, meron na po ba ngang

segments.speaker: Rep. Jose "Bong" J. Teves Jr.
segments.text: at tulad po ng sinasabi ng ating isang butihing Secretary, Secretary Boying Remulla,

segments.speaker: Rep. Jose "Bong" J. Teves Jr.
segments.text: na merong mga siyudad o bayan na may korupsiyon sa basura.

segments.speaker: Rep. Jose "Bong" J. Teves Jr.
segments.text: Ang akala po ni Congressman Bong Teves ng TGP Party-list ay may kita sa basura.

segments.speaker: Rep. Jose "Bong" J. Teves Jr.
segments.text: Ngayon po, may korupsiyon na pala sa basura.

segments.speaker: DILG Secretary Juanito Victor C. Remulla
DILG Secretary Juanito Victor C. Remulla
segments.text: I think the greater defect lies in the local government code

segments.speaker: DILG Secretary Juanito Victor C. Remulla
segments.text: that we have to redefine. According to the local government code, waste disposal is on the municipal and city level.

segments.speaker: DILG Secretary Juanito Victor C. Remulla
segments.text: So let's say Catanduanes, it is not the governor who is in charge who creates a master plan for

segments.speaker: DILG Secretary Juanito Victor C. Remulla
DILG Secretary Juanito Victor C. Remulla
segments.text: It is a plan of each and every municipality that is not necessarily integrated.

segments.speaker: DILG Secretary Juanito Victor C. Remulla
segments.text: So garbage collection is a scale business.

segments.speaker: DILG Secretary Juanito Victor C. Remulla
segments.text: If a small municipality engages in contracts left by themselves, then the costs become higher and more inefficient.

segments.speaker: DILG Secretary Juanito Victor C. Remulla
segments.text: If we can restudy the local government code to make it a regional program,

segments.speaker: DILG Secretary Juanito Victor C. Remulla
segments.text: a regional approach to solving the garbage problem, then that can be more efficient, sir.

segments.speaker: Rep. Jose "Bong" J. Teves Jr.
segments.text: Siguro ang kailangan din nating i-revisit ang Republic Act 9003.

segments.speaker: DILG Secretary Juanito Victor C. Remulla
Rep. Jose "Bong" J. Teves Jr.
segments.text: And lastly, Mr. Chair, may I know what the stage of the,

segments.speaker: Rep. Jose "Bong" J. Teves Jr.
segments.text: with regards to the hazing accident na nangyari po kay Mark Kenneth Alcedo?

segments.speaker: Rep. Jose "Bong" J. Teves Jr.
segments.text: naimbestigahan ng ating NAPOLCOM through sa CIDG.

segments.speaker: Rep. Jose "Bong" J. Teves Jr.
segments.text: Kasi ang lumalabas po sa aming pag-

segments.speaker: Rep. Jose "Bong" J. Teves Jr.
segments.text: ay isa pong PNP ang leader nito.

segments.speaker: Rep. Jose "Bong" J. Teves Jr.
segments.text: At kayo po mismo, Secretary, ang nagsabi sa akin na pagtulungan natin na ma-resolve ang kasong ito at huwag nang maulit.

segments.speaker: Rep. Jose "Bong" J. Teves Jr.
segments.text: Kaya siguro, nandito po ang ating PNP chief.

segments.speaker: Rep. Jose "Bong" J. Teves Jr.
segments.text: Sana maaksyunan po ninyo ito, lalong-lalo na ang leader pong involved dito ay isang kabaro ninyo, ay colonel ng PNP.

segments.speaker: Rep. Jose "Bong" J. Teves Jr.
segments.text: Thank you very much, Mr. Chair.

segments.speaker: DILG Secretary Juanito Victor C. Remulla
DILG Secretary Juanito Victor C. Remulla
segments.text: This regards to the death of a student in Dasmariñas, Cavite.

segments.speaker: DILG Secretary Juanito Victor C. Remulla
segments.text: We have almost—I think we have resolved the case already.

segments.speaker: DILG Secretary Juanito Victor C. Remulla
segments.text: But the anti-hazing law must be strengthened even more.

segments.speaker: DILG Secretary Juanito Victor C. Remulla
DILG Secretary Juanito Victor C. Remulla
segments.text: as of now, the PNP has been vigilant in their own departments, the PNPA.

segments.speaker: DILG Secretary Juanito Victor C. Remulla
DILG Secretary Juanito Victor C. Remulla
segments.text: in community-based organizations, we have a more difficult time in monitoring that.

segments.speaker: DILG Secretary Juanito Victor C. Remulla
segments.text: I think the best way to do that is to have a community-based ID so that we will know the actors in these certain communities.

segments.speaker: DILG Secretary Juanito Victor C. Remulla
segments.text: But that case has been solved, sir.

segments.speaker: Rep. Jose "Bong" J. Teves Jr.
segments.text: Mr. Chair, this representation manifests its full support of the proposed budget of the Department of Interior and Local Government

segments.speaker: Rep. Jose "Bong" J. Teves Jr.
segments.text: under the productive leadership of Secretary Boying Remulla.

segments.speaker: Rep. Jose "Bong" J. Teves Jr.
segments.text: At tulad ng sinasabi ko po, I encourage my fellow congressmen to support the budget of the DILG as an agency.

segments.speaker: Rep. Arnie B. Fuentebella
segments.text: Next to interpellate, we have Representative Sarah Jane Elago.

segments.speaker: Rep. Sarah Jane I. Elago
segments.text: Thank you, maraming salamat, Mr. Chair.

segments.speaker: Rep. Sarah Jane I. Elago
segments.text: Sa Philippine Commission on Women, may malaking budget cut na P27 million para sa susunod na taon.

segments.speaker: Rep. Sarah Jane I. Elago
segments.text: Maaaring niyo bang maibahagi sa atin kung paano maapektuhan ang inyong napakahalagang mandato at serbisyo pagdating sa napakalaking makakalta sa inyong pondo?

segments.speaker: PCW Chairperson Ermelita V. Valdeavilla
segments.text: Thank you very much for that question

segments.speaker: PCW Chairperson Ermelita V. Valdeavilla
segments.text: and magandang umaga po sa ating lahat.

segments.speaker: PCW Chairperson Ermelita V. Valdeavilla
segments.text: The Philippine Commission on Women has asked for P266,360,000 and it was given only P177,000.

segments.speaker: Rep. Sarah Jane I. Elago
segments.text: Mr. Chair, can we request the PCW Chair to move closer to the microphone?

segments.speaker: Rep. Arnie B. Fuentebella
segments.text: Kindly speak closer to the microphone. We can't really hear you, ma'am. Thank you.

segments.speaker: PCW Chairperson Ermelita V. Valdeavilla
segments.text: The areas of our work which will be affected by the cuts in our budget proposal are basically the areas of regionalization because last year you gave us like P30 million and we are now in the Visayas because of the support that was given by this committee.

segments.speaker: PCW Chairperson Ermelita V. Valdeavilla
segments.text: And we hope that before the end of the administration of the President, we can go to Mindanao.

segments.speaker: PCW Chairperson Ermelita V. Valdeavilla
segments.text: If we can be given another P30 million, but for the rest, we are prepared to live with what we are given.

segments.speaker: PCW Chairperson Ermelita V. Valdeavilla
segments.text: I think that the most important part of our work is to be able to reach the women. We are 51 years now, but this is the only time that we are moving down to the local level.

segments.speaker: Rep. Sarah Jane I. Elago
segments.text: Nag-issue ang PCW ng proper utilization and safeguards para sa GAD. Kumusta ho ang inyong assessment sa ating mga national government agencies

segments.speaker: Rep. Sarah Jane I. Elago
segments.text: and bureaus pagdating sa kanilang GAD compliance? Mahalaga ito, Mr. Chair, dahil at least 5% dapat na gagastos para sa gender and development mandate.

segments.speaker: PCW Chairperson Ermelita V. Valdeavilla
segments.text: Tama po iyan kasi if we have a policy, we have a very strong policy on women, but if we don't have a budget, then that is a joke.

segments.speaker: PCW Chairperson Ermelita V. Valdeavilla
segments.text: So we have strengthened our approach in GAD planning and budgeting with our partnership with the Commission on Human Rights,

segments.speaker: PCW Chairperson Ermelita V. Valdeavilla
segments.text: which is the ombuds machinery of the Philippines for gender equality.

segments.speaker: PCW Chairperson Ermelita V. Valdeavilla
segments.text: And just to show you that we have improved a lot, as of 2025, December, we had 378 government agencies that were registered in our gender mainstreaming system,

segments.speaker: PCW Chairperson Ermelita V. Valdeavilla
segments.text: which means that they are submitting and complying. But as of now, July 2026, we have 488, which is about 77.46% compliance in a period of six months.

segments.speaker: PCW Chairperson Ermelita V. Valdeavilla
segments.text: Because what we did is we reminded the heads of government agencies about their liability, that they can be charged administratively if they do not comply with the provisions of the Magna Carta of Women.

segments.speaker: PCW Chairperson Ermelita V. Valdeavilla
segments.text: So we are pushing hard to get things done. And we are also focusing on assessment of the performance because after one year, they submit their annual report and we assess the performance.

segments.speaker: PCW Chairperson Ermelita V. Valdeavilla
segments.text: And before, we used to focus on how much was allocated,

segments.speaker: PCW Chairperson Ermelita V. Valdeavilla
segments.text: how much was spent. But this year, we are focusing on what has been the good or the benefits that has reached women as a result of the expenditures on the GAD budget.

segments.speaker: PCW Chairperson Ermelita V. Valdeavilla
segments.text: And we are now in the process of assessment. By September, we will be providing awards to those who are complying well.

segments.speaker: Rep. Sarah Jane I. Elago
segments.text: Mr. Chair, mahalaga ang regionalization at pagtitiyak ng GAD compliance ng ating mga NGAs.

segments.speaker: Rep. Sarah Jane I. Elago
segments.text: Kaya dapat ma-restore ang budget ng PCW doon

segments.speaker: Rep. Sarah Jane I. Elago
segments.text: sa 2026 level at kung kaya pa ngang mataasan para magawa nila ang kanilang napakahalagang mandato.

segments.speaker: Rep. Sarah Jane I. Elago
segments.text: Ngayon, pagdating naman sa ECCDC, ito ay nalipat na mula sa DepEd at tungo sa DILG.

segments.speaker: Rep. Sarah Jane I. Elago
segments.text: Ngunit sa paglipat na ito, nakita rin natin iyong napakalaking budget cut para po sa kanilang pondo para sa 2027.

segments.speaker: Rep. Sarah Jane I. Elago
segments.text: Mababawasan ng P232 million para sa taong 2027.

segments.speaker: Rep. Sarah Jane I. Elago
segments.text: What explains this huge budget cut?

segments.speaker: DILG Secretary Juanito Victor C. Remulla
segments.text: Ma'am, we submitted the budget to the DBM and that we thought was adequate.

segments.speaker: DILG Secretary Juanito Victor C. Remulla
segments.text: However, DBM was the one who cut our budget so that is what was presented.

segments.speaker: DILG Secretary Juanito Victor C. Remulla
segments.text: If it could be restored as we asked, then I think we will have a more effective and usable budget, ma'am.

segments.speaker: Rep. Sarah Jane I. Elago
segments.text: Sorry. Mr. Chair, can we hear from the ECCDC

segments.speaker: Rep. Sarah Jane I. Elago
segments.text: how this huge budget cut will affect their services and their mandate for 2027?

segments.speaker: ECCD Council Executive Director Dr. Teresita G. Inciong
segments.text: Mr. Chair, Your Honor, the conversion of this daycare center and child development center will be affected greatly.

segments.speaker: ECCD Council Executive Director Dr. Teresita G. Inciong
segments.text: Because we do not have the FALGU.

segments.speaker: ECCD Council Executive Director Dr. Teresita G. Inciong
segments.text: Actually, funding only covers the rehabilitation and repair of the DCC, not including contents as provided in GAA.

segments.speaker: ECCD Council Executive Director Dr. Teresita G. Inciong
segments.text: Procurement of content for CDC ensures provision of appropriate learning materials, furniture, fixtures, and other essential components for child learning and development.

segments.speaker: ECCD Council Executive Director Dr. Teresita G. Inciong
segments.text: The ECCD Council allotted content [unclear] 360 only from [unclear] under the [unclear].

segments.speaker: Rep. Sarah Jane I. Elago
segments.text: Ibig sabihin ba, Mr. Chair, ilan ho ang bago nating itatayo na CDC for 2027?

segments.speaker: Rep. Sarah Jane I. Elago
segments.text: Ang tingin po kasi dito, Mr. Chair, parang napunta na po lahat sa barangay at sa LGU yung responsibility.

segments.speaker: Rep. Sarah Jane I. Elago
segments.text: Pero yung dati po natin na ninanais na palakasin talaga yung programa natin para sa child care ay hindi na po natin makita sa ating national budget.

segments.speaker: ECCD Council Executive Director Dr. Teresita G. Inciong
segments.text: Your Honor, Mr. Chair, after validation with some provincial social welfare development, we lack all 3,743 centerless barangay.
