segments.speaker: Rep. Sarah Jane I. Elago
segments.text: At ang pondo po niyan, dapat saan po nakalagay?

segments.speaker: ECCD Council Executive Director Dr. Teresita G. Inciong
segments.text: Under the new law, nasa LGU.

segments.speaker: Rep. Sarah Jane I. Elago
segments.text: Nasa LGU. Iyan nga ho, ang malaking problema dito, Mr. Chair.

segments.speaker: Rep. Sarah Jane I. Elago
segments.text: Pinalakas natin iyong batas, pero pagdating naman sa pondo, pinasa natin lahat sa LGU.

segments.speaker: Rep. Sarah Jane I. Elago
segments.text: Hindi naman po lahat ay may kakayahan para pondohan itong pagtatayo ng ating napakahalagang mga child development centers.

segments.speaker: Rep. Sarah Jane I. Elago
segments.text: Kaya ho, at a proper time, magpo-propose tayo ng special line item para po mapondohan itong mga child development centers na kailangan natin sa buong bansa.

segments.speaker: Rep. Sarah Jane I. Elago
segments.text: Ngayon naman, Mr. Chair, pagdating ho

segments.speaker: Rep. Sarah Jane I. Elago
segments.text: sa temporary shelters para sa VAW victim-survivors at sa situation ng ating barangay VAW officers, may study ang PCW na tumatanggap ang mga barangay VAW desk officers

segments.speaker: Rep. Sarah Jane I. Elago
segments.text: ng nasa P500 lang na honorarium kada buwan.

segments.speaker: Rep. Sarah Jane I. Elago
segments.text: Napakababa po nito kumpara doon sa napakalaki nilang responsibility sa ating mga barangay.

segments.speaker: Rep. Sarah Jane I. Elago
segments.text: Napag-aralan n'yo na ho ba kung ano iyong mga dapat nating gawin para matiyak na mapalakas ang mga barangay VAW desk officers

segments.speaker: Rep. Sarah Jane I. Elago
segments.text: at madagdagan iyong kanilang mga natatanggap na kompensasyon?

segments.speaker: Rep. Sarah Jane I. Elago
segments.text: The DILG or the PCW can answer, Mr. Chair.

segments.speaker: PCW Chairperson Ermelita V. Valdeavilla
segments.text: I would refer to the Secretary on this because we do not have a mandate at the local level.

segments.speaker: DILG Secretary Juanito Victor C. Remulla
segments.text: Pardon me, ma'am. Can you, if I can...

segments.speaker: Rep. Sarah Jane I. Elago
segments.text: Mr. Chair, sana hindi po mabawas sa aking oras.

segments.speaker: DILG Secretary Juanito Victor C. Remulla
Rep. Sarah Jane I. Elago
segments.text: Tinanong ko iyong kalagayan ng ating barangay VAW desk officers na madalas ay mga kagawad rin.

segments.speaker: Rep. Sarah Jane I. Elago
segments.text: At napakaliit ng natatanggap na honorarium, nasa P500.

segments.speaker: Rep. Sarah Jane I. Elago
segments.text: Pinapaaral po natin kung paano ba natin matitiyak na mas mataas yung kanilang compensation,

segments.speaker: Rep. Sarah Jane I. Elago
segments.text: magkaroon ng hazard pay dahil hindi po madali yung kanilang ginagawa.

segments.speaker: Rep. Sarah Jane I. Elago
segments.text: Minsan 25-8 po iyan on-call iyong trabaho ng mga barangay VAW desk officers natin.

segments.speaker: Rep. Sarah Jane I. Elago
segments.text: May programa at mga bagong policy ba tayo para ma-improve naman yung kalagayan ng kanilang trabaho?

segments.speaker: DILG Secretary Juanito Victor C. Remulla
DILG Secretary Juanito Victor C. Remulla
DILG Secretary Juanito Victor C. Remulla
segments.text: If you look at a barangay, on a barangay level, meron silang lupon ng tagapayapa,

segments.speaker: DILG Secretary Juanito Victor C. Remulla
segments.text: meron silang barangay tanod, meron silang barangay health workers,

segments.speaker: DILG Secretary Juanito Victor C. Remulla
segments.text: meron silang nutrition scholars, meron silang marami po iyan eh.

segments.speaker: DILG Secretary Juanito Victor C. Remulla
segments.text: It adds to something like 50 to 60 per barangay.

segments.speaker: DILG Secretary Juanito Victor C. Remulla
segments.text: Now, in the previous Congress, they tried to pass the Magna Carta for barangay health workers.

segments.speaker: DILG Secretary Juanito Victor C. Remulla
segments.text: But it was opposed because there would have been a Barangay Magna Carta for Barangay tanods,

segments.speaker: DILG Secretary Juanito Victor C. Remulla
segments.text: Barangay Magna Carta for all the others.

segments.speaker: DILG Secretary Juanito Victor C. Remulla
segments.text: So, that question cannot be easily answered by giving priority to one at the expense of the others.

segments.speaker: DILG Secretary Juanito Victor C. Remulla
segments.text: So it is a balancing act that the local government addresses and to what capacity that they can fulfill the expectation.

segments.speaker: Rep. Sarah Jane I. Elago
segments.text: Pagdating sa gender sensitivity training, hindi lang ng mga barangay VAW desk officers,

segments.speaker: Rep. Sarah Jane I. Elago
segments.text: kundi ng lahat ng ating mga barangay workers, ito madalas sa LGU pa rin po,

segments.speaker: Rep. Sarah Jane I. Elago
segments.text: kinukuha yung ating mga pondo para rito.

segments.speaker: Rep. Sarah Jane I. Elago
segments.text: At tinatawagan natin iyong PCW, again, para matiyak na iyong mga kinakailangang training

segments.speaker: Rep. Sarah Jane I. Elago
segments.text: at iyong tulong na rin para sa stress debriefing ng mga officers natin at mga workers natin at the barangay level,

segments.speaker: Rep. Sarah Jane I. Elago
segments.text: na frontliners natin sa ganitong tipo ng mga kaso, ay mabibigyan din ng karampatang suporta.

segments.speaker: Rep. Sarah Jane I. Elago
segments.text: Ngayon, pagdating naman po sa sexual assault investigation kit,

segments.speaker: Rep. Sarah Jane I. Elago
segments.text: naglabas ang DILG ng memorandum circular tungkol sa pagsusulong ng paggamit ng SAKIT na locally made

segments.speaker: Rep. Sarah Jane I. Elago
segments.text: para sa ating women and children protection units.

segments.speaker: Rep. Sarah Jane I. Elago
segments.text: May nakalaan ba na pondo para rito ang DILG?

segments.speaker: DILG Secretary Juanito Victor C. Remulla
segments.text: That's a local matter, ma'am, that we encourage them to address within their budget.

segments.speaker: Rep. Sarah Jane I. Elago
segments.text: Again, Mr. Chair, wala na naman pong pondo para rito.

segments.speaker: Rep. Sarah Jane I. Elago
segments.text: Kaya kung hindi man sa DILG, puwede po nating tingnan halimbawa sa DOH kung mapasok sa mga WCTU funding nila,

segments.speaker: Rep. Sarah Jane I. Elago
segments.text: iyong napakahalagang SAKIT, iyong access sa justice at iyong paghabol sa mga perpetrators ng gender-based violence,

segments.speaker: Rep. Sarah Jane I. Elago
segments.text: mahalaga po iyong timely collection ng forensic evidence.

segments.speaker: DILG Secretary Juanito Victor C. Remulla
Rep. Sarah Jane I. Elago
segments.text: Pagdating naman po sa PNP-related na VAWC, naglabas po kayo ng policy on addressing VAWC among PNP personnel.

segments.speaker: DILG Secretary Juanito Victor C. Remulla
Rep. Sarah Jane I. Elago
segments.text: Ngunit nakita po namin dito sa inyong policy na pinapayagan n'yo na magkaroon ng pag-uusap, marriage counseling

segments.speaker: Rep. Sarah Jane I. Elago
segments.text: doon sa VAWC victim at sa kanyang asawa na PNP personnel.

segments.speaker: Rep. Sarah Jane I. Elago
segments.text: Ito pa rin po ba iyong policy ngayon ng PNP?

segments.speaker: DILG Secretary Juanito Victor C. Remulla
DILG Secretary Juanito Victor C. Remulla
segments.text: It is an existing policy, ma'am, that we try to reconcile the differences within the department, but of course it has its limits, so how it is resolved eventually is beyond our control, but it has to be a mutual agreement within the two parties that the case in the VAWC.

segments.speaker: Rep. Sarah Jane I. Elago
segments.text: Mr. Chair, ang violence against women and their children ay isang krimen sa ating mga batas.

segments.speaker: Rep. Sarah Jane I. Elago
segments.text: Hindi po ito simpleng away lang ng mag-asawa na pribado kahit pa po involved ang PNP personnel.

segments.speaker: DILG Secretary Juanito Victor C. Remulla
segments.text: I want to give you an example.

segments.speaker: DILG Secretary Juanito Victor C. Remulla
segments.text: The provincial director of Batangas was relieved of duty and about to be relieved from service

segments.speaker: DILG Secretary Juanito Victor C. Remulla
segments.text: by a simple text message alone to a fellow policewoman.

segments.speaker: DILG Secretary Juanito Victor C. Remulla
segments.text: We take it very seriously, ma'am.

segments.speaker: DILG Secretary Juanito Victor C. Remulla
DILG Secretary Juanito Victor C. Remulla
segments.text: harassment among the ranks, that we will file the appropriate charges, whoever they may be.

segments.speaker: DILG Secretary Juanito Victor C. Remulla
segments.text: In fact, maybe a member of Congress was also charged by the PNP for violence against women

segments.speaker: DILG Secretary Juanito Victor C. Remulla
segments.text: among the security personnel and the charges have been filed by the DOJ.

segments.speaker: DILG Secretary Juanito Victor C. Remulla
DILG Secretary Juanito Victor C. Remulla
segments.text: I particularly am very sensitive about this.

segments.speaker: DILG Secretary Juanito Victor C. Remulla
segments.text: If there is any complaint against harassment of women personnel in the PNP,

segments.speaker: DILG Secretary Juanito Victor C. Remulla
segments.text: I take it very seriously and I prosecute.

segments.speaker: DILG Secretary Juanito Victor C. Remulla
segments.text: I prosecute it to the best of my ability.

segments.speaker: Rep. Sarah Jane I. Elago
segments.text: Dapat n'yo pong baguhin itong policy na ito kasi sa ilalim pong ng anti-VAWC law,

segments.speaker: Rep. Sarah Jane I. Elago
segments.text: Lalong-lalo na po doon sa mga kaso po ng physical abuse.

segments.speaker: Rep. Sarah Jane I. Elago
segments.text: Hindi po ito iyong simpleng away lang.

segments.speaker: DILG Secretary Juanito Victor C. Remulla
Rep. Sarah Jane I. Elago
segments.text: Ito po ay a VAWC case.

segments.speaker: Rep. Sarah Jane I. Elago
segments.text: Kaya po pagdating sa VAWC case, dapat po kasama rin po iyong PNP doon sa susunod sa ating Anti-VAWC Act.

segments.speaker: DILG Secretary Juanito Victor C. Remulla
segments.text: Okay. We will, duly noted, ma'am,

segments.speaker: DILG Secretary Juanito Victor C. Remulla
segments.text: and we will make the necessary adjustments.

segments.speaker: Rep. Sarah Jane I. Elago
segments.text: Pagdating naman po dito sa, nakakuha po kami ng report na meron pa rin pong insensitibo na mga nilalabas na anti-rape prevention post ang Philippine National Police.

segments.speaker: Rep. Sarah Jane I. Elago
segments.text: Kamusta po ang inyong guidelines pagdating dito?

segments.speaker: Rep. Sarah Jane I. Elago
segments.text: Ito po iyong ilan sa mga nakarating sa aming office.

segments.speaker: Rep. Sarah Jane I. Elago
segments.text: Ano po ba yung policy n'yo pagdating dito sa anti-rape prevention

segments.speaker: DILG Secretary Juanito Victor C. Remulla
segments.text: These are, ma'am, just guidelines what to do just in case.

segments.speaker: DILG Secretary Juanito Victor C. Remulla
segments.text: But, ma'am, I would like to add that in our Safer Cities campaign,

segments.speaker: DILG Secretary Juanito Victor C. Remulla
segments.text: rape has gone down by 60% from April to August.

segments.speaker: DILG Secretary Juanito Victor C. Remulla
segments.text: Simply because that we increase enforcement of loitering in the streets, drinking in the streets,

segments.speaker: DILG Secretary Juanito Victor C. Remulla
DILG Secretary Juanito Victor C. Remulla
segments.text: Rape has drastically gone down and I think the statistics will bear it out.

segments.speaker: Rep. Sarah Jane I. Elago
segments.text: Mr. Chair, bakit po ito nire-report sa amin sa Gabriela Women's Party?

segments.speaker: Rep. Sarah Jane I. Elago
segments.text: Kasi po, tulad nitong sumigaw ng saklolo, alam n'yo po ba na numero uno hong nangyayari sa mga biktima ng sexual assault at rape ay iyong involuntary freeze dahil po sa takot, sa matinding takot.

segments.speaker: Rep. Sarah Jane I. Elago
segments.text: Kaya po sobrang insensitibo po ng ganitong tipo ng mga

segments.speaker: Rep. Sarah Jane I. Elago
segments.text: post na sinisisi pa yung mga aksyon ng biktima.

segments.speaker: Rep. Sarah Jane I. Elago
segments.text: Tulad po ng paglalakad halimbawa sa gabi, paano po iyong mga BPO workers natin na nagtatrabaho at hindi po maiwasan na maglakad ho mag-isa.

segments.speaker: Rep. Sarah Jane I. Elago
segments.text: So ang tugon, DILG matter din naman po, siyempre, pagtitiyak po ng maayos na lighting, ligtas na kalsada, ligtas na mga siyudad, katulad ng mga nasabi ninyo.

segments.speaker: Rep. Sarah Jane I. Elago
segments.text: At pagtitiyak na iyong anti-rape prevention post po natin,

segments.speaker: Rep. Sarah Jane I. Elago
segments.text: Ano iyong mga psychosocial services, legal assistance para sa mga nabibiktima ng rape?

segments.speaker: Rep. Sarah Jane I. Elago
segments.text: At pagpapaalala din na huwag mang-rape at habang-buhay ang pagkakakulong para sa ganyang tipo ng seryosong krimen.

segments.speaker: Rep. Sarah Jane I. Elago
segments.text: Dapat baguhin ito, Mr. Chair, ng DILG, ng PNP,

segments.speaker: Rep. Sarah Jane I. Elago
segments.text: sana po may malinaw na commitment na ma-take down ang ganitong tipo ng mga post at palitan natin ang gender-sensitive na mga posters.

segments.speaker: DILG Secretary Juanito Victor C. Remulla
DILG Secretary Juanito Victor C. Remulla
segments.text: Ma'am, just as a rejoinder, this has been corrected already.

segments.speaker: DILG Secretary Juanito Victor C. Remulla
segments.text: But also, according to the latest research by OCTA,

segments.speaker: DILG Secretary Juanito Victor C. Remulla
segments.text: as of from last quarter to this quarter, 63% of women now feel safer going home alone from their jobs.

segments.speaker: DILG Secretary Juanito Victor C. Remulla
segments.text: So I think that's a testament to the PNP and the Safer Cities campaign.

segments.speaker: DILG Secretary Juanito Victor C. Remulla
segments.text: However, it is not perfect and we will do better.

segments.speaker: DILG Secretary Juanito Victor C. Remulla
Rep. Sarah Jane I. Elago
segments.text: Just a short manifestation, Mr. Chair.

segments.speaker: DILG Secretary Juanito Victor C. Remulla
Rep. Sarah Jane I. Elago
segments.text: May mga documents din po kami na i-request po from DILG, PNP, at sa ating mga attached agencies.

segments.speaker: Rep. Sarah Jane I. Elago
segments.text: At PNP din po ang naglabas ng mahalagang statistics na 1 out of 10 gender-based violence victims ang hindi po nagre-report dahil sa takot.

segments.speaker: Rep. Sarah Jane I. Elago
segments.text: Kaya po dapat manguna rin tayo doon sa paglaban sa victim blaming, shaming at iyong stigma na natatanggap po ng mga biktima.

segments.speaker: Rep. Sarah Jane I. Elago
segments.text: Maraming salamat, Mr. Chair, at maraming salamat po sa mga kasagutan.

segments.speaker: Rep. Arnie B. Fuentebella
segments.text: Before we proceed, I would like to ask our secretary, would you like a break or working lunch?

segments.speaker: Rep. Arnie B. Fuentebella
segments.text: So, before I call on the next interpellator, I would like to recognize the presence of Assistant Minority Leader Robert Nazal,

segments.speaker: Rep. Arnie B. Fuentebella
segments.text: Vice Chairperson, Maria Carmen Zamora, ma'am,

segments.speaker: Rep. Arnie B. Fuentebella
segments.text: Representative Felimon Espares, Assistant Majority Leader Mark Anthony Santos,

segments.speaker: Rep. Arnie B. Fuentebella
segments.text: Representative Mark Cojuangco, you're recognized, sir.

segments.speaker: Rep. Mark O. Cojuangco
segments.text: First of all, I'd like to manifest my pleasure at the performance of the DILG

segments.speaker: Rep. Mark O. Cojuangco
segments.text: I would like to manifest my complete support for the budget of the DILG,

segments.speaker: Rep. Mark O. Cojuangco
segments.text: I'd just like to make a few comments,

segments.speaker: Rep. Mark O. Cojuangco
segments.text: and maybe the DILG can take note.

segments.speaker: Rep. Mark O. Cojuangco
segments.text: The first comment is the PNP road,

segments.speaker: Rep. Mark O. Cojuangco
segments.text: Cadre Road in the Municipality of Lingayen,

segments.speaker: Rep. Mark O. Cojuangco
segments.text: which is the capital town of the province of Pangasinan.

segments.speaker: Rep. Mark O. Cojuangco
segments.text: We provided a budget of 60 million for the widening of this road.

segments.speaker: Rep. Mark O. Cojuangco
segments.text: because we have had a difficult time

segments.speaker: Rep. Mark O. Cojuangco
segments.text: getting the signature of the Chief PNP.

segments.speaker: Rep. Mark O. Cojuangco
segments.text: It has already passed through several Chief PNPs,

segments.speaker: Rep. Mark O. Cojuangco
segments.text: and up to now, we do not have a signature

segments.speaker: Rep. Mark O. Cojuangco
segments.text: which allows us to build a new wall

segments.speaker: Rep. Mark O. Cojuangco
segments.text: so that we can widen the road.

segments.speaker: Rep. Mark O. Cojuangco
segments.text: May I know if this is forthcoming,

segments.speaker: Rep. Mark O. Cojuangco
segments.text: and also may I know if the Secretary also needs to sign,

segments.speaker: DILG Secretary Juanito Victor C. Remulla
DILG Secretary Juanito Victor C. Remulla
segments.text: That road in question was delayed by a little bit

segments.speaker: DILG Secretary Juanito Victor C. Remulla
DILG Secretary Juanito Victor C. Remulla
segments.text: the destruction of the perimeter wall

segments.speaker: DILG Secretary Juanito Victor C. Remulla
DILG Secretary Juanito Victor C. Remulla
segments.text: So, that was addressed by the DPWH?

segments.speaker: Rep. Mark O. Cojuangco
segments.text: for the replacement of the wall and the gates,

segments.speaker: Rep. Mark O. Cojuangco
segments.text: And my worry is that these funds will lapse

segments.speaker: Rep. Mark O. Cojuangco
segments.text: by the end of the year

segments.speaker: Rep. Mark O. Cojuangco
segments.text: and be returned to the National Treasury.

segments.speaker: DILG Secretary Juanito Victor C. Remulla
DILG Secretary Juanito Victor C. Remulla
segments.text: We will make sure that it is implemented as [unclear], sir.

segments.speaker: Rep. Mark O. Cojuangco
segments.text: which this representation has brought to the attention

segments.speaker: Rep. Mark O. Cojuangco
segments.text: And, what do you call it?

segments.speaker: Rep. Mark O. Cojuangco
segments.text: And this person has taken possession of the property

segments.speaker: Rep. Mark O. Cojuangco
segments.text: which is over a hectare in size.

segments.speaker: Rep. Mark O. Cojuangco
segments.text: that the occupiers need to be evicted.

segments.speaker: Rep. Mark O. Cojuangco
segments.text: and the possession of the PNP be restored to this property.

segments.speaker: Rep. Mark O. Cojuangco
segments.text: May I know what the status of this is, Mr. Secretary, Mr. Chairman?

segments.speaker: PNP Chief Police General Jose Melencio C. Nartatez Jr.
segments.text: Good afternoon or good noon, Mr. Chair and Your Honor.

segments.speaker: PNP Chief Police General Jose Melencio C. Nartatez Jr.
segments.text: In behalf of the Philippine National Police, as the Chief PNP,

segments.speaker: PNP Chief Police General Jose Melencio C. Nartatez Jr.
segments.text: I would like to personally give you after this the update on the lot that

segments.speaker: PNP Chief Police General Jose Melencio C. Nartatez Jr.
segments.text: the Congressman, Your Honor, had been saying.

segments.speaker: PNP Chief Police General Jose Melencio C. Nartatez Jr.
segments.text: One of the problems of the Philippine National Police, of course, is

segments.speaker: PNP Chief Police General Jose Melencio C. Nartatez Jr.
segments.text: lot acquisition. And this one is one among these

segments.speaker: PNP Chief Police General Jose Melencio C. Nartatez Jr.
segments.text: challenges or problems that kailangan namin makuha.

segments.speaker: PNP Chief Police General Jose Melencio C. Nartatez Jr.
segments.text: And to brief the Honorable Congressman, the PNP lot is now a question of

segments.speaker: PNP Chief Police General Jose Melencio C. Nartatez Jr.
segments.text: our dealing with the DENR, the Office of the Secretary General, Provincial Prosecutor, Assessor,

segments.speaker: PNP Chief Police General Jose Melencio C. Nartatez Jr.
segments.text: and other agencies such that this lot should mapunta sa amin.

segments.speaker: PNP Chief Police General Jose Melencio C. Nartatez Jr.
segments.text: And this will pave the way also for the construction and or giving funds as well

segments.speaker: PNP Chief Police General Jose Melencio C. Nartatez Jr.
segments.text: as the utilization of funds that the Honorable Congressman have said a while ago.

segments.speaker: PNP Chief Police General Jose Melencio C. Nartatez Jr.
segments.text: And the PNP is committed to, committed such that this lot be finally.

segments.speaker: Rep. Mark O. Cojuangco
segments.text: Mr. Chair, matagal ko na pong nadidinig yung committed ang PNP pero wala pong nangyayari.

segments.speaker: Rep. Mark O. Cojuangco
segments.text: E kung sabihin ko po sa inyo ngayon na sigurado lang mababalik sa PNP yung lupa, yung pong scalawag na gumawa po nitong kagagawa na inagaw ang lupa ng gobyerno,

segments.speaker: Rep. Mark O. Cojuangco
segments.text: sisiguraduhin nyo ba na makasuhan itong taong ito?

segments.speaker: Rep. Mark O. Cojuangco
segments.text: ngayon ng mga politikong inaakala natin nagnanakaw sa gobyerno. E, ito bang dating nagnakaw?

segments.speaker: PNP Chief Police General Jose Melencio C. Nartatez Jr.
segments.text: Yes, Mr. Chair. The PNP is committed na makapag-file ng kaso after the conduct of thorough investigation.

segments.speaker: Rep. Mark O. Cojuangco
segments.text: So for the information of the DILG and the PNP, there is a DENR Administrative Order No. 2026-11

segments.speaker: Rep. Mark O. Cojuangco
segments.text: dated February 25, 2026, subject declaring certain portions of the unclassified public land

segments.speaker: Rep. Mark O. Cojuangco
segments.text: as forest land for permanent forest purposes.

segments.speaker: Rep. Mark O. Cojuangco
segments.text: Under land classification project number 47-A and 38-A of the municipalities of Lingayen and Binmaley, respectively,

segments.speaker: Rep. Mark O. Cojuangco
segments.text: province of Pangasinan, signed by then-Secretary Rafael P. M. Lotilla.

segments.speaker: Rep. Mark O. Cojuangco
segments.text: Ito po tinrabaho ng representative ng distrito, hindi po ng PNP.

segments.speaker: Rep. Mark O. Cojuangco
segments.text: solve na po ang problema ninyo.

segments.speaker: Rep. Mark O. Cojuangco
segments.text: Diniklara ng itong lupang ito ay pag-aari ng gobyerno.

segments.speaker: Rep. Mark O. Cojuangco
segments.text: So, what will you do with the actions of this scalawag police that did this?

segments.speaker: PNP Chief Police General Jose Melencio C. Nartatez Jr.
segments.text: If that is the basis, Mr. Chair, Your Honor, for the filing of criminal cases or even administrative case for the subject person,

segments.speaker: PNP Chief Police General Jose Melencio C. Nartatez Jr.
segments.text: then we'll be referring it to that honorable body, Mr. Chair, Your Honor.

segments.speaker: Rep. Mark O. Cojuangco
segments.text: Sana po itong representation ay magkaroon ng regular reporting on the status of this

segments.speaker: Rep. Mark O. Cojuangco
segments.text: and sana po the PNP will act immediately to take possession of this property.

segments.speaker: Rep. Mark O. Cojuangco
segments.text: Kasi hanggang ngayon, pagamat may deklarasyon na ang DENR na ito po ay lupa ng gobyerno,

segments.speaker: Rep. Mark O. Cojuangco
segments.text: yung pong taong yun ay nandun pa rin po at ginagamit ang property.

segments.speaker: PNP Chief Police General Jose Melencio C. Nartatez Jr.
segments.text: Rest assured of that commitment, Your Honor, Mr. Chair.

segments.speaker: PNP Chief Police General Jose Melencio C. Nartatez Jr.
segments.text: And ngayon pa lang nagpapasalamat na kami sa Your Honor, Sir,

segments.speaker: PNP Chief Police General Jose Melencio C. Nartatez Jr.
segments.text: for that helping the Philippine National Police in as much as this should be utilized by the government,

segments.speaker: PNP Chief Police General Jose Melencio C. Nartatez Jr.
PNP Chief Police General Jose Melencio C. Nartatez Jr.
PNP Chief Police General Jose Melencio C. Nartatez Jr.
segments.text: And it will be a subject of our continuing update to the Honorable Congressman.

segments.speaker: Rep. Mark O. Cojuangco
segments.text: Isa na lang punto tungkol po sa mga matagal ng laspag at tinabing mga police vehicle na Mahindra

segments.speaker: Rep. Mark O. Cojuangco
segments.text: na nakaparada po sa PNP Provincial Headquarters for the longest time.

segments.speaker: Rep. Mark O. Cojuangco
segments.text: Nabanggit ko po ito sa isang NLQ, North Luzon

segments.speaker: Rep. Mark O. Cojuangco
segments.text: Dahil [unclear] ko pong mapaayos po ito at maibigay sa mga barangay para gamitin po ng barangay,

segments.speaker: Rep. Mark O. Cojuangco
segments.text: Ang nangyari po, after ko binanggit, nawala po ang lahat na ito.

segments.speaker: Rep. Mark O. Cojuangco
segments.text: Meron pong nagkainteres na siguro ayusin, gamitin,

segments.speaker: Rep. Mark O. Cojuangco
segments.text: na privado, hindi na po gobyerno.

segments.speaker: Rep. Mark O. Cojuangco
segments.text: Nasasayangan po ako sa pagkakataon sana na mabigyan ng mga sasakyan ang mga barangay.

segments.speaker: Rep. Mark O. Cojuangco
segments.text: May I know kung ano pa po ang recourse nitong representation po na ito

segments.speaker: Rep. Mark O. Cojuangco
segments.text: para mahabol po itong mga Mahindra na ito

segments.speaker: Rep. Mark O. Cojuangco
segments.text: or meron pa bang mga Mahindra

segments.speaker: Rep. Mark O. Cojuangco
segments.text: na pwede po nating makuha para maibigay sa mga barangay po ng aming distrito?

segments.speaker: DILG Secretary Juanito Victor C. Remulla
segments.text: Sir, 95% of the Mahindra vehicles acquired by the PNP in 2010-2011, I think,

segments.speaker: DILG Secretary Juanito Victor C. Remulla
segments.text: are now considered beyond economic repair.

segments.speaker: DILG Secretary Juanito Victor C. Remulla
segments.text: If you, in the normal life cycle of a police vehicle, it is usually 12 years,

segments.speaker: DILG Secretary Juanito Victor C. Remulla
segments.text: 10 to 12 years before they are replaced.

segments.speaker: DILG Secretary Juanito Victor C. Remulla
segments.text: Right now, sir, the Mahindra vehicles are between 13 and 14 years old already.

segments.speaker: Rep. Mark O. Cojuangco
segments.text: Mr. Chairman, Mr. Secretary, for your information,

segments.speaker: Rep. Mark O. Cojuangco
segments.text: ang naging kakulangan lang ng mga Mahindrang yan kaya naitenga

segments.speaker: Rep. Mark O. Cojuangco
segments.text: ay dahil kulang ng preno at kulang ng clutch.

segments.speaker: DILG Secretary Juanito Victor C. Remulla
Rep. Mark O. Cojuangco
segments.text: Wala naman pong problema na mag-order

segments.speaker: Rep. Mark O. Cojuangco
segments.text: ng pyesa sa India para maisaayos po ang lahat na yan.

segments.speaker: Rep. Mark O. Cojuangco
segments.text: Kung hindi na po magamit ng PNP dahil deteriorated na po,

segments.speaker: Rep. Mark O. Cojuangco
segments.text: gustong gusto po ng mga barangay na gamitin po yan para sa mga local functions po nila.

segments.speaker: DILG Secretary Juanito Victor C. Remulla
Rep. Mark O. Cojuangco
segments.text: So, sana po this representation will be informed. Kung meron pa po kami na makukuha.

segments.speaker: Rep. Mark O. Cojuangco
segments.text: and if we can get 231 ex-Mahindras police vehicles, we would be very thankful, Mr. Secretary.

segments.speaker: DILG Secretary Juanito Victor C. Remulla
DILG Secretary Juanito Victor C. Remulla
segments.text: We will take an accounting and keep you up to date on the status of the vehicles.

segments.speaker: Rep. Antonio L. Tinio
segments.text: In the meantime, pagbati po sa DILG at kay classmate, Sec. John Vic.

segments.speaker: DILG Secretary Juanito Victor C. Remulla
Rep. Antonio L. Tinio
segments.text: Ang mga tanong po tungkol sa LGSF, Local Government Support Fund.

segments.speaker: Rep. Antonio L. Tinio
segments.text: Pero may role ang DILG sa implementation and monitoring nito.

segments.speaker: Rep. Antonio L. Tinio
segments.text: In the 2026 budget, talagang nilakihan, lumobo po nang husto yung LGSF,

segments.speaker: Rep. Antonio L. Tinio
segments.text: particular yung Financial Assistance to Local Government Units.

segments.speaker: Rep. Antonio L. Tinio
segments.text: So, nakikita diyan, originally sa NEP, 5 billion ang proposal,

segments.speaker: Rep. Antonio L. Tinio
segments.text: pero at the end of the budget process, naging 37.4 billion.

segments.speaker: Rep. Antonio L. Tinio
segments.text: Yun ang pinakamalaking component ng paglobo ng LGSF. Next slide.

segments.speaker: Rep. Antonio L. Tinio
segments.text: At that time, and up to now, pinuna natin ito, tinawag nating LGU Pork.

segments.speaker: Rep. Antonio L. Tinio
segments.text: At pinoint out natin na kaya lumakihan dahil yung pera, saan ang galing?

segments.speaker: Rep. Antonio L. Tinio
segments.text: Binawasan yung original proposal para pang sweldo, benepisyo at pensyon ng government employees.

segments.speaker: Rep. Antonio L. Tinio
segments.text: So doon ang galing yung increase.

segments.speaker: Rep. Antonio L. Tinio
segments.text: Why did we call it pork?

segments.speaker: Rep. Antonio L. Tinio
segments.text: Kasi yes, makakatulong, pero discretionary sa executive at ginagamit sa politika.

segments.speaker: Rep. Antonio L. Tinio
segments.text: Ito ay video ng Executive Secretary Recto sa League of Municipalities just two days ago sa Iloilo.

segments.speaker: Rep. Antonio L. Tinio
segments.text: Okay, medyo mahina po yung audio, pero essentially...

segments.speaker: Rep. Antonio L. Tinio
segments.text: Ang nangyayari po diyan ay distribution ng SARO ng financial assistance to LGUs.

segments.speaker: Rep. Antonio L. Tinio
segments.text: In this case mga mayor ng Luzon, convention

segments.speaker: Rep. Antonio L. Tinio
segments.text: nila yan. So, ano ang gusto nating i-highlight dito? Na yung dapat purely bureaucratic transmittal

segments.speaker: Rep. Antonio L. Tinio
segments.text: ng SARO sa ilalim ng administrasyong ito, ginawa na talagang full-blown official ceremony

segments.speaker: Rep. Antonio L. Tinio
segments.text: ng pork barrel distribution. Ganun ang tawag natin dito. Of course, hindi ito concern

segments.speaker: Rep. Antonio L. Tinio
segments.text: ni Secretary John Vic. My question to the DILG is, importante po ang, well, una sa guidelines

segments.speaker: Rep. Antonio L. Tinio
segments.text: ng financial assistance, may nilabas ang DBM, at magkano yung assistance? Meron lang general

segments.speaker: Rep. Antonio L. Tinio
segments.text: guidelines dito. Pagka-ayuda, yung ibibigay na ayuda sa constituents,

segments.speaker: Rep. Antonio L. Tinio
segments.text: maximum of 5 million pag barangay level, tapos 50 million pagka-province and city,

segments.speaker: Rep. Antonio L. Tinio
segments.text: 20 million pagka-municipality for ayuda. Yung mga para sa AICS, medical, etc. Pero pagka-

segments.speaker: Rep. Antonio L. Tinio
segments.text: infrastructure, sa barangay may maximum, 10 million din. Pero pagka-municipality, city,

segments.speaker: Rep. Antonio L. Tinio
segments.text: guidelines. In other words, it's up to the discretion of the DBM and the DILG. Tama po ba?

segments.speaker: DILG Secretary Juanito Victor C. Remulla
segments.text: Sir, these are all guidelines issued by the DBM and not the DILG, sir.

segments.speaker: Rep. Antonio L. Tinio
segments.text: But, accurate po ba yung sinabi ko?

segments.speaker: DILG Secretary Juanito Victor C. Remulla
segments.text: No. We are strictly on monitoring basis and we have no policy-making basis regarding the

segments.speaker: DILG Secretary Juanito Victor C. Remulla
segments.text: distribution and utilization of the FALGU.

segments.speaker: Rep. Arnie B. Fuentebella
segments.text: And can I add lang sa answer ni Secretary?

segments.speaker: Rep. Arnie B. Fuentebella
segments.text: Actually, ang LGSF ay wala po sa DILG. So ang DILG lang is to supervise kung tama yung paggawa

segments.speaker: Rep. Arnie B. Fuentebella
segments.text: since lahat po ng local government ay may mga officer tayo from DILG.

segments.speaker: Rep. Arnie B. Fuentebella
segments.text: We are not in the policy nor in the distribution side of the funds.

segments.speaker: Rep. Antonio L. Tinio
segments.text: But in DBM LBC No. 169, ito yung guidelines.

segments.speaker: Rep. Antonio L. Tinio
segments.text: Meron portion po roon na, for example, mga requests, nakalagay po rito, 3.4.3.4.

segments.speaker: Rep. Antonio L. Tinio
segments.text: The DBM, when necessary, shall forward the request to the DILG for the determination of the recommended amount for each LGU.

segments.speaker: DILG Secretary Juanito Victor C. Remulla
segments.text: If it is referred to us, sir. If it is necessary or not.

segments.speaker: DILG Secretary Juanito Victor C. Remulla
segments.text: We have received very few. The USECs take care of that. Yes, it is mostly, sir, on the water

segments.speaker: DILG Secretary Juanito Victor C. Remulla
segments.text: systems that we are associated with. But otherwise, sir, there are far and few

segments.speaker: DILG Secretary Juanito Victor C. Remulla
segments.text: requests for us to monitor. Thank you.

segments.speaker: Rep. Antonio L. Tinio
segments.text: So, actually, mas iyon ang tanong ko. Yung gusto nating malaman ng lahat ng publiko, malaking lump sum po ito,

segments.speaker: Rep. Antonio L. Tinio
segments.text: And in fact, nakita ko, tinignan ko yung budget, yung 57 billion total na LGSF for 2026,

segments.speaker: Rep. Antonio L. Tinio
segments.text: actually, nadagdagan pa ng more than 10 billion, may continuing appropriations, yung hindi pa nagamit.

segments.speaker: Rep. Antonio L. Tinio
segments.text: So, total 68 billion. Is that correct? Please confirm.

segments.speaker: DILG Secretary Juanito Victor C. Remulla
Rep. Antonio L. Tinio
segments.text: billion. Tapos, may proposal ulit for 57 billion

segments.speaker: Rep. Antonio L. Tinio
segments.text: for next year. So, ang gusto po nating malaman, of course, in the interest of transparency, paano po nagamit ito? Kumusta na po ang utilization? At magkano yung in-approve ninyo, DBM-DILG, sa bawat LGU?

segments.speaker: DILG Secretary Juanito Victor C. Remulla
segments.text: Sir, the utilization rate will be determined at the end of the year

segments.speaker: DILG Secretary Juanito Victor C. Remulla
segments.text: since the program started in 2026. We will give a full report in

segments.speaker: DILG Secretary Juanito Victor C. Remulla
segments.text: 2027 after we have monitored all the distribution and how they were used.

segments.speaker: Rep. Antonio L. Tinio
segments.text: Well, let me just note that in the guidelines,

segments.speaker: Rep. Antonio L. Tinio
segments.text: sinasabi po rito, actually may transparency requirement and the LGUs, the recipient LGUs,

segments.speaker: Rep. Antonio L. Tinio
segments.text: are required to provide, submit quarterly reports on how they use the funds to DBM, DILG,

segments.speaker: Rep. Antonio L. Tinio
segments.text: as well as actually Congress and [unclear]. So dapat meron kayo.

segments.speaker: DILG Secretary Juanito Victor C. Remulla
segments.text: Yes, sir, there's a Subay Bayan portal that we have for them to submit.

segments.speaker: Rep. Antonio L. Tinio
segments.text: Opo, kaya nga, therefore, baka puwedeng magbigay ng update on 2025. Meron na po kasi in 2025

segments.speaker: DILG Secretary Juanito Victor C. Remulla
segments.text: Yes, sir, we will gladly submit it to your office.

segments.speaker: DILG Secretary Juanito Victor C. Remulla
segments.text: I will submit it within the day, sir.

segments.speaker: Rep. Antonio L. Tinio
segments.text: Thank you, sir. Thank you po, so iyon po yung gusto nating makita. Gusto rin siyempre malaman ng lahat siguro, kahit yung ibang-ibang LGU, magkano ba, paano ba na, magkano ang natatanggap ng ibang-ibang LGU.

segments.speaker: Rep. Antonio L. Tinio
segments.text: Of course, the other concern is yung implementation.

segments.speaker: Rep. Antonio L. Tinio
segments.text: Yung implementation, tama po ba, nasa level na ng LGU?

segments.speaker: DILG Secretary Juanito Victor C. Remulla
Rep. Antonio L. Tinio
segments.text: How do we ensure na talagang na-implement nang tama at walang problema at anomalya?

segments.speaker: Rep. Antonio L. Tinio
segments.text: Ang malaking pondo rin po ito.

segments.speaker: Rep. Antonio L. Tinio
segments.text: We're talking about a total of at least 37 billion pesos.

segments.speaker: DILG Secretary Juanito Victor C. Remulla
segments.text: Sir, the department has hired engineers to help us assess.

segments.speaker: DILG Secretary Juanito Victor C. Remulla
segments.text: But mostly, sir, this is a function of the Commission on Audit

segments.speaker: DILG Secretary Juanito Victor C. Remulla
segments.text: to check whether or not they have complied with all.

segments.speaker: DILG Secretary Juanito Victor C. Remulla
segments.text: We are talking about over 40,000 LGU recipients here.

segments.speaker: DILG Secretary Juanito Victor C. Remulla
segments.text: And our department will need the help also of COA

segments.speaker: DILG Secretary Juanito Victor C. Remulla
segments.text: in assessing the final outcome of their projects.

segments.speaker: Rep. Antonio L. Tinio
segments.text: Yes, isang concern po natin yan.

segments.speaker: Rep. Antonio L. Tinio
segments.text: Kasi actually nakita ko sa guidelines din

segments.speaker: Rep. Antonio L. Tinio
segments.text: ang isang requirement para ma-release yung pondo mula dito.

segments.speaker: Rep. Antonio L. Tinio
segments.text: Sabi rito, 4.17.2, Certificate of Reversion of Funds

segments.speaker: Rep. Antonio L. Tinio
segments.text: in Case of Undisbursed Balances from the Completed Projects

segments.speaker: Rep. Antonio L. Tinio
segments.text: under the Fiscal Years 2016 to 2025, LGSF, Financial Assistance to LGU.

segments.speaker: Rep. Antonio L. Tinio
segments.text: Ibig po sabihin, mukhang may hinahabol pa kayong mga unused funds from 2016 to 2025.

segments.speaker: DILG Secretary Juanito Victor C. Remulla
DILG Secretary Juanito Victor C. Remulla
DILG Secretary Juanito Victor C. Remulla
DILG Secretary Juanito Victor C. Remulla
segments.text: it was under the purview of Congress and not of the DILG in its distribution.

segments.speaker: DILG Secretary Juanito Victor C. Remulla
segments.text: So it's only in 2026 that we took full cognizance of this, sir.

segments.speaker: Rep. Antonio L. Tinio
segments.text: Noted na 2026 sa ilalim ng DILG.

segments.speaker: Rep. Antonio L. Tinio
segments.text: Pero ang punto, hindi naman po bago itong programa ng LGSF Financial Assistance

segments.speaker: Rep. Antonio L. Tinio
segments.text: Ang sinasabi nga, mukhang may hinahabol pa all the way back from 2016

segments.speaker: Rep. Antonio L. Tinio
segments.text: So kaya nga po, talagang tatanungin din natin, nabanggit n'yo [unclear],

segments.speaker: Rep. Antonio L. Tinio
segments.text: Pero alam naman natin, LGU 'yan, medyo mahirap din na bawat isa ay makita natin.

segments.speaker: Rep. Antonio L. Tinio
segments.text: So iyon po yung concern natin is with regard to transparency dito.

segments.speaker: Rep. Antonio L. Tinio
segments.text: may discretionary element, especially with regard to the infrastructure.

segments.speaker: DILG Secretary Juanito Victor C. Remulla
segments.text: Sir, I'd like to add that the accountability level of the local chief executives

segments.text: is a very high bar to follow.

segments.text: There are three parts to this, ma'am.

segments.speaker: DILG Secretary Juanito Victor C. Remulla

segments.speaker: DILG Secretary Juanito Victor C. Remulla

segments.speaker: DILG Secretary Juanito Victor C. Remulla

segments.speaker: DILG Secretary Juanito Victor C. Remulla

segments.text: It would reach about 5 billion because out of 17 projects, only 5 were included in the NEP.

segments.speaker: Rep. Rufus B. Rodriguez
segments.text: Yeah, include Kageyandi Oron and Region 10, excluding the others.

segments.speaker: BJMP Chief Jail Director Efren A. Nemeño
segments.text: Yes, we will submit another request for Kageyandi Oron and Region 10.

segments.speaker: BJMP Chief Jail Director Efren A. Nemeño
segments.text: That's really needed by our regional director.

segments.speaker: Rep. Rufus B. Rodriguez
segments.text: We have to congratulate our director for BJMP we have here, Hill Inopia. Please stand.

segments.speaker: Rep. Rufus B. Rodriguez
segments.text: ARD because our RD Hagarin is recuperating from his spine.

segments.speaker: Rep. Rufus B. Rodriguez
segments.text: I know your people, they are doing very well.

segments.speaker: Rep. Rufus B. Rodriguez
segments.text: The PDLs are really fed very well and they don't want to live anymore in the jail.

segments.speaker: Rep. Rufus B. Rodriguez
segments.text: What else? Summarize na lang lahat.

segments.speaker: Rep. Rufus B. Rodriguez
segments.text: How much total ang request niyo?

segments.speaker: BJMP Chief Jail Director Efren A. Nemeño
segments.text: At present, Mr. Chairman, your honors, we have an additional request of about 747,000,000.

segments.speaker: BJMP Chief Jail Director Efren A. Nemeño
Rep. Rufus B. Rodriguez
segments.text: Plus 100 million for Region 10, how much is that?

segments.speaker: BJMP Chief Jail Director Efren A. Nemeño
Rep. Rufus B. Rodriguez
segments.text: Thank you, Mr. Chairman. We will push for this.

segments.speaker: Rep. Rufus B. Rodriguez
segments.text: Finally, Mr. Chairman, I go to the Bureau of Fire.

segments.speaker: Rep. Rufus B. Rodriguez
segments.text: I thank so much our FC Superintendent, Wilberto Rico Juan Chu.

segments.speaker: Rep. Rufus B. Rodriguez
segments.text: You have a very good compliment.

segments.speaker: Rep. Rufus B. Rodriguez
segments.text: And the Regional Director, Richard Arbutante.

segments.speaker: Rep. Rufus B. Rodriguez
segments.text: Yes, very good compliment of the Bureau of Fire.

segments.speaker: Rep. Rufus B. Rodriguez
segments.text: I just received, about a month ago, the new fire truck, modern fire truck, brand new.

segments.speaker: Rep. Rufus B. Rodriguez
segments.text: It's now in Barangay Macabalan, which leads most in the city of Cagliari.

segments.speaker: BFP Officer-in-Charge Fire Chief Superintendent Wilberto Rico Neil A. Kwan Tiu
segments.text: Mr. Chair and Your Honor, I have five items, actually.

segments.speaker: BFP Officer-in-Charge Fire Chief Superintendent Wilberto Rico Neil A. Kwan Tiu
BFP Officer-in-Charge Fire Chief Superintendent Wilberto Rico Neil A. Kwan Tiu
segments.text: It's in the amount of 3.4 billion pesos.

segments.speaker: BFP Officer-in-Charge Fire Chief Superintendent Wilberto Rico Neil A. Kwan Tiu
segments.text: Item number one is the restoration of the 200 million that was lost from the original budget

segments.speaker: BFP Officer-in-Charge Fire Chief Superintendent Wilberto Rico Neil A. Kwan Tiu
BFP Officer-in-Charge Fire Chief Superintendent Wilberto Rico Neil A. Kwan Tiu
segments.text: We will use this amount to purchase eight collapse structure search and rescue trucks.

segments.speaker: BFP Officer-in-Charge Fire Chief Superintendent Wilberto Rico Neil A. Kwan Tiu
segments.text: This is what is used when there are collapse structures in Lindolpo, in the earthquake.

segments.speaker: BFP Officer-in-Charge Fire Chief Superintendent Wilberto Rico Neil A. Kwan Tiu
segments.text: And one of these trucks will be for Cagayan de Oro, Mr. Chair.

segments.speaker: BFP Officer-in-Charge Fire Chief Superintendent Wilberto Rico Neil A. Kwan Tiu
BFP Officer-in-Charge Fire Chief Superintendent Wilberto Rico Neil A. Kwan Tiu
segments.text: Another item number two, Mr. Chair, is the 1.8 billion pesos for the 74 collapsed structural

segments.speaker: BFP Officer-in-Charge Fire Chief Superintendent Wilberto Rico Neil A. Kwan Tiu
BFP Officer-in-Charge Fire Chief Superintendent Wilberto Rico Neil A. Kwan Tiu
segments.text: The intention of this one is to capacitate all provincial fire offices to have a rescue

segments.speaker: BFP Officer-in-Charge Fire Chief Superintendent Wilberto Rico Neil A. Kwan Tiu
Rep. Rufus B. Rodriguez
segments.text: How many for Cagayan de Oro?

segments.speaker: BFP Officer-in-Charge Fire Chief Superintendent Wilberto Rico Neil A. Kwan Tiu
BFP Officer-in-Charge Fire Chief Superintendent Wilberto Rico Neil A. Kwan Tiu
segments.text: Then, additional of 373 million pesos for OPEX and our unified 911 maintenance and operating

segments.speaker: BFP Officer-in-Charge Fire Chief Superintendent Wilberto Rico Neil A. Kwan Tiu
BFP Officer-in-Charge Fire Chief Superintendent Wilberto Rico Neil A. Kwan Tiu
segments.text: And item number four, Mr. Chair and Your Honor, is the procurement of 82 ambulances in the

segments.speaker: BFP Officer-in-Charge Fire Chief Superintendent Wilberto Rico Neil A. Kwan Tiu
BFP Officer-in-Charge Fire Chief Superintendent Wilberto Rico Neil A. Kwan Tiu
segments.text: And number five is the additional...

segments.speaker: BFP Officer-in-Charge Fire Chief Superintendent Wilberto Rico Neil A. Kwan Tiu
segments.text: Quota for FO1, that is 2,000, so that we will be able to achieve the ideal money requirements

segments.speaker: BFP Officer-in-Charge Fire Chief Superintendent Wilberto Rico Neil A. Kwan Tiu
segments.text: for the BFP in a shorter period of time.

segments.speaker: BFP Officer-in-Charge Fire Chief Superintendent Wilberto Rico Neil A. Kwan Tiu
segments.text: If we give an additional 2,000 on top of the 2,000 yearly, we will be able to do the money

segments.speaker: BFP Officer-in-Charge Fire Chief Superintendent Wilberto Rico Neil A. Kwan Tiu
segments.text: requirements correctly within 10 years instead of going to 20 years.

segments.speaker: BFP Officer-in-Charge Fire Chief Superintendent Wilberto Rico Neil A. Kwan Tiu
segments.text: So, all in all, Mr. Chair, the amount here is 3.4 billion pesos, but additional to request

segments.speaker: BFP Officer-in-Charge Fire Chief Superintendent Wilberto Rico Neil A. Kwan Tiu
BFP Officer-in-Charge Fire Chief Superintendent Wilberto Rico Neil A. Kwan Tiu
BFP Officer-in-Charge Fire Chief Superintendent Wilberto Rico Neil A. Kwan Tiu
Rep. Rufus B. Rodriguez
segments.text: With that, Mr. Chairman, I make a manifestation as I congratulate the DLG, the PNP, the Bureau

segments.speaker: Rep. Rufus B. Rodriguez
segments.text: of Fire and the Bureau of Jail Management.

segments.speaker: Rep. Rufus B. Rodriguez
segments.text: In the proper time, Mr. Chairman, I will move for the approval of the budget of the DLG

segments.speaker: Rep. Rufus B. Rodriguez
segments.text: and the attached agencies with all the requested increase, Mr. Chairman.

segments.speaker: Rep. Rufus B. Rodriguez
segments.text: This country cannot be developing, cannot be economically strong, culturally strong if

segments.speaker: Rep. Rufus B. Rodriguez
segments.text: And who provides the peace, and who provides those, for example, there is a calamity, fire.

segments.speaker: Rep. Rufus B. Rodriguez
segments.text: Our fireman arrives at the scene before the fire, and then also the BGMP.

segments.speaker: Rep. Rufus B. Rodriguez
segments.text: So Mr. Chairman, I thank you for the additional time.

segments.speaker: Rep. Rufus B. Rodriguez
segments.text: You have always, it pays to be a friend of the chairman.

segments.speaker: Rep. Rufus B. Rodriguez
segments.text: And so with that, in the proper time, I will move.

segments.speaker: Rep. Rufus B. Rodriguez
segments.text: For the approval, plus all the increase requested by the branches and also the DLG.

segments.speaker: Rep. Rufus B. Rodriguez
segments.text: Thank you very, very much, Mr. Chairman.

segments.speaker: Rep. Arnie B. Fuentebella
segments.text: Duly noted, Congressman Rufus, parang nakadami ito ah.

segments.speaker: Rep. Arnie B. Fuentebella
segments.text: Next to interpellate, Congressman Munir Arbison, sir, recognized.

segments.speaker: Rep. Munir N. Arbison Jr.
segments.text: Mr. Chairman, unang-una, gusto ko lang magpasalamat sa DILG at saka,

segments.speaker: Rep. Munir N. Arbison Jr.
segments.text: sa Chief PNP for the maintenance of peace and order sa Sulu.

segments.speaker: Rep. Munir N. Arbison Jr.
segments.text: Alam mo, yung Sulu ngayon, dati-dati ang tinatanong, ang gulo-gulo ng Sulu ah, bakit kaya?

segments.speaker: Rep. Munir N. Arbison Jr.
segments.text: Ngayon ang tinatanong na, saan bang magandang beach?

segments.speaker: Rep. Munir N. Arbison Jr.
segments.text: So maraming salamat sa PNP at saka sa DILG.

segments.speaker: Rep. Munir N. Arbison Jr.
segments.text: Ang question ko lang sa regarding the transition sa DILG, this is in accordance with the

segments.speaker: Rep. Munir N. Arbison Jr.
segments.text: Executive Order 91 regarding the transfer of the BARMM to Region 9.

segments.speaker: Rep. Munir N. Arbison Jr.
segments.text: Ano na kaya ang status ngayon?

segments.speaker: DILG Undersecretary for Local Government Marlo L. Iringan
DILG Undersecretary for Local Government Marlo L. Iringan
DILG Undersecretary for Local Government Marlo L. Iringan
DILG Undersecretary for Local Government Marlo L. Iringan
segments.text: What we will do in the coming days is to release the Memorandum Circular for the guidance of

segments.speaker: DILG Undersecretary for Local Government Marlo L. Iringan
segments.text: the local governments in the province of Sulu, pertaining to Sulu being now part of Region

segments.speaker: DILG Undersecretary for Local Government Marlo L. Iringan
DILG Undersecretary for Local Government Marlo L. Iringan
segments.text: But as far as the local government sector is concerned, we have already started coordinating

segments.speaker: DILG Undersecretary for Local Government Marlo L. Iringan
segments.text: and working with the local governments of Sulu as far back as late 2025, no?

segments.speaker: DILG Undersecretary for Local Government Marlo L. Iringan
segments.text: We have already oriented our field officers pertaining to the programs that the DILG is implementing, the local government sector

segments.speaker: DILG Undersecretary for Local Government Marlo L. Iringan
DILG Undersecretary for Local Government Marlo L. Iringan
segments.text: And we also have already oriented them on the policies pertaining to the local government support

segments.speaker: DILG Undersecretary for Local Government Marlo L. Iringan
segments.text: fund, to the programs of the DILG in disaster reduction and management.

segments.speaker: Rep. Munir N. Arbison Jr.
segments.text: Actually, ang problema ngayon ng mga empleyado natin sa DILG, hindi nila alam kung saan sila.

segments.speaker: Rep. Munir N. Arbison Jr.
segments.text: Kasi as of now, ang nagsasweldo sa kanila, BARMM pa eh.

segments.speaker: DILG Undersecretary for Local Government Marlo L. Iringan
segments.text: That's correct, Mr. Chair, because the arrangement is until the end of the year, it will be the

segments.speaker: DILG Undersecretary for Local Government Marlo L. Iringan
segments.text: Bangsamoro Autonomous Region of Muslim Mindanao, which will be providing the salaries for all

segments.speaker: DILG Undersecretary for Local Government Marlo L. Iringan
segments.text: the affected personnel, not only of the DILG, but all national government agencies.

segments.speaker: DILG Undersecretary for Local Government Marlo L. Iringan
segments.text: But for the local government sector, as I mentioned, I do believe we will have no problem

segments.speaker: DILG Undersecretary for Local Government Marlo L. Iringan
segments.text: with that, Mr. Chair, because the warm bodies or the personnel complement of the Ministry

segments.speaker: DILG Undersecretary for Local Government Marlo L. Iringan
segments.text: of Interior and local government in Sulu is almost the same as the structure of the

segments.speaker: DILG Undersecretary for Local Government Marlo L. Iringan
segments.text: regular provinces under the DILG, Mr. Chair.

segments.speaker: DILG Undersecretary for Local Government Marlo L. Iringan
segments.text: I'm not really sure, sir, about other national government agencies.

segments.speaker: Rep. Munir N. Arbison Jr.
segments.text: Nakasama na ba yung personal services nila sa budget ngayon?

segments.speaker: DILG Undersecretary for Local Government Marlo L. Iringan
segments.text: For 2027, Mr. Chair, as far as LG, the local government sector, is concerned, their salaries

segments.speaker: DILG Undersecretary for Local Government Marlo L. Iringan
segments.text: are already included in our proposed budget for 2027.

segments.speaker: Rep. Arnie B. Fuentebella
segments.text: Next, we have Congressman Brian Yamsuan.

segments.speaker: Rep. Arnie B. Fuentebella
segments.text: Congressman Miro Quimbo, you have the floor, sir.

segments.speaker: Rep. Atty. Miro S. Quimbo
segments.text: Thank you very much, Mr. Chairman.

segments.speaker: Rep. Atty. Miro S. Quimbo
segments.text: May iksi lang yung tanong ko, actually.

segments.speaker: Rep. Atty. Miro S. Quimbo
segments.text: Right now, nag-meeting kami nung we had the initial meeting with the Department of Budget and Management when

segments.speaker: Rep. Atty. Miro S. Quimbo
segments.text: So we have a recurring issue.

segments.speaker: Rep. Atty. Miro S. Quimbo
segments.text: Not only in our city but in other cities as well.

segments.speaker: Rep. Atty. Miro S. Quimbo
segments.text: At tinuturo kami sa inyo to find a resolution.

segments.speaker: Rep. Atty. Miro S. Quimbo
segments.text: Ang nangyayari kasi sa amin is marami kaming mga programs under the GAA ng 2026, even 2025, na

segments.speaker: Rep. Atty. Miro S. Quimbo
segments.text: hindi kami nabibigyan ng building permit.

segments.speaker: Rep. Atty. Miro S. Quimbo
segments.text: For one reason or the other, nagpapabalik-balik kami,

segments.speaker: Rep. Atty. Miro S. Quimbo
segments.text: We comply, and then may panibago na naman silang requirement, requirements which were not present at that

segments.speaker: Rep. Atty. Miro S. Quimbo
segments.text: So, tinatanong ko sa DBM, ang sabi sa akin, sa DILG, kami humingi ng sangguni kung saan kami.

segments.speaker: Rep. Atty. Miro S. Quimbo
segments.text: Because obviously, when many of these programs are stranded at hindi sa nadi-dispense

segments.speaker: Rep. Atty. Miro S. Quimbo
segments.text: o na-carry out, yung programming ng gobyerno hindi nangyayari.

segments.speaker: Rep. Atty. Miro S. Quimbo
segments.text: At yung budget na yun ay nasasayang.

segments.speaker: Rep. Atty. Miro S. Quimbo
segments.text: So, we're talking about schools, we're talking about facilities, health facilities, but primarily

segments.speaker: Rep. Atty. Miro S. Quimbo
segments.text: Ano bang maitutulong sa amin dyan?

segments.speaker: Rep. Atty. Miro S. Quimbo
segments.text: Ano bang aming recourse pagdating sa DILG?

segments.speaker: DILG Undersecretary for Local Government Marlo L. Iringan
segments.text: Sir, as far as requirements for example for the issuance of building permits is concerned,

segments.speaker: DILG Undersecretary for Local Government Marlo L. Iringan
segments.text: there's already a set of requirements.

segments.speaker: DILG Undersecretary for Local Government Marlo L. Iringan
segments.text: And so long as the project proponent complies, faithfully complies with all the requirements,

segments.speaker: DILG Undersecretary for Local Government Marlo L. Iringan
segments.text: There should be no reason why the building permit is not issued.

segments.speaker: Rep. Atty. Miro S. Quimbo
segments.text: Yeah, but there are fine nuances of every requirement eh.

segments.speaker: Rep. Atty. Miro S. Quimbo
segments.text: Pag pinadala namin doon, biglang may location plan, kasi yung location plan, ito ginagawa na

segments.speaker: Rep. Atty. Miro S. Quimbo
segments.text: bordering already in fact beyond being reasonable.

segments.speaker: Rep. Atty. Miro S. Quimbo
segments.text: So pwede ba namin yung isangguni po sa inyo yun?

segments.speaker: Rep. Atty. Miro S. Quimbo
segments.text: Kasi I think this is already a matter that requires the attention of the DILG using its

segments.speaker: Rep. Atty. Miro S. Quimbo
segments.text: supervisory powers over the local government and local governments?

segments.speaker: DILG Undersecretary for Local Government Marlo L. Iringan
DILG Undersecretary for Local Government Marlo L. Iringan
segments.text: We would look into the concern that you have raised now.

segments.speaker: Rep. Atty. Miro S. Quimbo
segments.text: Bago ako sumulat sa inyo, kasi noon na sa DBM ko talaga gustong i-raise, pero

segments.speaker: Rep. Atty. Miro S. Quimbo
segments.text: ang sabi nga ng DBM, sa DILG ninyo yan kasi sila may mandato dyan.

segments.speaker: Rep. Atty. Miro S. Quimbo
segments.text: So, we will provide you with all the data we have so that malaman namin.

segments.speaker: Rep. Atty. Miro S. Quimbo
segments.text: Kasi, obviously, if it requires disciplinary action on the part or whether it's an admin

segments.speaker: Rep. Atty. Miro S. Quimbo
segments.text: proceeding or for that matter, sir, ayoko naman dalhin sa ombudsman at lahat,

segments.speaker: Rep. Atty. Miro S. Quimbo
segments.text: sa totoo lang, kasi ang mahahabla dyan are the regular employees

segments.speaker: Rep. Atty. Miro S. Quimbo
segments.text: na talagang pakiramdam ko at sinasabi nila, inuutusan lang naman daw sila na i-refuse

segments.speaker: Rep. Atty. Miro S. Quimbo
segments.text: yung aming application for building permits.

segments.speaker: Rep. Atty. Miro S. Quimbo
segments.text: So yun po nga akong sinasangguni sa inyo, Usec.

segments.speaker: DILG Undersecretary for Local Government Marlo L. Iringan
DILG Undersecretary for Local Government Marlo L. Iringan
segments.text: I would be happy to receive additional details from you, sir, so that we'll also be properly

segments.speaker: DILG Undersecretary for Local Government Marlo L. Iringan
segments.text: guided as to the course of action that the department will take.

segments.speaker: DILG Undersecretary for Local Government Marlo L. Iringan
Rep. Atty. Miro S. Quimbo
segments.text: At akin na lang, kayo ba yan? Hubert Gervacio?

segments.speaker: Rep. Atty. Miro S. Quimbo
segments.text: Kala ko parang biglang gumandang lalaki si Gervacio.

segments.speaker: Rep. Atty. Miro S. Quimbo
segments.text: So, yun lang po ang aking katanungan

segments.speaker: Rep. Atty. Miro S. Quimbo
segments.text: Ayoko nung magtanong sa ibang bagay

segments.speaker: Rep. Atty. Miro S. Quimbo
segments.text: Gusto ko lang po i-congratulate siyempre ating PNP

segments.speaker: Rep. Atty. Miro S. Quimbo
segments.text: Si PNP Chief ay meron ding roots sa Marikina

segments.speaker: Rep. Atty. Miro S. Quimbo
segments.text: Kaya nakikita ko po yung inyong galing at gandang lalaki. Ay alam kong taga-Marikina ho talaga kayo ha.

segments.speaker: Rep. Atty. Miro S. Quimbo
segments.text: At umaasa ako na makakatanggap po kami ng karampatang aksyon manggagaling po sa inyo.

segments.speaker: DILG Undersecretary for Local Government Marlo L. Iringan
Rep. Atty. Miro S. Quimbo
segments.text: I will hold you to that.

segments.speaker: Rep. Atty. Miro S. Quimbo
segments.text: Thank you very much, Mr. Chair.
