segments.speaker: BFP Officer-in-Charge Fire Chief Superintendent Wilberto Rico Neil A. Kwan Tiu
segments.text: And we are very fortunate, the courage of the applicant to tell this matter to the BFP.

segments.speaker: BFP Officer-in-Charge Fire Chief Superintendent Wilberto Rico Neil A. Kwan Tiu
segments.text: Kaya ho, nahuli at na-entrap po through the help of the CIDG Region 3.

segments.speaker: BFP Officer-in-Charge Fire Chief Superintendent Wilberto Rico Neil A. Kwan Tiu
segments.text: The good Secretary's instructions is very clear.

segments.speaker: BFP Officer-in-Charge Fire Chief Superintendent Wilberto Rico Neil A. Kwan Tiu
segments.text: Eradicate all forms of corruption and anomalies.

segments.speaker: BFP Officer-in-Charge Fire Chief Superintendent Wilberto Rico Neil A. Kwan Tiu
segments.text: Not only under the recruitment but as well as under the procurement of fire trucks and other equipments by the BFP.

segments.speaker: BFP Officer-in-Charge Fire Chief Superintendent Wilberto Rico Neil A. Kwan Tiu
segments.text: Ito ho yung ginagawa ng BFP ngayon, Sir. Nililinis po natin ang ating hanay.

segments.speaker: BFP Officer-in-Charge Fire Chief Superintendent Wilberto Rico Neil A. Kwan Tiu
segments.text: The Oplan Santindig is working the mechanism to ensure that anomalies and corruptions are being undertaken and addressed immediately.

segments.speaker: BFP Officer-in-Charge Fire Chief Superintendent Wilberto Rico Neil A. Kwan Tiu
BFP Officer-in-Charge Fire Chief Superintendent Wilberto Rico Neil A. Kwan Tiu
segments.text: Mangyari pong malinis natin through a new form of recruitment.

segments.speaker: BFP Officer-in-Charge Fire Chief Superintendent Wilberto Rico Neil A. Kwan Tiu
segments.text: We have e-hiring. It's an online. At the doorstep of the applicants, they can immediately apply to the Fire Bureau

segments.speaker: BFP Officer-in-Charge Fire Chief Superintendent Wilberto Rico Neil A. Kwan Tiu
segments.text: without spending much of their money by going to the regional offices.

segments.speaker: BFP Officer-in-Charge Fire Chief Superintendent Wilberto Rico Neil A. Kwan Tiu
segments.text: Tapos ang examination is being done online also through their cell phone.

segments.speaker: BFP Officer-in-Charge Fire Chief Superintendent Wilberto Rico Neil A. Kwan Tiu
segments.text: They can immediately get the results.

segments.speaker: BFP Officer-in-Charge Fire Chief Superintendent Wilberto Rico Neil A. Kwan Tiu
segments.text: With this kind of e-hiring mechanism, we can assure that at the very start of recruitment, medyo malinis po natin.

segments.speaker: BFP Officer-in-Charge Fire Chief Superintendent Wilberto Rico Neil A. Kwan Tiu
segments.text: Just very unfortunate that doon sa last stage na po, doon po pumasok.

segments.speaker: BFP Officer-in-Charge Fire Chief Superintendent Wilberto Rico Neil A. Kwan Tiu
segments.text: At alam nyo po yung anomalies, pag mayroon tayong in-in-place na safety net,

segments.speaker: BFP Officer-in-Charge Fire Chief Superintendent Wilberto Rico Neil A. Kwan Tiu
segments.text: nagkakaroon din ng evolution of mechanism kung paano din po nila malusutan yung ganitong klaseng mekanismo na ginagawa natin.

segments.speaker: BFP Officer-in-Charge Fire Chief Superintendent Wilberto Rico Neil A. Kwan Tiu
segments.text: But luckily, ito nga po, ang mga aplikante po natin ay nagising na alam na po nila na talagang ang direction po ng ating good secretary

segments.speaker: BFP Officer-in-Charge Fire Chief Superintendent Wilberto Rico Neil A. Kwan Tiu
segments.text: is really to cleanse the agency of any anomalies.

segments.speaker: BFP Officer-in-Charge Fire Chief Superintendent Wilberto Rico Neil A. Kwan Tiu
BFP Officer-in-Charge Fire Chief Superintendent Wilberto Rico Neil A. Kwan Tiu
segments.text: With what transpired during the entrapment operation, hopefully in the future or in the next succeeding recruitment,

segments.speaker: BFP Officer-in-Charge Fire Chief Superintendent Wilberto Rico Neil A. Kwan Tiu
segments.text: can be addressed these anomalies, Mr. Chair and Your Honor.

segments.speaker: Rep. Timothy Joseph E. Cayton
segments.text: It's good that the matter already reached your office, Navarra.

segments.speaker: Rep. Timothy Joseph E. Cayton
segments.text: And the matter will not go nationwide.

segments.speaker: Rep. Timothy Joseph E. Cayton
segments.text: And hopefully, the applicants will be hired on the basis of their qualifications.

segments.speaker: Rep. Timothy Joseph E. Cayton
segments.text: At sana po, siyempre, doon sa aming probinsya, we truly needed additional items for BFP, including the BFP.

segments.speaker: BFP Officer-in-Charge Fire Chief Superintendent Wilberto Rico Neil A. Kwan Tiu
BFP Officer-in-Charge Fire Chief Superintendent Wilberto Rico Neil A. Kwan Tiu
segments.text: Rest assured that our recruitment will be based on merit and fitness.

segments.speaker: BFP Officer-in-Charge Fire Chief Superintendent Wilberto Rico Neil A. Kwan Tiu
segments.text: It will be fair and transparent.

segments.speaker: BFP Officer-in-Charge Fire Chief Superintendent Wilberto Rico Neil A. Kwan Tiu
segments.text: And hopefully, every year we are given 2,000 recruits by DBM.

segments.speaker: BFP Officer-in-Charge Fire Chief Superintendent Wilberto Rico Neil A. Kwan Tiu
segments.text: But the present strength of the BFP right now is very far from the ideal money requirement.

segments.speaker: BFP Officer-in-Charge Fire Chief Superintendent Wilberto Rico Neil A. Kwan Tiu
segments.text: Of 78,000 for the entire across the country.

segments.speaker: BFP Officer-in-Charge Fire Chief Superintendent Wilberto Rico Neil A. Kwan Tiu
segments.text: Ang authorized strength po namin is only 43.

segments.speaker: BFP Officer-in-Charge Fire Chief Superintendent Wilberto Rico Neil A. Kwan Tiu
segments.text: So if we have 2,000 per year, it will take us 20 years to complete the money requirements.

segments.speaker: BFP Officer-in-Charge Fire Chief Superintendent Wilberto Rico Neil A. Kwan Tiu
segments.text: And hopefully, an additional 2,000 per year.

segments.speaker: BFP Officer-in-Charge Fire Chief Superintendent Wilberto Rico Neil A. Kwan Tiu
segments.text: Siguro po namin na transparent, fair, and based on merit and fitness po yung maging recruit na tayo.

segments.speaker: BFP Officer-in-Charge Fire Chief Superintendent Wilberto Rico Neil A. Kwan Tiu
BFP Officer-in-Charge Fire Chief Superintendent Wilberto Rico Neil A. Kwan Tiu
Rep. Timothy Joseph E. Cayton
segments.text: Kasi sayang din ho yung mga equipment natin.

segments.speaker: Rep. Timothy Joseph E. Cayton
segments.text: Fire trucks, fire stations kung wala ho tayong additional manpower.

segments.speaker: Rep. Timothy Joseph E. Cayton
segments.text: So yun yung constraints sa grassroots.

segments.speaker: Rep. Timothy Joseph E. Cayton
segments.text: So once again, anyway, napakabot na ho namin.

segments.speaker: Rep. Timothy Joseph E. Cayton
segments.text: Maraming salamat po, Chief and to our Chair.

segments.speaker: Rep. Arnie B. Fuentebella
segments.text: Thank you, Representative Tim Cayton and the DILG family.

segments.speaker: Rep. Arnie B. Fuentebella
segments.text: Now, we proceed to our second round.

segments.speaker: Rep. Dadah Kiram Ismula
segments.text: May katanungan lamang po ako muna sa NYC, sa National Youth Commission.

segments.speaker: Rep. Dadah Kiram Ismula
segments.text: Mr. Chair, kung maaari po, wala pa po akong tinatanong.

segments.speaker: Rep. Dadah Kiram Ismula
segments.text: Yung oras ko po, tumatakbo na.

segments.speaker: Rep. Dadah Kiram Ismula
segments.text: Sabi niyo po, Mr. Chair, magiging magaan kayo ngayon sa oras.

segments.speaker: Rep. Dadah Kiram Ismula
segments.text: Ito pong mga katanungan ay nanggaling din po sa ating mga Akbayan Youth members po natin.

segments.speaker: Rep. Dadah Kiram Ismula
segments.text: Based on the research of our office,

segments.speaker: Rep. Dadah Kiram Ismula
segments.text: from the PSA, 17.4% of Filipinos aged between 5 to 24 years old are currently not in school.

segments.speaker: Rep. Dadah Kiram Ismula
segments.text: That figure is alarming considering that public education is already free for all school-age children,

segments.speaker: Rep. Dadah Kiram Ismula
segments.text: while tertiary education is also free due to the University Access to Quality Tertiary Education Act.

segments.speaker: Rep. Dadah Kiram Ismula
segments.text: What programs, if any, are included in the 2027 NEP

segments.speaker: Rep. Dadah Kiram Ismula
segments.text: to address the various situations of our out-of-school youth?

segments.speaker: NYC Chairperson and CEO Joseph Francisco R. Ortega
segments.text: Madam Chair, actually, most of the events that we presented,

segments.speaker: NYC Chairperson and CEO Joseph Francisco R. Ortega
segments.text: all the out-of-school youth are invited.

segments.speaker: NYC Chairperson and CEO Joseph Francisco R. Ortega
segments.text: In fact, we are pushing for the legislation of the Magna Carta for Out-of-School Youth.

segments.speaker: NYC Chairperson and CEO Joseph Francisco R. Ortega
segments.text: We're a very big supporter of that.

segments.speaker: NYC Chairperson and CEO Joseph Francisco R. Ortega
segments.text: We do have, let's say, for instance, the pride parades that we did.

segments.speaker: NYC Chairperson and CEO Joseph Francisco R. Ortega
segments.text: We worked with out-of-school youth as well.

segments.speaker: NYC Chairperson and CEO Joseph Francisco R. Ortega
segments.text: We always invite Akbayan youth also for our West Philippine Sea activities.

segments.speaker: NYC Chairperson and CEO Joseph Francisco R. Ortega
segments.text: So, marami ma'am naman, hindi naman po kami restrictive sa events.

segments.speaker: Rep. Dadah Kiram Ismula
segments.text: Definitely, nag-a-agree po ako dyan dahil active na active po ang ating NYC.

segments.speaker: Rep. Dadah Kiram Ismula
segments.text: Isa pang katanungan, are there any planned coordinations with other government agencies

segments.speaker: Rep. Dadah Kiram Ismula
segments.text: to ensure that our young learners will either be afforded or an opportunity to resume schooling

segments.speaker: Rep. Dadah Kiram Ismula
segments.text: for those of working age to be gainfully employed absent exploitation or discrimination?

segments.speaker: NYC Chairperson and CEO Joseph Francisco R. Ortega
segments.text: We are currently under the National Advisory Council.

segments.speaker: NYC Chairperson and CEO Joseph Francisco R. Ortega
NYC Chairperson and CEO Joseph Francisco R. Ortega
segments.text: We are with DepEd being the chair.

segments.speaker: NYC Chairperson and CEO Joseph Francisco R. Ortega
segments.text: And we've raised these concerns in the National Advisory Council.

segments.speaker: NYC Chairperson and CEO Joseph Francisco R. Ortega
NYC Chairperson and CEO Joseph Francisco R. Ortega
segments.text: And on the part of NYC, since we are limited sa advocacy and policy

segments.speaker: NYC Chairperson and CEO Joseph Francisco R. Ortega
segments.text: outside of supporting the Magna Carta for Out-of-School Youth,

segments.speaker: NYC Chairperson and CEO Joseph Francisco R. Ortega
segments.text: we do have, it's like micro events like Kamustahan.

segments.speaker: NYC Chairperson and CEO Joseph Francisco R. Ortega
segments.text: not necessarily in line with the educational standards.

segments.speaker: NYC Chairperson and CEO Joseph Francisco R. Ortega
segments.text: But we do come up with programs that entail the economic standing of the youth

segments.speaker: NYC Chairperson and CEO Joseph Francisco R. Ortega
segments.text: given na wala po silang school.

segments.speaker: NYC Chairperson and CEO Joseph Francisco R. Ortega
segments.text: So, we have youth entrepreneurship program.

segments.speaker: NYC Chairperson and CEO Joseph Francisco R. Ortega
segments.text: Meron po kaming 2.5 million allocated for 2027.

segments.speaker: NYC Chairperson and CEO Joseph Francisco R. Ortega
segments.text: It's a bit small pero we can make do with it.

segments.speaker: NYC Chairperson and CEO Joseph Francisco R. Ortega
segments.text: At the same time, we're partnering with DOT and DTI.

segments.speaker: NYC Chairperson and CEO Joseph Francisco R. Ortega
segments.text: So, for the Philippine National Creative Youth Summit for next year.

segments.speaker: NYC Chairperson and CEO Joseph Francisco R. Ortega
segments.text: Ang goal po namin is mata po yung mga youth natin,

segments.speaker: NYC Chairperson and CEO Joseph Francisco R. Ortega
segments.text: lalo na yung out-of-school youth for arts and crafts.

segments.speaker: NYC Chairperson and CEO Joseph Francisco R. Ortega
segments.text: So, things where they can earn without having to finish school for now.

segments.speaker: Rep. Dadah Kiram Ismula
segments.text: And balita ko nga ang DTI may programa sila para sa ating mga youth.

segments.speaker: Rep. Dadah Kiram Ismula
segments.text: Yes, ma'am. We have the Young Farmers Challenge,

segments.speaker: Rep. Dadah Kiram Ismula
segments.text: if I'm not mistaken, with the Department of Agriculture.

segments.speaker: Rep. Dadah Kiram Ismula
segments.text: Dadako naman po ako sa isa sa mga nakakaligtaan.

segments.speaker: Rep. Dadah Kiram Ismula
segments.text: Sa ating National Commission on Muslim Filipinos.

segments.speaker: Rep. Dadah Kiram Ismula
segments.text: Napansin ko po mula kanina, wala po halos nagtatanong sa kanila.

segments.speaker: Rep. Dadah Kiram Ismula
segments.text: Kaya, tinake ko po talaga tong opportunity for a second round para maitanong naman sila.

segments.speaker: Rep. Dadah Kiram Ismula
segments.text: Unang-una, gusto ko po, Mr. Chair, i-congratulate si Secretary Sabudin

segments.speaker: Rep. Dadah Kiram Ismula
segments.text: for his re-appointment as Secretary of the NCMF.

segments.speaker: National Commission on Muslim Filipinos Secretary Sabuddin N. Abdurahim
Rep. Dadah Kiram Ismula
segments.text: And I believe so, itutuloy po ito ni Secretary Sabudin ngayong 2027 hanggang matapos ang kanyang termino.

segments.speaker: Rep. Dadah Kiram Ismula
segments.text: With that, napansin ko po, napakalaki ng nabawas na pondo sa inyo.

segments.speaker: Rep. Dadah Kiram Ismula
segments.text: Malaking bahagi po ng budget ng NCMF ang nakalaan para sa Hajj Operation.

segments.speaker: Rep. Dadah Kiram Ismula
segments.text: Ngunit, may mga ulat na kulang sa suporta sa mga medical needs ng mga pilgrims.

segments.speaker: Rep. Dadah Kiram Ismula
segments.text: Lalong-lalo pa, 30 days silang nasa pilgrim.

segments.speaker: Rep. Dadah Kiram Ismula
segments.text: Tapos, nabalitaan ko, binibigyan lang daw ng isang pirasong biogesic kung kinakailangan.

segments.speaker: Rep. Dadah Kiram Ismula
segments.text: Babalik na lang kung kailan kailangan ulit.

segments.speaker: Rep. Dadah Kiram Ismula
segments.text: With that, in this record, magkano ang eksaktong bahagi ng Hajj Operations Budget na nakalaan para sa medical needs ng pilgrims ngayong 2027 po?

segments.speaker: National Commission on Muslim Filipinos Secretary Sabuddin N. Abdurahim
National Commission on Muslim Filipinos Secretary Sabuddin N. Abdurahim
segments.text: On our NEP for 2027, it was allocated only P616,000 for medical expenses.

segments.speaker: National Commission on Muslim Filipinos Secretary Sabuddin N. Abdurahim
segments.text: Which is equivalent to P95 only per capita or per pilgrim on our projected 6,000 pilgrims for this 2027.

segments.speaker: National Commission on Muslim Filipinos Secretary Sabuddin N. Abdurahim
segments.text: So, yeah, Madam Chair, that's why we need to increase this budget.

segments.speaker: National Commission on Muslim Filipinos Secretary Sabuddin N. Abdurahim
segments.text: Although the NCMF proposes P6.1 million.

segments.speaker: National Commission on Muslim Filipinos Secretary Sabuddin N. Abdurahim
segments.text: To support the medical expenses of the pilgrims.

segments.speaker: National Commission on Muslim Filipinos Secretary Sabuddin N. Abdurahim
segments.text: So, but it is already included in our Tier 2.

segments.speaker: National Commission on Muslim Filipinos Secretary Sabuddin N. Abdurahim
segments.text: Hopefully, we can submit, if you may consider us, we're going to submit our enumerated list for our proposed Tier 2 budget in connection to our NEP.

segments.speaker: Rep. Dadah Kiram Ismula
segments.text: Mr. Chair, nakakalungkot no 95 pesos para sa 30 days.

segments.speaker: Rep. Dadah Kiram Ismula
segments.text: Sakaling senior citizen na, mahina na ang tuhod, 95 pesos para sa gamot.

segments.speaker: Rep. Dadah Kiram Ismula
segments.text: Napakakulang po ng budget nito, Mr. Chair.

segments.speaker: Rep. Dadah Kiram Ismula
segments.text: At kailangan pong tugunan nito, Mr. Chair, kasi nasa ibang bansa sila.

segments.speaker: Rep. Dadah Kiram Ismula
segments.text: At trabaho po ng ating gobyerno, naalagaan din po sila.

segments.speaker: Rep. Dadah Kiram Ismula
segments.text: Hindi po dahil sa reliyon lang yung ginagawa nilang practice na ito.

segments.speaker: Rep. Dadah Kiram Ismula
segments.text: Eh, trabaho po, mandato po ng NCMF yun.

segments.speaker: Rep. Dadah Kiram Ismula
segments.text: Hindi po nila masasecure ang buhay ng ating mga pilgrim kung wala po silang pondo or sapat na pondo para isecure yung buhay nila, no?

segments.speaker: Rep. Dadah Kiram Ismula
segments.text: With that, Mr. Chair, if I may be allowed, gusto ko lamang pong itake yung opportunity na pakinggan naman po ang ating good secretary na ano pa po ang nabawas sa inyo, Mr. Secretary?

segments.speaker: National Commission on Muslim Filipinos Secretary Sabuddin N. Abdurahim
National Commission on Muslim Filipinos Secretary Sabuddin N. Abdurahim
National Commission on Muslim Filipinos Secretary Sabuddin N. Abdurahim
National Commission on Muslim Filipinos Secretary Sabuddin N. Abdurahim
segments.text: If not all these are approved, at least we have our three top-priority programs to be considered by the House.

segments.speaker: National Commission on Muslim Filipinos Secretary Sabuddin N. Abdurahim
segments.text: The first one is the Madaris, a traditional education for madrasa, which is P87.5 million, a continuing project.

segments.speaker: National Commission on Muslim Filipinos Secretary Sabuddin N. Abdurahim
segments.text: And the second is the Halal, Philippine Halal Industry Growth and Muslim Community Economic Empowerment Program,

segments.speaker: National Commission on Muslim Filipinos Secretary Sabuddin N. Abdurahim
segments.text: which is amounting to P89.494 million.

segments.speaker: National Commission on Muslim Filipinos Secretary Sabuddin N. Abdurahim
segments.text: And of course, our Hajj Operation Modernization Program.

segments.speaker: National Commission on Muslim Filipinos Secretary Sabuddin N. Abdurahim
segments.text: Kasama na po doon yung P6.1 million, pero ang total po doon is P24,537,000.

segments.speaker: National Commission on Muslim Filipinos Secretary Sabuddin N. Abdurahim
segments.text: Yun lang po. Sana, kung hindi mag-consider lahat ng request namin, at least yung top-priority programs po.

segments.speaker: Rep. Arnie B. Fuentebella
segments.text: Have you written this? Have you written to Speaker Bojie through Chairman Mika Suansing regarding dun sa mga additional..?

segments.speaker: Rep. Arnie B. Fuentebella
segments.text: Submit it po sa akin, and iikot pa po ako sa inyo, NAPOLCOM. Kinulang lang po yung oras ko.

segments.speaker: National Commission on Muslim Filipinos Secretary Sabuddin N. Abdurahim
Rep. Arnie B. Fuentebella
segments.text: But definitely, I will fight it out, okay?

segments.speaker: Rep. Arnie B. Fuentebella
segments.text: So I will support it, ma'am.

segments.speaker: Rep. Arnie B. Fuentebella
segments.text: Especially sa ating mga kapatid na mga Muslim. Maraming salamat po.

segments.speaker: Rep. Dadah Kiram Ismula
segments.text: Mr. Chair, kung inyo pong napapansin, ang PNP, BFP at iba pa pong ahensya under nito, kung sila po ang hinihingi nila pong

segments.speaker: Rep. Dadah Kiram Ismula
segments.text: NCMF, million lang po ang kulang nila.

segments.speaker: Rep. Dadah Kiram Ismula
segments.text: So siguro naman po kaya naman po natin maibigay

segments.speaker: Rep. Dadah Kiram Ismula
segments.text: and I am very thankful sa ating Chair sa pag-suporta po dito. Bago po ako matapos, iaalaw ko naman po isang katanungan sa ating

segments.speaker: Rep. Dadah Kiram Ismula
segments.text: PCW. Isa rin pong sektor na nakakaligtaan din po natin,

segments.speaker: Rep. Dadah Kiram Ismula
segments.text: Mr. Chair, na ito po naman ang ahensya na nagtutugon ng

segments.speaker: Rep. Dadah Kiram Ismula
segments.text: pangangailangan at nagsusuporta po sa ating mga kababaihan. Kaya po sa

segments.speaker: Rep. Dadah Kiram Ismula
segments.text: PCW, ma'am, I believe, nabawasan din po kayo, di

segments.speaker: PCW Chairperson Ermelita V. Valdeavilla
segments.text: ba? Nabawasan po. Ano-ano po yung mga nakulang sa inyong

segments.speaker: PCW Chairperson Ermelita V. Valdeavilla
segments.text: Philippine Commission on Women ay nagko-conduct po ng mga trainings kasama mga

segments.speaker: PCW Chairperson Ermelita V. Valdeavilla
segments.text: local government units, kasama ng national government agencies.

segments.speaker: PCW Chairperson Ermelita V. Valdeavilla
segments.text: So may plano po kami sanang,

segments.speaker: PCW Chairperson Ermelita V. Valdeavilla
segments.text: webinars with around 1,000 participants each webinar, magkaroon kami ng

segments.speaker: PCW Chairperson Ermelita V. Valdeavilla
segments.text: center for gender research and capacity building. Tapos yung sinabi ko nga po kanina, ang kababaihan po dapat may

segments.speaker: PCW Chairperson Ermelita V. Valdeavilla
segments.text: participation sa governance. Yung kanilang boses naririnig po ng mga

segments.speaker: PCW Chairperson Ermelita V. Valdeavilla
segments.text: local government units. Pero wala po tayong

segments.speaker: PCW Chairperson Ermelita V. Valdeavilla
segments.text: Meron po tayong gender budget, may GAD budget ang

segments.speaker: PCW Chairperson Ermelita V. Valdeavilla
segments.text: local government units, pero hindi po kasama sa nakikinabang doon ang kababaihan. So kaya po kailangan-kailangan namin bumaba sa subnational

segments.speaker: PCW Chairperson Ermelita V. Valdeavilla
segments.text: para makarating kami doon sa area na pwede namin silang makasama sa advocacies at

segments.speaker: Rep. Dadah Kiram Ismula
segments.text: maturuan namin sila kung paano mag-advocate. Magkano po, Madam Chair, Mr. Chair, Madam Chair,

segments.speaker: PCW Chairperson Ermelita V. Valdeavilla
segments.text: yung inyong nakulangan? Ibibigay po sana namin sa inyo ngayon, yung buong listahan ng hinihingi

segments.speaker: Rep. Dadah Kiram Ismula
segments.text: namin. Mr. Chair, Madam Chair, hindi po ako, kay Chair na lang po natin ipasa po. Mr. Chair,

segments.speaker: Rep. Dadah Kiram Ismula
segments.text: dahil nabanggit ninyo na rin po kanina na iikutan ninyo rin po silang lahat, baka po maaari

segments.speaker: Rep. Arnie B. Fuentebella
segments.text: include na rin po natin ang PCW, Mr. Chair. Yes, just kindly write a letter addressed to Speaker

segments.speaker: Rep. Arnie B. Fuentebella
segments.text: Bojie Dy III, Faustino Bojie Dy III, through Chairman Mika Suansing.

segments.speaker: PCW Chairperson Ermelita V. Valdeavilla
segments.text: Mr. Chair, at maraming salamat po.

segments.speaker: Rep. Arnie B. Fuentebella
segments.text: And sigurado yun pong i-submit po sa office of Speaker

segments.speaker: Rep. Arnie B. Fuentebella
segments.text: But bigyan po ako ng kopya.

segments.speaker: Rep. Dadah Kiram Ismula
segments.text: Mr. Chair. And to close, Mr. Chair, if I may be allowed, mukhang

segments.speaker: Rep. Dadah Kiram Ismula
segments.text: sakto lang ako sa oras ko. In closing, I would like to manifest my full support sa pagtaas ng

segments.speaker: Rep. Dadah Kiram Ismula
segments.text: budget ng National Commission on Muslim Filipinos at ng Philippine Commission on Women, which notably

segments.speaker: Rep. Dadah Kiram Ismula
segments.text: were decreased for fiscal year 2027. Ang NCMF ay mahalaga para sa karapatan ng Muslim Filipinos,

segments.speaker: Rep. Dadah Kiram Ismula
segments.text: ang pangunahing ahensya na nagtataguyod ng gender equality at karapatan ng kababaihan. Parehong

segments.speaker: Rep. Dadah Kiram Ismula
segments.text: kritikal ang kanilang mandato para sa inclusive development ng bansa. Kaya't buong suporta po ako

segments.speaker: Rep. Dadah Kiram Ismula
segments.text: sa pagdagdag ng kanilang budget upang masiguro na ang Muslim Filipinos at kababaihan ay lubos na

segments.speaker: Rep. Dadah Kiram Ismula
segments.text: protektado at empowered. Maraming salamat, Mr. Chair.

segments.speaker: Rep. Arnie B. Fuentebella
segments.text: Not here. From the minority, Representative Sara

segments.speaker: Rep. Sarah Jane I. Elago
segments.text: Maraming salamat, Mr. Chair. Magtatanong po ako tungkol sa implementation ng solo parents cash subsidy.

segments.speaker: Rep. Antonio L. Tinio
segments.text: So, kanina may nirace akong issue and regarding yung problema nga sa mga records, yung karpeta.

segments.speaker: Rep. Antonio L. Tinio
segments.text: At may initial na napabutin tayo sa BJMP.

segments.speaker: Rep. Antonio L. Tinio
segments.text: However, may nakausap, actually nandito sila ngayon, grupo ng mga former detainees at mga advocates for detainees' rights.

segments.speaker: Rep. Antonio L. Tinio
segments.text: And they brought something to my attention na tama po ba na mayroong patakaran ng BJMP regarding visits.

segments.speaker: Rep. Antonio L. Tinio
segments.text: Na ang pinahintulutan nyo lang ay ang family.

segments.speaker: Rep. Antonio L. Tinio
segments.text: Yung mga pamilya ang pwedeng bumisita.

segments.speaker: Rep. Antonio L. Tinio
segments.text: Pamilya lamang ang pwedeng bumisita apart from yung legal representation or lawyers.

segments.speaker: BJMP Chief Jail Director Efren A. Nemeño
BJMP Chief Jail Director Efren A. Nemeño
segments.text: Per policy, Mr. Chairman, Your Honor, the lawyer, the doctors, and the direct family of the PDL are allowed to visit.

segments.speaker: BJMP Chief Jail Director Efren A. Nemeño
segments.text: And the PDL can also request to the warden kung may gusto pa siyang mag-visit sa kanya.

segments.speaker: BJMP Chief Jail Director Efren A. Nemeño
segments.text: But hindi po ito, Your Honor, na pupunta yung bisita doon na hindi nag-request yung PDL natin.

segments.speaker: Rep. Antonio L. Tinio
segments.text: Well, Chair, ito nga yung nakakarating sa amin na ulat na kakaiba yung patakaran nyo with regard to non-direct family members.

segments.speaker: Rep. Antonio L. Tinio
segments.text: At ang sinabi rin sa akin na hindi ganito ang patakaran ng BuCor, halimbawa.

segments.speaker: Rep. Antonio L. Tinio
segments.text: Na mas kayo pa, BJMP, ang may napaka-strictong patakaran na mainly direct family ang puwede.

segments.speaker: Rep. Antonio L. Tinio
segments.text: Pero may iba pang requirements kapag hindi direct.

segments.speaker: Rep. Antonio L. Tinio
segments.text: Marami pong may mga kaso po na mayroon tayong mga detainees na hindi maaaring nasa ibang isla, malayo.

segments.speaker: Rep. Antonio L. Tinio
segments.text: Ang kanilang direct family, ibig sabihin kahit talimbawa best friend ka, kababata mo, hindi basta-bastang pwede mong bisitahin.

segments.speaker: Rep. Antonio L. Tinio
segments.text: Ganun po ang inuulat sa amin.

segments.speaker: Rep. Antonio L. Tinio
segments.text: Mga konkretong instances sa Bohol at saka sa Negros, ganun daw po.

segments.speaker: Rep. Antonio L. Tinio
segments.text: At sinasabi rin na ang BuCor hindi ganun, mas mahigpit pa kayo sa BuCor.

segments.speaker: Rep. Antonio L. Tinio
segments.text: So, sa BuCor, alam natin, iyon ay para sa mga convicted.

segments.speaker: Rep. Antonio L. Tinio
segments.text: Whereas ang BJMP, detainees, innocent until proven guilty in the end. Diba?

segments.speaker: Rep. Antonio L. Tinio
segments.text: So bakit po, mas mahigpit pa kayo?

segments.speaker: Rep. Antonio L. Tinio
segments.text: At hindi ba ito paglabag sa karapatan?

segments.speaker: Rep. Antonio L. Tinio
segments.text: Na naghihigpit kayo sa karapatan na mabisita, kahit ng hindi direct family.

segments.speaker: Rep. Antonio L. Tinio
segments.text: Dahil nga, hindi sa lahat ng pagkakataon, ay readily nandyan bilang support system ang direct family.

segments.speaker: Rep. Antonio L. Tinio
segments.text: Gusto ko lang po natin marinig, bakit may ganitong partikular na sa BJMP lang?

segments.speaker: BJMP Chief Jail Director Efren A. Nemeño
segments.text: Mr. Chairman, Your Honor, hindi naman po namin pinagbabawal yung hindi direct family na bumisita sa jail facility natin.

segments.speaker: BJMP Chief Jail Director Efren A. Nemeño
segments.text: Ang pinahintulutan po natin yan, pag yung PDL po natin mismo, ay mag-allow sa person na yun na bibisita sa kanya.

segments.speaker: BJMP Chief Jail Director Efren A. Nemeño
segments.text: Hindi lang po natin ina-allow na automatic na pagdating doon, wala siyang, hindi naman in-allow ng PDL yun na bibisita ka sa kanya.

segments.speaker: BJMP Chief Jail Director Efren A. Nemeño
segments.text: Baka kasi, hindi naman gusto ng PDL yung tao na yun na bibisita sa kanya.

segments.speaker: BJMP Chief Jail Director Efren A. Nemeño
segments.text: Kaya, we need the clearance first.

segments.speaker: BJMP Chief Jail Director Efren A. Nemeño
segments.text: From the PDL na pwedeng bumisita sa kanya yung taong yun.

segments.speaker: BJMP Chief Jail Director Efren A. Nemeño

segments.speaker: Rep. Antonio L. Tinio
segments.text: So, ibig sabihin, kailangan, bago dumating kailangan, mayroon authorization muna sa bisita?

segments.speaker: Rep. Antonio L. Tinio
segments.text: Edi simple lang naman yan eh, itatanong lang naman sa kanya kung okay ba sa iyo na may bumisita sa iyo?

segments.speaker: Rep. Antonio L. Tinio
segments.text: Tama kayo, importante yung consent ng PDL.

segments.speaker: Rep. Antonio L. Tinio
segments.text: Pero then and there, pwede naman tanungin siya, o gusto mo bang makita to?

segments.speaker: Rep. Antonio L. Tinio
segments.text: Ito, pag sinabi niyang yes, hindi ba satisfied na?

segments.text: E hindi niya alam. Ito, paano niya marirequest yun?

segments.speaker: Rep. Renee Louise M. Co
segments.text: My next question is in relation po to the Barangay Development Program.

segments.speaker: Rep. Renee Louise M. Co
segments.text: naging parang 10 million per barangay, naging 5 million na lang per barangay.

segments.speaker: Rep. Renee Louise M. Co
segments.text: And dumami po yung mga barangay na beneficiaries neto.

segments.speaker: Rep. Renee Louise M. Co
segments.text: May tanong ko, ano po bang actual physical and financial accomplishment rate

segments.speaker: Rep. Renee Louise M. Co
segments.text: ng Barangay Development Program na bilyong piso po talaga yung nailalaan dito?

segments.speaker: Rep. Renee Louise M. Co
segments.text: And paano po na-audit ng DILG?

segments.speaker: Rep. Renee Louise M. Co
segments.text: At nabiverify yung authenticity ng ECLIP beneficiaries?

segments.speaker: DILG Undersecretary for Local Government Marlo L. Iringan
segments.text: Thank you, Mr. Chair. I will reply to that. The DILG is only one of the many agencies under the Ending Local Communist Armed Conflict Task Force, and the responsibility of the DILG is to facilitate the consultation at the barangay level between and among the people and barangay officials so that they can identify priority programs funded by the Barangay Development Program.

segments.speaker: DILG Undersecretary for Local Government Marlo L. Iringan
segments.text: For 2021, the delivery rate is 99.86%. For 2022, it's 100%. For 2023, it's 98.48%. For 2024, dun sa original na allocation, 2.5 million, it's 90%. And then there's an additional 5 million which was given towards the third quarter or last quarter of the year. The delivery rate is 71%.

segments.speaker: DILG Undersecretary for Local Government Marlo L. Iringan
segments.text: For 2025, our performance is at the level of 29%. For 2026, wala pong completed na project. As much as the fund was released only the second quarter and the third quarter of this year, Mr. Chair.

segments.speaker: Rep. Renee Louise M. Co
segments.text: Can these documents be submitted to the representation, Mr. Chair?

segments.speaker: DILG Undersecretary for Local Government Marlo L. Iringan
segments.text: Gladly, Mr. Chair. We will provide a copy to the committee.

segments.speaker: Rep. Renee Louise M. Co
segments.text: So yung tanong ko rin po sa...

segments.speaker: Rep. Renee Louise M. Co
segments.text: ...na isang bahagi. Paano po nagiging bahagi yung DILG? Ano pong ginagawa ng DILG to audit and verify yung authenticity? So isang bahagi yung distribution, di ba po? Pero pagkatapos na na-distribute, paano po na-insure na nagigamit po yun sa purposes stated?

segments.speaker: DILG Undersecretary for Local Government Marlo L. Iringan
segments.text: Yung support to Barangay Development Program is lumped under the Local Government Support Fund. And for this purpose, the DILG was given the responsibility to do the monitoring and evaluation.

segments.speaker: DILG Undersecretary for Local Government Marlo L. Iringan
segments.text: And as mentioned by the Secretary a while ago, we hired, at this time, 700 engineers and program evaluation officers to monitor not only the SBDP, this fund, but also the other financial assistance to local government units, the growth equity fund, which are under the LGSF, Mr. Chair.

segments.speaker: DILG Undersecretary for Local Government Marlo L. Iringan
segments.text: So we have people on the ground to make sure that these projects are implemented accordingly, and we require our local government units to upload...

segments.speaker: DILG Undersecretary for Local Government Marlo L. Iringan
segments.text: ...the progress status of the projects in the Subay Bayan portal regularly, Mr. Chair.

segments.speaker: Rep. Renee Louise M. Co
segments.text: Ang re-report po natin, Mr. Chair, ay meron po tayong advocates that wish to access yung mga relevant documents nga po. Yan, for example, ASARO on the website. Pero unfortunately, ay hindi po siya available. Parang last year, kayang ma-access yung ilang documents, pero this year ay hindi na po.

segments.speaker: Rep. Renee Louise M. Co
segments.text: So ayaw natin magkaroon ng sitwasyon.

segments.speaker: Rep. Renee Louise M. Co
segments.text: Kung saan hindi po kaya ma-scrutinize ng mamamayan, maging bahagi ng paano ba na-ensure na yung pondo ng gobyerno galing sa pera ng mamamayan ay hindi po na-account kung saan na pupunta.

segments.speaker: Rep. Renee Louise M. Co
segments.text: But you mentioned po, may engineers, etc. So may audit processes po ang DILG dito. So maaari po bang makapagsubmit ang DILG ng full financial and physical performance audit ng funds under BDP?

segments.speaker: Rep. Renee Louise M. Co
segments.text: And yung disbursement breakdown ng ECLIP for the last year, Mr. Chair?

segments.speaker: DILG Undersecretary for Local Government Marlo L. Iringan
segments.text: Yes, Mr. Chair. What we can provide is the status of the physical project completion and the fund releases. As to the scrutiny of how the funds are used, we leave it to the Commission on Audit.

segments.speaker: DILG Undersecretary for Local Government Marlo L. Iringan
segments.text: I also would like to add, Mr. Chair, that the SBDP projects are subject to third-party monitoring.

segments.speaker: DILG Undersecretary for Local Government Marlo L. Iringan
DILG Undersecretary for Local Government Marlo L. Iringan
segments.text: ...coordinated with the CSOs and NGOs to help us monitor the implementation of the SBDP projects.

segments.speaker: Rep. Renee Louise M. Co
segments.text: And to clarify, yung third-party na in-engage to monitor, ang DILG po ang nag-engage sa kanya?

segments.speaker: DILG Undersecretary for Local Government Marlo L. Iringan
segments.text: Yes, Mr. Chair, but there's a sort of criteria in determining the third-party monitor.

segments.speaker: Rep. Renee Louise M. Co
segments.text: So is the DILG also a recipient of the reports of this third-party in its monitoring? Baka po pwedeng masubmit din po iyon sa committee?

segments.speaker: DILG Undersecretary for Local Government Marlo L. Iringan
segments.text: Yes, Mr. Chair. We, naturally, we are the first group which benefit from the report of the third-party monitors.

segments.speaker: DILG Undersecretary for Local Government Marlo L. Iringan
segments.text: And we would gladly provide you a copy of the report.

segments.text: My next question is in relation naman po sa active shooting drills that na-announce po, supposedly this week mangyayari pero na-push back po to September.

segments.speaker: Rep. Renee Louise M. Co
segments.text: May I ask kung meron na po bang comprehensive plan and timeline kung paano po ito isasagawa sa bansa?

segments.speaker: Rep. Renee Louise M. Co
segments.text: Bahagi po ba ang DILG sa pagplano po nito, Mr. Chair?

segments.speaker: DILG Undersecretary for Plans and Programs Jon Paulo V. Salvahan
DILG Undersecretary for Plans and Programs Jon Paulo V. Salvahan
segments.text: The DepEd po is spearheading this. It will be a school-led event and they have issued guidelines.

segments.speaker: DILG Undersecretary for Plans and Programs Jon Paulo V. Salvahan
segments.text: And they are coordinating with the PNP, the DILG, and the BFP so far as the drills are concerned.

segments.speaker: DILG Undersecretary for Plans and Programs Jon Paulo V. Salvahan
segments.text: Ang plan po dito is they will conduct simulation drills in schools.

segments.speaker: DILG Undersecretary for Plans and Programs Jon Paulo V. Salvahan
segments.text: And then there will be a group of experts like, for example, members from the PNP, DILG,

segments.speaker: DILG Undersecretary for Plans and Programs Jon Paulo V. Salvahan
segments.text: which will somehow comment on how the drills are being conducted.

segments.speaker: DILG Undersecretary for Plans and Programs Jon Paulo V. Salvahan
segments.text: Right now, the guidelines po are being refined by the DepEd in coordination with the DILG regional offices

segments.speaker: DILG Undersecretary for Plans and Programs Jon Paulo V. Salvahan
segments.text: and then mga PNP personnel po natin sa regions.

segments.speaker: DILG Undersecretary for Plans and Programs Jon Paulo V. Salvahan
segments.text: And then as soon as the guidelines are finished,

segments.speaker: DILG Undersecretary for Plans and Programs Jon Paulo V. Salvahan
segments.text: we will resume with the, we will schedule the drills.

segments.speaker: DILG Undersecretary for Plans and Programs Jon Paulo V. Salvahan
segments.text: It's also taking into consideration the comments from the several associations

segments.speaker: DILG Undersecretary for Plans and Programs Jon Paulo V. Salvahan
segments.text: so far as mental health, mental well-being of the children are concerned.

segments.speaker: Rep. Renee Louise M. Co
segments.text: Mr. Chair, ang concerned kasi natin, well, tama namang nare-refine pa yung guidelines,

segments.speaker: Rep. Renee Louise M. Co
segments.text: pero ang report sa atin, September 1, diba, ang target day na unang isasagawa na ito.

segments.speaker: Rep. Renee Louise M. Co
segments.text: So, kaya po bang masubmit yung guidelines, for example, to this committee upon its completion?

segments.speaker: Rep. Renee Louise M. Co
segments.text: And I assume, supposedly, complete na siya by Tuesday bago maglunsad ng una. Tama po ba?

segments.speaker: DILG Undersecretary for Plans and Programs Jon Paulo V. Salvahan
segments.text: As of now, we have not received any specific date as to the rescheduling po.

segments.speaker: DILG Undersecretary for Plans and Programs Jon Paulo V. Salvahan
segments.text: We were informed by the DepEd that it might be rescheduled to next week.

segments.speaker: DILG Undersecretary for Plans and Programs Jon Paulo V. Salvahan
segments.text: Wala pong definite date kung kailan next week.

segments.speaker: DILG Undersecretary for Plans and Programs Jon Paulo V. Salvahan
segments.text: But surely, Mr. Chair, as soon as we receive the guidelines, we will share it to the committee.

segments.speaker: DILG Undersecretary for Plans and Programs Jon Paulo V. Salvahan
Rep. Renee Louise M. Co
segments.text: Mr. Chair, ang pina-flag na lang din natin, so narinig naman natin, syempre, yung considerations ng mental health,

segments.speaker: Rep. Renee Louise M. Co
segments.text: pero may mga studies from other countries kung saan mas madalas ang shooters,

segments.speaker: Rep. Renee Louise M. Co
segments.text: at ayaw natin maulit yun dito at mangyari dito, na yung effect niya sa kabataan ay nakakare-relieve ng trauma,

segments.text: So, yung paglabas po ng guidelines nito as soon as possible at ma-operate, at ma-scrutinize din po kung paano siya magagawa,

segments.speaker: Rep. Renee Louise M. Co
segments.text: ay yun na po ang pinaka-matutulong kung paano natin, syempre, ma-respondehan nito.

segments.speaker: Rep. Renee Louise M. Co
segments.text: So, your last question, Mr. Chair, if I am allowed.

segments.speaker: Rep. Renee Louise M. Co
segments.text: Thank you very much, Mr. Chair.

segments.speaker: Rep. Renee Louise M. Co
segments.text: This will be on the National Youth Commission po, Mr. Chair, because usapin din, syempre, yung anti-political,

segments.speaker: Rep. Renee Louise M. Co
segments.text: So, nasa SK lang, and meron din po now, at least, proposals after so long at the national level and applicable to all elective positions.

segments.speaker: Rep. Renee Louise M. Co
segments.text: Mas mahigpit pa nga yung sa youth as it stands.

segments.speaker: Rep. Renee Louise M. Co
segments.text: But, nonetheless, right now, we have reports on the ground na hindi din naman, or ang hirap din, i-implement ito.

segments.speaker: Rep. Renee Louise M. Co
segments.text: May mga tumatakbo pa rin na bahagi ng political dynasties.

segments.speaker: Rep. Renee Louise M. Co
segments.text: Or even labag doon sa provision provided in law.

segments.speaker: Rep. Renee Louise M. Co
segments.text: Kasi it's up to essentially any person to file at COMELEC ng complaint dito.

segments.speaker: Rep. Renee Louise M. Co
segments.text: So, siguro, ang tanong ko na lang, paano po ba makakatulong ng National Youth Commission sa pag-implement ng existing provisions in law

segments.speaker: Rep. Renee Louise M. Co
segments.text: para on the prohibition of political dynasties kahit isang ganyang kabataan?

segments.text: Madam Chair, the law limits us, our mandate, to recommend or encourage,

segments.speaker: NYC Chairperson and CEO Joseph Francisco R. Ortega
segments.text: just to share with you, baka magalit sa akin yung committee chair who's my cousin.

segments.speaker: NYC Chairperson and CEO Joseph Francisco R. Ortega
segments.text: Actually, I'm a member of the Anti-Dynasties Network.

segments.speaker: NYC Chairperson and CEO Joseph Francisco R. Ortega
segments.text: And it's not to go against sitting dynasties.

segments.speaker: NYC Chairperson and CEO Joseph Francisco R. Ortega
segments.text: It's really just more to push for equal rights for people to join politics.

segments.speaker: NYC Chairperson and CEO Joseph Francisco R. Ortega
segments.text: So, what we do is we try to incorporate voters' youth suffrage programs.

segments.speaker: NYC Chairperson and CEO Joseph Francisco R. Ortega
segments.text: So, in this case, this year, Madam Chair, may partnership kami ng Commission on Human Rights.

segments.speaker: NYC Chairperson and CEO Joseph Francisco R. Ortega
segments.text: Actually, they didn't have a budget. They only had 600,000.

segments.speaker: NYC Chairperson and CEO Joseph Francisco R. Ortega
segments.text: And the National Youth Commission actually realigned some of our funds to the amount of about 4.8 million.

segments.speaker: NYC Chairperson and CEO Joseph Francisco R. Ortega
segments.text: So, they can do a regional youth suffrage program on their own.

segments.speaker: NYC Chairperson and CEO Joseph Francisco R. Ortega
segments.text: So, for now, Madam Chair, I think that's the best we can do, is to really educate them on the grassroots.

segments.speaker: NYC Chairperson and CEO Joseph Francisco R. Ortega
segments.text: Ang last na lang po, Mr. Chair, dahil alam kong underfunded na nga ang NYC, marami nang gawain, pero ang mandate pa is recommendatory.

segments.speaker: Rep. Renee Louise M. Co
segments.text: Pero can I ask an update? Ano po ba ang mga recommendations na nagawa ng NYC in relation sa pag-implement ng provision na ito?

segments.speaker: Rep. Renee Louise M. Co
segments.text: Baka po may, meron po ba siyang studies sa mga binigay niya po sa COMELEC, ilan po ba ang na-actionan dito?

segments.speaker: NYC Chairperson and CEO Joseph Francisco R. Ortega
segments.text: madam sure we don't have that data right now we have to defer to comelec however we would be open

segments.speaker: NYC Chairperson and CEO Joseph Francisco R. Ortega

segments.text: Ideally, the basis for the suspension of classes should be 11pm forecast of PAGASA

segments.speaker: DILG Undersecretary for Local Government Marlo L. Iringan
segments.text: so that the following day, parents and students will no longer have to go to school

segments.speaker: DILG Undersecretary for Local Government Marlo L. Iringan
DILG Undersecretary for Local Government Marlo L. Iringan
segments.text: I do believe that PAGASA is also doing its best to provide most accurate information

segments.speaker: DILG Undersecretary for Local Government Marlo L. Iringan
segments.text: to all local governments and to all our citizens.

segments.speaker: Rep. Anna York P. Bondoc, M.D.
Rep. Anna York P. Bondoc, M.D.
segments.text: Sa mga climate change threatened and forever flooded municipalities,

segments.speaker: Rep. Anna York P. Bondoc, M.D.
segments.text: first of all, I would like to commend the PNP sa kanila pong tulong sa amin sa 4th District of Pampanga.

segments.speaker: Rep. Anna York P. Bondoc, M.D.
segments.text: Napakasipag po nila and they were with us last year and this year.

segments.speaker: Rep. Anna York P. Bondoc, M.D.
segments.text: And sila po nagbibigay ng libring sakay so gusto ko po silang pasalamatan.

segments.speaker: Rep. Anna York P. Bondoc, M.D.
segments.text: Now, the second question sa amin, I would also like to thank the BFP.

segments.speaker: Rep. Anna York P. Bondoc, M.D.
Rep. Anna York P. Bondoc, M.D.
segments.text: So, my question is, pwede po ba natin silang i-capacitate at i-train?

segments.speaker: Rep. Anna York P. Bondoc, M.D.
segments.text: At saka nagahanap po talaga sila ng mga gamit for water rescue.

segments.speaker: Rep. Anna York P. Bondoc, M.D.
segments.text: Can we identify po specific flooded areas like the entire Pampanga or maybe the 4th District of Pampanga?

segments.speaker: Rep. Anna York P. Bondoc, M.D.
segments.text: Kasi wala man po kami mga boats eh.

segments.speaker: Rep. Anna York P. Bondoc, M.D.
Rep. Anna York P. Bondoc, M.D.
segments.text: And I think that we should...

segments.speaker: Rep. Anna York P. Bondoc, M.D.
segments.text: Identify areas that need to be rescued po.

segments.speaker: Rep. Anna York P. Bondoc, M.D.
Rep. Anna York P. Bondoc, M.D.
segments.text: And can you share with us what you are doing po for water rescue, lalo na po sa flooded areas?

segments.speaker: BFP Officer-in-Charge Fire Chief Superintendent Wilberto Rico Neil A. Kwan Tiu
BFP Officer-in-Charge Fire Chief Superintendent Wilberto Rico Neil A. Kwan Tiu
segments.text: Yung Bureau for Protection plays a very vital role pagdating po sa HIDR, especially on flooding.

segments.speaker: BFP Officer-in-Charge Fire Chief Superintendent Wilberto Rico Neil A. Kwan Tiu
segments.text: Yung nakikita niyo po na nakatancherate are all BFP.

segments.speaker: BFP Officer-in-Charge Fire Chief Superintendent Wilberto Rico Neil A. Kwan Tiu
segments.text: Ang ginagawa po ng BFP ngayon, ma'am, continuous po yung capacity building po ng mga local disaster restaurants.

segments.speaker: BFP Officer-in-Charge Fire Chief Superintendent Wilberto Rico Neil A. Kwan Tiu
segments.text: At yung management office ng mga LGUs nila.

segments.speaker: BFP Officer-in-Charge Fire Chief Superintendent Wilberto Rico Neil A. Kwan Tiu
segments.text: Isa po yan, ma'am, sa nakasama po sa listahan na mga bibiliin po ng BFP.

segments.speaker: BFP Officer-in-Charge Fire Chief Superintendent Wilberto Rico Neil A. Kwan Tiu
segments.text: Pagdating po sa HIDR, kasama na po yung mga watercraft natin na magagamit automatically.

segments.speaker: BFP Officer-in-Charge Fire Chief Superintendent Wilberto Rico Neil A. Kwan Tiu
segments.text: That includes also the life vest.

segments.speaker: BFP Officer-in-Charge Fire Chief Superintendent Wilberto Rico Neil A. Kwan Tiu
segments.text: So hopefully po, madagdagan lang po yung pondo ng BFP para po mabiliin natin yung ating kailangan po.

segments.speaker: Rep. Anna York P. Bondoc, M.D.
segments.text: Rest assured, susuportahan ko po yan.

segments.speaker: Rep. Anna York P. Bondoc, M.D.
segments.text: And is it possible po that we would give the boats?

segments.speaker: Rep. Anna York P. Bondoc, M.D.
segments.text: Mga gamit po sa mga places na talagang alam po natin na binabaha?

segments.speaker: BFP Officer-in-Charge Fire Chief Superintendent Wilberto Rico Neil A. Kwan Tiu
segments.text: Ma'am, meron na po kaming identified mga localities na constantly po, maliit lang na ulan, binabaha kagad.

segments.speaker: Rep. Anna York P. Bondoc, M.D.
segments.text: Like yung mga nandun po sa Project NOAA, for example?

segments.speaker: BFP Officer-in-Charge Fire Chief Superintendent Wilberto Rico Neil A. Kwan Tiu
BFP Officer-in-Charge Fire Chief Superintendent Wilberto Rico Neil A. Kwan Tiu
segments.text: Pagka po, nadagdagan lang po yung pondo at mabibili po yung mga gamit namin,

segments.speaker: BFP Officer-in-Charge Fire Chief Superintendent Wilberto Rico Neil A. Kwan Tiu
segments.text: that will be distributed geographically kung ano po yung needs ng mga local fire stations natin.

segments.speaker: Rep. Anna York P. Bondoc, M.D.
segments.text: Kasi po sa amin, umaagos talaga yung tubig.

segments.speaker: Rep. Anna York P. Bondoc, M.D.
segments.text: And somebody drowned actually in front of me.

segments.speaker: Rep. Anna York P. Bondoc, M.D.
segments.text: At talagang kulang po yung gamit nila.

segments.speaker: Rep. Anna York P. Bondoc, M.D.
segments.text: So, if you could support us po, we would be very grateful.

segments.speaker: BFP Officer-in-Charge Fire Chief Superintendent Wilberto Rico Neil A. Kwan Tiu
segments.text: Rest assured, ma'am, that we will do our best to help in the capacity building po ng mga local disaster reduction management office po natin,

segments.speaker: BFP Officer-in-Charge Fire Chief Superintendent Wilberto Rico Neil A. Kwan Tiu
segments.text: yung mga parang gay disaster po.

segments.speaker: BFP Officer-in-Charge Fire Chief Superintendent Wilberto Rico Neil A. Kwan Tiu
segments.text: Constant naman po yung mga trainings namin sa kanila.

segments.speaker: BFP Officer-in-Charge Fire Chief Superintendent Wilberto Rico Neil A. Kwan Tiu
segments.text: And hopefully in the future, ma-acquire po namin yung mga necessary equipments

segments.speaker: BFP Officer-in-Charge Fire Chief Superintendent Wilberto Rico Neil A. Kwan Tiu
segments.text: and that will be placed doon po sa mga localities na talaga po tinatamaan po, baha or whatever.

segments.speaker: BFP Officer-in-Charge Fire Chief Superintendent Wilberto Rico Neil A. Kwan Tiu
segments.text: Kahit o hydromet hazards na meron po sila.

segments.speaker: Rep. Anna York P. Bondoc, M.D.
segments.text: Sige po. And we look forward to that.

segments.speaker: Rep. Anna York P. Bondoc, M.D.
segments.text: Sana po our PNPG would look into that also.

segments.speaker: BFP Officer-in-Charge Fire Chief Superintendent Wilberto Rico Neil A. Kwan Tiu
Rep. Anna York P. Bondoc, M.D.
segments.text: So, after climate change po, my next question is regarding po yung

segments.speaker: Rep. Anna York P. Bondoc, M.D.
segments.text: alam na po natin na talagang laganap na po ang mga threats sa bawat school po.

segments.speaker: Rep. Anna York P. Bondoc, M.D.
segments.text: At araw-araw daw yung mga PNP nandun na po sa bawat school checking up on threats.

segments.speaker: Rep. Anna York P. Bondoc, M.D.
Rep. Anna York P. Bondoc, M.D.
segments.text: Paano po, parang nagkaroon po ng access sa mga barel ang mga bata?

segments.speaker: Rep. Anna York P. Bondoc, M.D.
segments.text: And I believe these are registered firearms given to licensed personnel.

segments.speaker: Rep. Anna York P. Bondoc, M.D.
segments.text: Like yung isa po, yung tita niya was a nurse, a lawyer, and a policeman, a policewoman.

segments.speaker: Rep. Anna York P. Bondoc, M.D.
segments.text: And the other one po, yung daddy niya po, customs.

segments.speaker: Rep. Anna York P. Bondoc, M.D.
Rep. Anna York P. Bondoc, M.D.
segments.text: Parang hindi po unregistered eh. Registered pa po yung mga firearms.

segments.speaker: Rep. Anna York P. Bondoc, M.D.
Rep. Arnie B. Fuentebella
segments.text: Thank you for the last question.

segments.speaker: PNP Chief Police General Jose Melencio C. Nartatez Jr.
PNP Chief Police General Jose Melencio C. Nartatez Jr.
segments.text: Those recovered firearms that were used in June 16 as well as in Zamboanga are all registered firearms except for the other one.

segments.speaker: PNP Chief Police General Jose Melencio C. Nartatez Jr.
segments.text: So, the Philippine National Police, of course, in coordination with other law enforcement units,

segments.speaker: PNP Chief Police General Jose Melencio C. Nartatez Jr.
PNP Chief Police General Jose Melencio C. Nartatez Jr.
segments.text: as a unit responsible for regulating these firearms.

segments.speaker: PNP Chief Police General Jose Melencio C. Nartatez Jr.
segments.text: Ginagawa po ng paraan with regards to several policies.

segments.speaker: PNP Chief Police General Jose Melencio C. Nartatez Jr.
segments.text: As to when we say these are within the reach of children, of course, or minor,

segments.speaker: PNP Chief Police General Jose Melencio C. Nartatez Jr.
segments.text: of course, nandun na yung indication.

segments.speaker: PNP Chief Police General Jose Melencio C. Nartatez Jr.
segments.text: But that's why we have prepared cases against these personalities

segments.speaker: PNP Chief Police General Jose Melencio C. Nartatez Jr.
segments.text: who are supposed to be the custodian of these firearms.

segments.speaker: PNP Chief Police General Jose Melencio C. Nartatez Jr.
PNP Chief Police General Jose Melencio C. Nartatez Jr.
segments.text: The recommendation was, of course, the enactment of law such that maripil yung naging bailable ang ating violation of firearms,

segments.speaker: PNP Chief Police General Jose Melencio C. Nartatez Jr.
PNP Chief Police General Jose Melencio C. Nartatez Jr.
segments.text: We are recommending that a higher penalty be imposed for those in possession of unlicensed firearms.

segments.speaker: PNP Chief Police General Jose Melencio C. Nartatez Jr.
segments.text: Especially so that unlicensed firearms are being used in the commission of crime.

segments.speaker: PNP Chief Police General Jose Melencio C. Nartatez Jr.
segments.text: About 98% of the cases involving firearms are unlicensed firearms.

segments.speaker: PNP Chief Police General Jose Melencio C. Nartatez Jr.
Rep. Anna York P. Bondoc, M.D.
segments.text: And lastly, ano po yung maging role po ng barangay Tanots and the barangay regarding this?

segments.speaker: Rep. Anna York P. Bondoc, M.D.
segments.text: Ito pong mga nagiging violence in schools.

segments.speaker: Rep. Anna York P. Bondoc, M.D.
Rep. Anna York P. Bondoc, M.D.
segments.text: At may role po ba sila?

segments.speaker: PNP Chief Police General Jose Melencio C. Nartatez Jr.
PNP Chief Police General Jose Melencio C. Nartatez Jr.
segments.text: Ang alam naman natin ng peace and order ay shared responsibility of the community and the...

segments.speaker: Rep. Anna York P. Bondoc, M.D.
Rep. Anna York P. Bondoc, M.D.
segments.text: Limited lang po ang polis sa isang munisipyo eh.

segments.speaker: Rep. Anna York P. Bondoc, M.D.
segments.text: And they cannot be patrolling all the elementary schools.

segments.speaker: Rep. Anna York P. Bondoc, M.D.
segments.text: Though ako po as a parent, bahala na po yung ibang crimes, basta okay lang po yung mga kids.

segments.speaker: Rep. Anna York P. Bondoc, M.D.
segments.text: Pero again, that is not realistic.

segments.speaker: Rep. Anna York P. Bondoc, M.D.
segments.text: Pero kung tatangin niyo po, gusto ko yun.

PNP Chief Police General Jose Melencio C. Nartatez Jr.
PNP Chief Police General Jose Melencio C. Nartatez Jr.

PNP Chief Police General Jose Melencio C. Nartatez Jr.
segments.text: Kung pibilangin na lang natin ang number of schools, there are, of course, more than 42,000.

segments.speaker: PNP Chief Police General Jose Melencio C. Nartatez Jr.
PNP Chief Police General Jose Melencio C. Nartatez Jr.
segments.text: So, let's say it's about 56,000 schools nationwide, including those private schools.

segments.speaker: PNP Chief Police General Jose Melencio C. Nartatez Jr.
segments.text: So, it is a must that we multiply each other, especially in negating the occurrence of crime

segments.speaker: PNP Chief Police General Jose Melencio C. Nartatez Jr.
PNP Chief Police General Jose Melencio C. Nartatez Jr.
segments.text: The best po dyan is the police, other law enforcement agencies working together with the community

segments.text: para po may capacitate at madinay natin by police presence or presence of our...

segments.speaker: PNP Chief Police General Jose Melencio C. Nartatez Jr.
segments.text: presence of this police in the community, especially in the school.

segments.speaker: PNP Chief Police General Jose Melencio C. Nartatez Jr.
segments.text: And if we have 230,000 and then say another times 3, 42,000 times 7 of barangay,

segments.speaker: PNP Chief Police General Jose Melencio C. Nartatez Jr.
PNP Chief Police General Jose Melencio C. Nartatez Jr.
segments.text: But it is not the efficient way of maintaining peace and order.

Rep. Anna York P. Bondoc, M.D.
Rep. Anna York P. Bondoc, M.D.
segments.text: Sila muna yung una, tapos pag kayo na po yung re-rescue sa kanila.

PNP Chief Police General Jose Melencio C. Nartatez Jr.
Rep. Anna York P. Bondoc, M.D.
PNP Chief Police General Jose Melencio C. Nartatez Jr.
segments.text: We are sitting together, engaging each other, and...

segments.speaker: PNP Chief Police General Jose Melencio C. Nartatez Jr.
segments.text: making sure that we have our security plan for that.

segments.text: May mga data po ba kayo regarding crime, kung ina niyong pinatay, kanila, or...

segments.text: Under the leadership of General Atates.

Rep. Anna York P. Bondoc, M.D.
segments.text: Yes, I'm actually curious lang po.

PNP Chief Police General Jose Melencio C. Nartatez Jr.
segments.text: Sir Chair, we'll be submitting the data.

segments.text: I would like to recognize the presence of our SDS,

segments.text: Ang pinakahuli na po magtatanong sa inyo,

segments.text: hinihintay po po natin si Chairman Micah Sonsing.

segments.text: Pero habang wala siya, may clarificatory question lang po ako.

segments.text: So, we have the letter already.

segments.text: It was received na by Secretary Vince Dizon.

segments.speaker: Rep. Arnie B. Fuentebella
segments.text: And for sure, tatanungin po ang DNR and then tatanungin po rin ng DILG,

segments.text: siyempre po gagamit ka ng bakho,

segments.speaker: Rep. Mikaela Angela B. Suansing
segments.text: So, if I may po, on behalf of the civil society organizations, I would like to pose a few questions

segments.speaker: Rep. Mikaela Angela B. Suansing
segments.text: These questions po, emanate from Code NGO, and these are the questions po for DILG.

segments.speaker: Rep. Mikaela Angela B. Suansing
segments.text: The first is the rationale for the Local Government Support Fund.

segments.speaker: Rep. Mikaela Angela B. Suansing
segments.text: I believe this was actually discussed at length by Secretary Jonvic earlier today.

segments.speaker: Rep. Mikaela Angela B. Suansing
segments.text: The Mandanas-Garcia ruling broadened the tax base used to compute the just share of local government units in national taxes,

segments.speaker: Rep. Mikaela Angela B. Suansing
segments.text: now released through the National Tax Allotment.

segments.speaker: Rep. Mikaela Angela B. Suansing
segments.text: Considering the resulting increase in the NTA of LGUs,

segments.speaker: Rep. Mikaela Angela B. Suansing
segments.text: What is the policy justification for retaining a separate local government support fund

segments.speaker: Rep. Mikaela Angela B. Suansing
segments.text: whose allocations are still determined and directly released by the national government

segments.speaker: Rep. Mikaela Angela B. Suansing
segments.text: Follow-up question po, what specific programs, needs, or fiscal gaps funded through the LGSF

segments.speaker: Rep. Mikaela Angela B. Suansing
segments.text: cannot be adequately supported through the increased NTA and other regular revenues of LGUs?

segments.speaker: Rep. Mikaela Angela B. Suansing
segments.text: How does the government ensure that the LGSF supplements rather than duplicates or substitutes

segments.speaker: Rep. Mikaela Angela B. Suansing
segments.text: for resources already available to LGUs?

segments.speaker: Rep. Mikaela Angela B. Suansing
segments.text: So yun po yung katanungan. If we may pose that to DILG.

segments.speaker: DILG Undersecretary for Local Government Marlo L. Iringan
segments.text: Thank you, Mr. Chair. Your Honor.

segments.speaker: DILG Undersecretary for Local Government Marlo L. Iringan
segments.text: For 2027, the estimated national tax allocation share of local government is like 1.32 to 1.4 trillion pesos.

segments.speaker: DILG Undersecretary for Local Government Marlo L. Iringan
segments.text: But this amount is divided between and among the 82 provinces, 149 cities, 1,493 municipalities,

segments.speaker: DILG Undersecretary for Local Government Marlo L. Iringan
DILG Undersecretary for Local Government Marlo L. Iringan
segments.text: So on the surface, it looks like it's a very, very big amount.

segments.speaker: DILG Undersecretary for Local Government Marlo L. Iringan
segments.text: But when divided between those local governments that I mentioned,

segments.speaker: DILG Undersecretary for Local Government Marlo L. Iringan
segments.text: a while ago, it will not really be enough to fund the priority projects of the local governments,

segments.speaker: DILG Undersecretary for Local Government Marlo L. Iringan
segments.text: considering that there are devolved functions that are given to LGUs.

segments.speaker: DILG Undersecretary for Local Government Marlo L. Iringan
segments.text: So the local government support fund, which will be like 58 billion for 2027,

segments.speaker: DILG Undersecretary for Local Government Marlo L. Iringan
segments.text: will be an additional resource, additional fund, which the local governments can use

segments.speaker: DILG Undersecretary for Local Government Marlo L. Iringan
segments.text: in responding to the other felt needs.

segments.speaker: DILG Undersecretary for Local Government Marlo L. Iringan
DILG Undersecretary for Local Government Marlo L. Iringan
segments.text: These funds are earmarked for projects like water system, water sanitation system,

segments.speaker: DILG Undersecretary for Local Government Marlo L. Iringan
DILG Undersecretary for Local Government Marlo L. Iringan
segments.text: and for other basic services of the people in the different localities.

segments.speaker: DILG Undersecretary for Local Government Marlo L. Iringan
segments.text: So I believe, Mr. Chair, Your Honor, that's the rationale why there's the local government support fund.

segments.speaker: Rep. Mikaela Angela B. Suansing
segments.text: Just to clarify po, I believe this was something that Sec. Mulya raised earlier today, that for the record, DILG, what is the role that DILG plays in LGSF? Para lang po malinaw.

segments.speaker: DILG Undersecretary for Local Government Marlo L. Iringan
segments.text: Yes, Your Honor, Mr. Chair. The local government support fund is directly released to the local governments.

segments.speaker: DILG Undersecretary for Local Government Marlo L. Iringan
segments.text: The DILG's task is to, per the General Appropriations Act, is to do the monitoring and evaluation in the implementation of these projects.

segments.speaker: DILG Undersecretary for Local Government Marlo L. Iringan
segments.text: So for that purpose, as I mentioned a while ago, we have a fund allocated for the hiring of engineers and project evaluation officers, which we deploy to our provinces and regions to help us monitor, to ensure the faithful implementation of all those projects funded from the LGSF.

segments.speaker: Rep. Mikaela Angela B. Suansing
segments.text: So in terms of validation po, vetting?

segments.speaker: DILG Undersecretary for Local Government Marlo L. Iringan
segments.text: Yes, Your Honor, Mr. Chair. There's a portal created by DBM where LGUs can submit their project proposals.

segments.speaker: Rep. Mikaela Angela B. Suansing
segments.text: So just to answer the last question of our CSO partner, hindi po DILG. Kasi po ang tanong, how do we ensure that these are not duplicate projects?

segments.speaker: Rep. Mikaela Angela B. Suansing
segments.text: So the vetting, the validation, all that process is not...

segments.speaker: Rep. Mikaela Angela B. Suansing
segments.text: It's not handled by DILG, but rather DBM. So we can, perhaps, we can also post that as a question to the DBM.

segments.speaker: DILG Undersecretary for Local Government Marlo L. Iringan
segments.text: That's correct, Mr. Chair, Your Honor. It's the LGUs themselves which identify the priority projects that they will fund from the LGSF.

segments.speaker: DILG Undersecretary for Local Government Marlo L. Iringan
Rep. Mikaela Angela B. Suansing
segments.text: Thank you. Thank you, po, USEC. So we'll move to the next question. This is with regard to community participation, project validation, and oversight, also from Code NGO.

segments.speaker: Rep. Mikaela Angela B. Suansing
segments.text: Could the DILG explain the complete process

segments.speaker: Rep. Mikaela Angela B. Suansing
segments.text: for identifying, endorsing, validating, procuring, and monitoring projects funded under the LGSF, particularly the FALGU, to the Barangay Development Program?

segments.speaker: Rep. Mikaela Angela B. Suansing
segments.text: At what stages are local development councils, local sanggunians, accredited civil society organizations, sectoral representatives, and affected communities meaningfully involved?

segments.speaker: Rep. Mikaela Angela B. Suansing
segments.text: To ensure that projects respond to documented community needs, are aligned with local development plans, do not duplicate existing national government or LGU programs, and are protected from conflicts of interest and undue influence in procurement.

segments.speaker: Rep. Mikaela Angela B. Suansing
segments.text: The 2027 National Expenditure Program also proposes P563.925 million for the DILG's monitoring and evaluation of LGSF projects, as mentioned by USEC.

segments.speaker: Rep. Mikaela Angela B. Suansing
segments.text: What measurable outputs, public disclosure requirements, and accountability mechanisms correspond to this allocation?

segments.speaker: Rep. Mikaela Angela B. Suansing

segments.speaker: DILG Undersecretary for Local Government Marlo L. Iringan
